raw.excerpt: As an DFR Application Engineer, you will be a key part of our Commercial Sales Team, helping drive the growth and success of our Drone First Responder (DFR) solutions portfolio in North America.
raw.description:
As an DFR Application Engineer, you will be a key part of our Commercial Sales Team, helping drive the growth and success of our Drone First Responder (DFR) solutions portfolio in North America. You will operate at the intersection of customer engagement, product innovation, and operational excellence, acting as a trusted technical advisor for customers, channel partners, and internal stakeholders. Together with our world-class team, you will help shape the future of public safety and autonomous aerial operations by translating customer needs into scalable, mission-ready solutions. The role is focused on supporting and advancing our DFR ecosystem, particularly around DronePort, Twister, and future autonomous deployment capabilities.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the primary technical expert for our DFR solutions portfolio, supporting customers, channel partners, and internal sales teams throughout the entire customer lifecycle.

  • Customer Engagement: Collaborate closely with public safety agencies, first responders, government organisations, and commercial customers to understand operational requirements and translate them into effective solutions.

  • Solution Consulting: Conduct product demonstrations, technical workshops, proof-of-concept activities, flight testing, and customer evaluations to showcase the value of Quantum Systems technologies.

  • Product & Roadmap Development: Work directly with Product Management and Engineering teams to define product requirements, provide field feedback, and help shape the future roadmap for DronePort, Twister, and associated DFR capabilities.

  • Cross-Functional Product Collaboration: Partner closely with software and hardware development teams, utilising tools such as Confluence, Jira, and related product management platforms to document requirements, communicate customer feedback, and align development priorities.

  • Requirements Management: Capture customer requirements, operational challenges, and mission needs and translate them into structured recommendations for product development.

  • Sales Enablement: Support the Commercial Sales organisation through technical presentations, RFP responses, customer workshops, technical qualification, and proposal development.

  • Channel Partner Support: Train, guide, and enable reseller and integration partners to successfully deploy and operate Quantum Systems solutions.

  • Regulatory & Operational Support: Support customers and internal stakeholders on FAA-related operational concepts, BVLOS operations, public aircraft operations, waivers, and emerging Part 108 requirements.

  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed about industry trends, regulatory developments, competitive technologies, and emerging DFR use cases to strengthen our market position.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Training teams to ensure successful deployments and long-term customer satisfaction.

Requirements

What you bring to the team:

  • Several years of experience in Application Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Pre-Sales, Customer Success Engineering, or a comparable customer-facing technical role.

  • Experience within UAV/UAS, public safety, defence, robotics, aerospace, telecommunications, emergency response, or related technology industries is highly desirable.

  • Strong understanding of customer requirements gathering, technical solution development, and stakeholder management.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience working with cross-functional software and hardware product development teams, including familiarity with collaboration and product management tools such as Confluence, Jira, or similar platforms.

  • Experience supporting technology products throughout their lifecycle, from evaluation and deployment through ongoing operations.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to troubleshoot, demonstrate, and present technical products in customer environments.

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to influence cross-functional teams.

  • Willingness to travel extensively across the United States and Canada as required to support customers and business growth.

  • FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate required.

  • Knowledge of FAA regulatory frameworks, including current and emerging Part 108 requirements, is strongly preferred.

  • Hands-on experience obtaining or operating under BVLOS waivers and public aircraft operations, including Certificates of Authorization (COAs), is strongly preferred.

  • Experience with dock-based drone operations, remote flight operations, or Drone First Responder (DFR) programmes is strongly preferred.

  • Familiarity with autonomous drone deployment systems and remote command-and-control environments is considered a strong advantage.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • A proactive, solution-oriented approach and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations.

At Quantum Systems, you’ll work alongside experts across disciplines, take ownership from day one and help turn ambitious ideas into technology with real-world impact. We move fast, think beyond boundaries and give our teams the space to shape what comes next.

The Future is Unmanned - But the responsibility is not.

Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The Mission

Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, and scale their applications with speed and intelligence. We are hiring a Product Manager, Billing to lead the product and systems work behind how Konnect makes money: entitlements, metering, checkout, invoicing, provisioning, and the enterprise and marketplace motions that surround them.

In this role you are the product owner of Konnect's commercial operating layer: the systems that translate what Sales sells and what customers use into what ends up on an invoice. That means plan and entitlement design, the usage metering pipeline, self-serve checkout and subscription lifecycle, customer organization and billing admin experiences, enterprise billing workflows (CPQ sync, custom contracts), and cloud marketplace billing. You will work hand-in-hand with Product Growth, Pricing & Packaging, Finance, GTM, Sales, and Engineering.

This role reports to the Sr Director, Product (Platform) and sits at the intersection of two multi-year transformations: Kong's move from a single-product API gateway company into a multi-product enterprise, and Monetization's company-wide overhaul of pricing and packaging. The Billing, Provisioning, and Fulfillment program has historically been manual and relationship-driven. Your job is to turn it into a product, so Sales can sell more, Finance can bill more accurately, and customers get an experience that matches the quality of what they are paying for.

What You’ll Do

  • Platform Vision: Set a multi-year direction for how Konnect prices, meters, entitles, and invoices. Decide what becomes shared platform capability versus what stays feature-specific, and sequence delivery so near-term work lands without creating long-term drag.

  • Unified Entitlements: Build the entitlements model that determines what every customer can access within Konnect. Make entitlements a first-class concept that is consistently defined in contracts, enforced in-product, honored by provisioning, and reflected in billing.

  • Pricing & Packaging Delivery: Act as the product and systems counterpart to Monetization. Translate pricing and packaging decisions into production reality: configuring plans, reshaping metering, updating contracts, coordinating customer migrations, and making sure a rollout doesn't disrupt existing revenue.

  • Metering & Usage Visibility: Run the event pipeline, aggregation layer, and reporting experiences that show customers what they consumed and what they are being charged. Hold a financial-grade bar on accuracy, auditability, and reconcilability.

  • Checkout & Subscription Lifecycle: Own how customers self-serve onto a plan, change plans, renew, lapse, and recover. That covers plan discovery, checkout, the underlying payments integration, subscription state, retries and dunning, and the admin surfaces where customers manage their own billing.

  • Enterprise & Marketplace Motions: Connect Kong's enterprise sales and channel motions to the billing stack: CPQ-to-entitlement sync, bespoke contract handling, invoice-based billing, and marketplace billing across AWS, GCP, and Azure as we expand our presence there.

  • Fulfillment Automation: Replace today's manual, high-touch provisioning and fulfillment processes with productized, automated workflows. This includes migrating off our current metering and billing system onto a target stack that supports the new pricing and packaging framework.

  • Outcomes & Measurement: Define the health metrics for the domain, including net revenue retention, billing-driven churn, invoice dispute rate, collections aging, and billing support ticket load. Use them to set priorities and hold the team accountable for results.

What You’ll Bring

  • Have at least 6 years of product management experience in SaaS, with 2 or more spent directly in a billing, monetization, or pricing domain.

  • Can reason about the moving parts of a billing stack well enough to co-design the architecture with your engineering partner.

  • Have carried a pricing or packaging change from proposal through to production, including financial modeling, plan configuration, grandfathering logic, migrations, sales enablement, and customer communication.

  • Have built or scaled consumption-based monetization and understand the tradeoffs between simplicity, accuracy, and customer trust when metering drives the invoice.

  • Pull your own numbers when you need them (SQL, Snowflake, Hex, or equivalent) and use data to set priorities rather than to decorate decisions already made.

  • Have worked directly with Stripe or a metered billing platform (Metronome, Orb, OpenMeter), not through an engineer.

  • Hold billing surfaces (plan pages, checkouts, invoices, usage dashboards) to the same design standard as the rest of the product.

  • Have worked in or adjacent to API, infrastructure, or developer-platform products, and are comfortable with the technical context that comes with that territory.

  • Independently define and execute the long-term vision to bring billing, fulfillment, and provisioning to best-in-class for the company's success.

Bonus Points

  • Experience leading an end-to-end pricing transformation or building a billing system from scratch.

  • Shipped cloud marketplace integrations (AWS, GCP, Azure) or Salesforce CPQ-to-billing integrations.

  • Proficiency using LLMs and coding agents as part of your day-to-day product management workflow.

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit .

Compensation Range: $160K - $230K

raw.description:
About Offshore Launch:

Offshore Launch is a business and growth operations firm helping home service owners scale their operations.

We design, build, and staff business and revenue operations so the shop runs on clear process, technology and data - so owners can work on the business instead of being trapped inside it.

We are a people-centered agency with a passion for leaving every employee and client in a better position than we found them.

Why Join Offshore Launch?

  • Impact the growth and success of small and medium-sized businesses.
  • Work in a people-first, remote environment that values career growth.
  • Access comprehensive benefits that include HMO, PTO, transparent bonus, raise and career pathways - with an overall emphasis on teamwork, collaboration, and work/life balance.
  • Contribute to a culture that values partnership, service, and excellence.

Who We Serve

You’ll be the Office Manager for a family-owned residential plumbing, heating and cooling company. The family has been in the trade for 40+ years and serves homeowners in Connecticut and New York. They run a premium, professional operation:

  • Flat-rate pricing
  • Customer financing
  • A paid maintenance membership
  • 24/7 emergency service

Their customers expect polish, and so does the owner. This role is for someone who wants to own the office, not just support it.

What you’ll own

  • The phones. You are the first voice customers hear. You answer and book calls for service, emergencies (no heat, active leaks, no hot water) and estimates, calmly and professionally.
  • Scheduling and dispatch. Build and manage the technicians’ daily schedules, re-route them when emergencies come in, and keep customers updated on arrival times. The owner should not have to step in.
  • Follow-up. Make happy calls after jobs, follow up on open estimates per the SOP, and sell and renew maintenance memberships.
  • Job tracking. Track every job from booking through completion and invoicing, and flag any job that’s stuck, on hold or at risk of slipping.
  • Cash. Invoice, collect payments, keep receivables current and help customers through financing applications.
  • Compliance and admin. Handle permits, certificates of insurance (COIs), licenses and technician paperwork accurately and on time.
  • Payroll. Prepare accurate payroll every pay period.
  • Reporting. Send the owner a weekly report covering calls, booking rate, job completion, backlog, AR aging and memberships.
  • Systems and team. Keep the field service software (Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan or similar) clean and accurate. Support hiring and onboarding, and manage any office staff added as the company grows.

How you’ll be measured

  • 95%+ of calls answered
  • Every new lead contacted within 5 minutes
  • 75%+ of qualified leads booked
  • Every open estimate followed up on time, per the SOP
  • Membership sign-ups and renewals on target
  • AR kept within target, with nothing aging without action
  • A weekly list of stuck or on-hold jobs, sent with zero surprises
  • Payroll, permits and paperwork done right and on time, every time

You’ll succeed here if you have

  • 2+ years in office management, dispatch, customer service or operations coordination, ideally in plumbing, HVAC or other home services
  • Hands-on experience with Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan, Jobber or a similar platform
  • Excellent spoken English and a confident, warm phone presence
  • High drive and high attention to detail. You follow through without being chased.
  • The ability to juggle phones, schedules and follow-ups at the same time without dropping anything
  • Availability to work US Eastern business hours

Nice to have

  • Direct plumbing or HVAC experience, especially with emergency dispatch or maintenance memberships
  • Experience with payroll, AR or basic job costing
  • Experience managing a small remote team

Compensation & Benefits (to be provided by Offshore Launch):

  • Up to $1600/mo depending on experience
  • Guaranteed annual bonus of one month's salary
  • Performance-based annual bonus up to 1.5x one month's salary contingent on quarterly performance scores
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including dependents: health, life, vision and dental insurance.
  • 16 days PTO

Note:

The Client is not involved in compensation or benefits. As an employee of Offshore Launch, all compensation and benefits are to be provided by the Agency.

Please note that we anticipate a response from candidates within 24 hours of our outreach. If we do not receive a reply within this timeframe, we will assume that you are no longer interested in pursuing this opportunity.

The Oncology Program Trainer plays a key role in strengthening and advancing reimbursement knowledge across the program to support exceptional patient access outcomes. While the program benefits from strong nursing and clinical leadership, this position is focused on enhancing foundational reimbursement expertise across both the RCM and Nurse Navigator teams, including benefit investigations, explanation of benefits (EOB) interpretation, and revenue cycle management (RCM) fundamentals.

Using adult learning principles, the Program Trainer will facilitate engaging and effective training programs utilizing manufacturer-provided and client approved materials to build team confidence and capability in reimbursement processes. In addition, the role will proactively identify opportunities for content enhancements and communicate update recommendations to key stakeholders based on learner feedback, program evolution, and changing payer requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Deliver reimbursement fundamentals training covering benefit investigations, EOB interpretation, and RCM basics for both RCM and Nurse Navigator team members

  • Support training alignment with manufacturer-provided and client approved content, incorporating or leveraging manufacturer materials where applicable

  • Communicate training content gaps or update needs to the appropriate client and internal stakeholders, in alignment with manufacturer-provided and client approved content standards

  • Support the training team in the maintenance and delivery of existing manufacturer-provided and client approved training materials

  • Update the knowledge management system to ensure it holds the most up-to-date program and reimbursement information

  • Facilitate new hire training and skills development classes for both RCM and Nurse Navigator populations

  • Coordinate and deliver reimbursement compliance training updates and skills refresher classes

  • Track new hire and annual compliance training completion as needed

  • Provide follow-up for all new hire classes at 30 days and 60 days post training to ensure that skills have transferred to the job

  • Document areas of concern for all trainees and review results with Training and Development Manager

  • Pursue ongoing professional development in training delivery through attendance of webinars and meetings for training professionals

  • Confers with management to gain knowledge of work situations requiring training for employees to better understand changes in policies, procedures, regulations, and technologies

  • Determines appropriate instructional methods to use in a variety of settings (e.g., group instruction, workshops, individual training)

  • Selects appropriate manufacturer-provided and client approved training resources and facilitates supplemental exercises such as reimbursement workflow simulations and payer scenario practice

  • On time adherence to training deadlines for all corporate policies and procedures governing access to confidential data

  • Ensure all SOPs are followed with consistency

  • Conducts miscellaneous tasks or projects as assigned

  • Provide in-person and/or virtual training, with enthusiasm and high energy, to program team members using manufacturer-provided and client approved materials

Are you passionate about making a difference in people's lives? Do you enjoy working in a service-oriented industry? If so, this opportunity may be the right fit for you!

Modivcare is looking for an experienced MDM Architect to join our team. As an MDM Architect, you will play a critical role in shaping the enterprise data foundation that powers healthcare operations, analytics, AI-driven decision-making, and digital transformation. You will lead the design and implementation of modern Master Data Management (MDM) capabilities that establish trusted, governed, and high-quality data across our Member, Provider, Facility, and other enterprise domains. Your work will directly improve the accuracy of critical business processes, enhance experiences for members and providers, accelerate innovation, and enable strategic growth across the organization.

We’re looking for a collaborative technology talent who enjoys solving complex enterprise data challenges, influencing enterprise architecture, and building scalable solutions that create lasting business value. The ideal candidate is passionate about modern data platforms, embraces continuous learning, and is excited to help shape the future of healthcare by delivering trusted, high-quality data that powers better decisions, stronger operational outcomes, and improved member experiences.

This is an opportunity to build enterprise-scale data products that become foundational assets for operational systems, advanced analytics, regulatory reporting, and emerging AI initiatives. Working closely with business and technology leaders, you will establish scalable architecture, modern engineering practices, and enterprise governance standards that transform data into a strategic business asset while supporting Modivcare’s mission of delivering better care through better data.

This role…

Master Data Management & Solution Architecture

  • Design and implement enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) solutions, including canonical data models, entity relationships, hierarchies, reference data, and enterprise data standards.

  • Establish trusted Golden Records through identity resolution, survivorship rules, and deterministic and probabilistic matching techniques.

  • Configure, implement, and optimize enterprise MDM platforms such as Ataccama ONE, Reltio, or similar technologies.

  • Define and maintain canonical data models and governance standards that improve consistency across enterprise applications.

  • Ensure master data is accurate, governed, reusable, and available across Member, Provider, Facility, and other enterprise domains.

  • Design scalable architecture that supports operational excellence, enterprise growth, advanced analytics, and AI initiatives.

Data Integration & APIs

  • Design and develop secure, scalable APIs and enterprise data services that expose mastered data to operational systems, analytics platforms, and downstream applications.

  • Build integration solutions supporting real-time, near real-time, and batch data exchange.

  • Develop scalable integration patterns that enable enterprise-wide consumption of trusted master data.

  • Ensure secure, governed access to enterprise master data across cloud and hybrid environments.

Data Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain cloud-native data pipelines using AWS Redshift, Glue, Lambda, Amazon S3, Athena, and Step Functions.

  • Develop scalable transformation logic using SQL and dbt.

  • Leverage dbt capabilities including data testing, schema validation, referential integrity, documentation, lineage tracking, exposures, metric definitions, and environment-based deployment controls.

  • Support CI/CD deployment pipelines and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Pulumi.

  • Implement enterprise best practices for testing, documentation, deployment, observability, and governance.

  • Optimize SQL, data processing, and query performance across large-scale healthcare datasets.

  • Build modern data platforms that enable advanced analytics, machine learning, AI, and enterprise reporting while improving operational efficiency.

Data Quality & Stewardship

  • Collaborate with Data Governance teams to implement enterprise metadata management, stewardship, lineage, and governance processes.

  • Define, measure, and monitor master data quality metrics, governance KPIs, and service level agreements (SLAs).

  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, PHI, PII, privacy, security, and applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Promote enterprise adoption of governed and standardized master data practices.

  • Champion governance processes that enable innovation while protecting critical enterprise information assets.

  • This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

We are interested in speaking with individuals with the following…

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Ten (10) plus years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, data warehousing, enterprise data management, or related disciplines.

  • Four (4) plus years of hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) solutions.

  • Experience implementing enterprise MDM platforms such as Ataccama ONE, Reltio, or similar solutions.

Responsibilities for Network Analyst/Network Engineer:

The Network Analyst is responsible for providing specialized technical support commensurate with acquired tele Network skills required during the conception, planning, and design of technical solutions to satisfy business needs.

The Network Analyst will report to a manager, although, depending on the nature, size, and duration of a project, the incumbent may also be reported temporarily to a Network Project Manager in a matrix environment.

Must be able to work independently to accomplish tasks.

The scope of the Network includes network architecture, Network hardware and software, networking applications, network management, planning and management of financial budgets, and Network products and services.

Responsible for implementing and supporting a diverse and wide range of technology, encompassing all the company's networks in all branches in the region, maintaining service reliability and availability in line with Service Level Agreements requirements consistent with strategic objectives.

Procedures and policies, based on experience and industry best practices, will be developed to quickly resolve all incidents and introduce cost-effective structural remedies to permanently fix problems while maintaining confidentiality, availability, and integrity of all systems, networks, and data.

Knowledge of banking products, procedures, business practices, and customer expectations is a must to gauge the effect of change on service delivery.

Experience with support and deployment of all or subset of network routers and switches, network firewalls, and voice systems required.

Ensure proper information is available and always current in all appropriate, and possibly multiple, locations, including SharePoint administration and coordination with other repository owners.

Collect and diagnose sample products that indicate quality issues, locate the component or identify the process causing the issue with the root cause and preventive action plans if applicable, and document findings for management review.

Create and provide testing and repair procedures to service operations for known quality issues and monitor the reliability of the products in the field.

Provide easily understandable illustrations and wordings for diagnosis-related service information bulletins originally sent from the counter partner for a more efficient and effective repair process.

Qualifications

  1. 5+ years of experience
  2. A certified CCNA is a must
  3. Bachelor's Degree in Network Engineering or any equivalent
  4. 2+ years of experience working on Enterprise level projects for Financial Institutions
  5. Thorough understanding of Network principles and practices
  6. Understanding of financial/investment industry is a plus
  7. Has a can-do attitude and a sense of urgency in this rapidly changing environment
  8. Thrive in a fast-past, deadline-driven environment with the ability to work collaboratively and individually
  9. Strong organization, attention to detail, and analytical skills.

title: Sr. Principal Platform Engineer
description: Hi.  We’re Hummingbird. We’re elevating patient access so patients can get healthcare how, when, and where they need it.

raw.title: Sr. Principal Platform Engineer
raw.excerpt: Hi.  We’re Hummingbird. We’re elevating patient access so patients can get healthcare how, when, and where they need it.
raw.description:
Hi. We’re Hummingbird.

We’re elevating patient access so patients can get healthcare how, when, and where they need it. We partner with healthcare systems to transform how patients access care, enabling their providers to focus on what matters most – caring for patients. By managing patient access as a technology-enabled service, we help health systems stabilize costs and improve patient experience while creating good jobs that attract and retain talent in the industry. Our team of experts is obsessed with the connection between the people, processes, and technology that make healthcare organizations hum. Join us and help build the healthcare experience we want for our communities, our families, and ourselves.

Summary

Responsibilities

About the Role


Build the platforms that power patient access, and help a growing engineering team do the best work of their careers.


As a Sr. Principal Platform Engineer at Hummingbird, you’ll be the technical anchor for the team that builds our production platforms. You’ll spend most of your day hands on in the code: designing and building features, making the architecture decisions that shape our applications, and reviewing the work of earlier-career engineers so the whole team grows stronger. You’ll bring deep, independent engineering skill to the work and use AI tools to move faster without relying on them to do the thinking for you.


You’ll work closely with your team and partner regularly with IT Security and Data and Analytics to keep our systems connected, reliable, and built to last. For a few engineers just starting their careers, you’ll be the person who helps them understand not just what we build, but why we build it the way we do.


What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain the core of our production platforms, spending most of your time hands on in the codebase.
  • Own the architecture decisions for our production applications, choosing where logic should live and how systems should connect.
  • Review pull requests and designs from earlier-career engineers, reinforcing standards for quality and consistency.
  • Mentor engineers who are early in their careers, helping them understand the reasoning behind technical decisions.
  • Develop across the full stack, working in both front-end and back-end code as the work requires.
  • Partner with IT Security and Data and Analytics to align on data access, integration, and system design.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues, from failed integrations to system reliability problems, and resolve them at the root.
  • Use AI-powered development tools to speed up delivery while keeping full ownership of quality and design judgment.
  • Document decisions and tradeoffs so the team can build consistently and maintain systems over time.

The Details

  • Employment Eligibility: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship
  • Work Location: Remote. You must work from a location within the United States with consistent Internet service
  • Work Type: Full-time
  • Compensation: Expected range is $162,500 to $211,250. New hires usually start between $162,500 and $195,000, depending on experience and internal equity.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; 401(k); parental leave; career development support; and more

Required & Desired Skills

What You’ll Bring

  • 8 to 10+ years of software engineering experience, with deep hands-on skill building and shipping production systems.
  • Strong, independent programming ability across the full stack, working comfortably in both front-end and back-end code.
  • Hands-on experience with our stack or closely related technologies: TypeScript, Python, React, and Vite.
  • Strong system design and architecture skills, with the judgment to review designs and sign off on technical direction.
  • A track record of mentoring and growing earlier-career engineers, including those in their first role out of school.
  • A process-oriented mindset and the ability to reinforce standards through code and design review.
  • Comfort using AI-powered development tools to work faster, paired with the discipline not to rely on them for core engineering judgment.

Nice to Have

  • A computer science degree or equivalent formal background in software engineering.
  • Experience in a start-up or fast-paced environment where you’ve built structure while moving quickly.
  • Background working in regulated, secure, or high-trust environments such as healthcare.

What Helps You Shine

  • Please note that we use both your resume and your written and oral communication throughout the hiring process to understand your fit for this role.
  • Thoughtful, clear responses help us see your attention to detail, your professionalism, and your ability to communicate with care, all skills that are essential for success on our team.

Expectations for Focus & Presence

  • To support patients and each other, this role requires your full attention during scheduled work hours. Our Outside Employment Policy doesn’t allow overlapping work or “job stacking,” so any outside work must happen fully outside your Hummingbird schedule.
  • We’re a camera-ready team, and you’ll need to be on camera during training and when needed during the workday after training ends.
  • We value connection, teamwork, and being present, which is what keeps our patients safe and our team supported. If that’s what you’re looking for, you’ll feel at home here. If you’re hoping to hold another job during the same hours, this job won’t be the best match.

Growth at Hummingbird

This role is a key step in our engineering career path. You’ll receive support, collaboration, and real technical ownership from day one, with the chance to shape our platforms, grow the engineers around you, and take on broader architectural influence over time. At Hummingbird, we believe good jobs should lead somewhere, and that starts here.


Please Note: The seniority level of this position may be adjusted during the recruitment process based on candidate skills and experience.


A Note on Authentic Interviews

We believe the best hiring conversations are real ones. Notes are welcome, and jotting things down during the call is completely fine. What we ask is that you don’t use AI tools or similar assistance to generate your responses in real time. We’re genuinely trying to get to know you: how you think, how you communicate, and what you’ve experienced. That connection matters to us, and it’s hard to find when answers are scripted rather than interactive.

We’re a team that makes healthcare more human. We’d love to meet the person behind your application.

The Hummingbird Approach
We value a team that brings diverse perspectives and experiences to the work we do. While there are many ways to do this, people who are successful at Hummingbird:

  • Lead with Respect by valuing kindness and working to actively foster an environment of inclusion and respect.
  • Embrace Growth and seek out learning and growth for themselves and support those around them in their growth journey. They bring curiosity and an openness to innovation to all their interactions.
  • Bring a Win Together mentality by approaching conflict directly, listening carefully, and seeking to understand. They problem-solve with the goal of finding successes, not trade-offs, for all involved.

Equal Opportunity Statement
Hummingbird Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic. We value the talents of individuals from all backgrounds and actively seek a diverse workforce.

Our mission is to provide a fair and inclusive recruitment process for everyone, and reasonable accommodations are available to any applicant who may need them. Please reach out to to request accommodations and we’d be happy to chat.

Beterggz is dé innovatieve online specialist in de specialistische GGZ, waar we landelijk poliklinische behandelingen aanbieden. Ons behandelteam, bestaande uit psychologen, artsen en psychiaters, werkt nauw samen om cliënten met een complexe zorgvraag de beste zorg te bieden. Wij geloven in een vernieuwende aanpak gebaseerd op bewezen resultaten en zetten ons in om wachtlijsten te verkorten. Ook al werken we op verschillende locaties of zelfs in verschillende landen, we delen samen één missie: de geestelijke gezondheidszorg verbeteren en de lange wachtlijsten aanpakken!

Als arts maak je deel uit van het multidisciplinaire team. Je onderzoekt en begeleidt cliënten met psychische en gedragsproblemen. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in de behandeling van onze patiënten.

  • Je houdt je bezig met intakes en psycho-diagnostisch onderzoek.

  • Je denkt samen met jouw collega’s na over de ontwikkeling van het behandelbeleid en de kwaliteit van zorg, waarbij jouw inbreng wordt gewaardeerd.

  • Je draagt de verantwoordelijkheid voor tijdige en adequate rapportage;

  • Je indiceert medische behandeling en onderzoek binnen de mogelijkheden van de behandeldoelstelling.

Requirements

Wie ben jij?
Jij bent een enthousiaste en betrokken arts met de volgende kwalificaties:

  • Je bent geregistreerd als arts volgens de wet BIG.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met een brede generalistische visie binnen de SGGZ.

  • Je bent proactief en hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden.

  • Je bent flexibel en kunt goed in teamverband werken.

  • Je registreert nauwkeurig je verrichtingen en bent stipt in je werk.

  • Je spreekt goed Nederlands en Engels.

Je komt terecht in een platte, informele organisatie waar collegialiteit hoog in het vaandel staat. Er is weinig hiërarchie en veel ruimte voor eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Bij ons werk je niet alleen snel, vriendelijk en effectief, maar ook in een sfeer waar jouw ideeën gewaardeerd worden. We kunnen een arbeidsovereenkomst aanbieden, ook al woon je in het buitenland! Dit biedt jou de kans om werk en leven op een flexibele manier te combineren en tegelijkertijd bij te dragen aan de geestelijke gezondheidszorg in Nederland.

Je wordt ingeschaald in schaal 65 volgens de CAO GGZ.

  • Sales skills and abilities in establishing customer relationships, making presentations, and closing service support sales opportunities.

Summary

Estamos buscando un Mecánico Automotriz capacitado y confiable para unirse a nuestro equipo. El puesto implica diagnosticar, reparar y realizar mantenimiento rutinario en automóviles y camiones ligeros. El candidato ideal tendrá experiencia utilizando herramientas de diagnóstico, realizando reparaciones y asegurándose de que todo el trabajo cumpla con los estándares de seguridad de la industria. Además, el mecánico brindará soporte a los clientes tanto en persona como a través de consultas remotas o virtuales, asesorando sobre reparaciones necesarias o mantenimiento preventivo, asegurando que los vehículos operen al máximo rendimiento y manteniendo una documentación detallada de los servicios realizados para respaldar interacciones tanto en el taller como virtuales. Los candidatos deben contar con un teléfono inteligente moderno con conexión activa a Internet para gestionar eficientemente pedidos y asignaciones a través de la aplicación de la empresa. Es esencial tener habilidades en el manejo de aplicaciones móviles, plataformas digitales y flujos de trabajo basados en aplicaciones para una ejecución y comunicación fluidas.

La compensación varía entre $37,440 y $58,240 por año, según la experiencia y la disponibilidad.

Job Specifics

  • Diagnosticar automóviles y camiones ligeros utilizando herramientas de diagnóstico modernas.
  • Realizar reparaciones en sistemas de vehículos como motores, frenos, transmisiones y componentes eléctricos.
  • Llevar a cabo tareas de mantenimiento rutinario, como cambios de aceite, rotación de neumáticos, verificación de fluidos y reemplazo de filtros.
  • Asegurarse de que todas las reparaciones y mantenimientos cumplan con los estándares de seguridad de la industria y las especificaciones del fabricante.
  • Comunicarte con los clientes para ofrecer consejos sobre mantenimiento preventivo y cuidado del vehículo.
  • Mantener registros precisos de todas las reparaciones, mantenimientos y trabajos de diagnóstico realizados.
  • Mantener un entorno de trabajo limpio y organizado, siguiendo los protocolos de seguridad.

Qualifications and Experience


Qualifications

  • Diploma de escuela secundaria o equivalente (GED).
  • Más de 2 años de experiencia en reparación automotriz, específicamente con automóviles y camiones ligeros.
  • Dominio del uso de herramientas de diagnóstico y realización de reparaciones básicas en vehículos.

Experience

  • Certificación ASE (Automotive Service Excellence).
  • Más de 3 años de experiencia en reparación automotriz, con un enfoque en automóviles y camiones ligeros.
  • Experiencia en técnicas avanzadas de diagnóstico y solución de problemas.
  • Habilidades sólidas de comunicación para interacciones con clientes y asesoramiento en servicios.

Our innovative approach to remote mechanic jobs is reshaping the industry, offering unparalleled opportunities for skilled professionals like you. By joining our team, you'll be at the forefront of this revolution, leveraging cutting-edge technology to provide expert services from anywhere. With flexible schedules and the ability to work remotely, you'll enjoy greater freedom and autonomy in your career. Plus, our commitment to inclusivity ensures that every team member is valued and supported. At our organization, we're on a mission to revolutionize the opportunities available in the mechanic industry by pioneering remote mechanic jobs. We believe that skilled mechanics shouldn't be limited by traditional brick-and-mortar settings but should have the flexibility to work remotely, leveraging technology to provide expert services wherever they're needed. By embracing remote work, we're empowering mechanics to optimize their schedules, reduce commuting time, and expand their reach to serve clients beyond geographical boundaries. Company Description
Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private, and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. We look for people our clients and assignees can count on to thoughtfully deliver clear solutions to complex problems.

To be the best in the business, we cultivate a dynamic, highly collaborative culture that fuels the growth of our people. We invite you to inquire boldly, learn deeply, and grow endlessly with us. You’ll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way.

Job Description

As a Proposal Specialist you will support Pursuit Strategists and Proposal Managers in developing, coordinating, and delivering high-quality client proposals across strategic and competitive pursuits. You will serve as a key contributor across coordination and content development; ensuring every submission is client-focused and aligned with our firm’s services and value proposition.

This role requires strong writing and editing capability, disciplined follow-through, and effective collaboration with subject matter experts (SMEs), delivery leaders, and commercial teams. The role is delivery-oriented ensuring proposals are accurate, compliant, well-written, and submitted on time.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:


Daily Core Activities

  • Support Proposal Managers by reviewing new RFPs/proposal requests and breaking down requirements, deadlines and deliverables
  • Draft and tailor proposal content, including executive summaries, service overviews, methodologies, bios, and case studies, using content libraries and templated assets.
  • Edit and refine inputs from subject matter experts (SMEs) to ensure clarity, consistency, and client ready language
  • Apply proposal writing best practices to improve structure, readability, and responsiveness to client requirements
  • Load RFPs and proposal materials into the proposal automation platform and ensure projects are set up correctly
  • Maintain proposal timelines, task assignments, and status updates within the proposal tool
  • Coordinate day-to-day proposal activity, tracking inputs, sending reminders, and managing follow-ups
  • Create and maintain shared working folders and ensure documents are accurately version controlled
  • Support collaboration across contributors by managing working drafts and consolidating inputs

Additional Responsibilities (Weekly/Ad Hoc)

  • Support proposal kick-off sessions, check-in meetings, and oral prep calls by preparing materials, documenting actions, and tracking follow-ups
  • Perform compliance and completeness checks against RFP instructions prior to review and submission
  • Support proposal submission activities, including uploads to client portals where required
  • Assist with post-submission administration, including archiving materials and updating proposal records
  • Identify recurring content and process issues and escalate to the Proposal Manager or Content Manager

Qualifications

  • 2+ years’ experience in proposal writing, editing and bid support in a professional services, consulting, or B2B environment
  • Excellent written English, with the ability to edit, simplify, and tailor content to different client audiences
  • High attention to detail and strong document management skills
  • Familiarity with proposal structures, formal RFP responses, and portals like Ariba, Jaggaer, or SAP
  • Proficient in MS Word, PowerPoint, Adobe, and document formatting best practices
  • Experience using tools like Loopio, Responsive, and SharePoint
  • Proficient using AI in day-to-day work, especially Copilot and Claude

Key Attributes for Success

  • Execution focused with a strong sense of ownership for assigned tasks
  • Meticulous attention to detail with a focus on quality
  • Able to work to direction and deliver consistently under time pressure
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks simultaneously

Why This Role?

  • Play a pivotal role in winning new business for a fast-growing global services firm.
  • Work closely with leadership and experts on high-impact, global opportunities.
  • Develop deep expertise in proposal writing and editing within a growing proposal environment.
  • Opportunities for advancement into senior pursuits, bid strategy, or commercial operations roles.

Position: Procurement Manager

Location: US (Remote)

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8-5pm PST

Job Type: 6-month W2 contract

***This is a remote 6-month W2 contract with one of our tech clients***

About the Role:

Our client is looking for a remote-based Senior Procurement Manager to support their internal business teams with SaaS software contract rationalization and negotiation. Ensuring that their teams have the items they need to perform at their best is key to their success, and they're looking for someone who can partner with those teams to develop strategies to support them with existing or new vendors. You will partner with internal teams to ensure that vendor requests meet their requirements to ensure security and privacy of information along with meeting their legal requirements. This role will also represent the company in discussions with their vendors to ensure that they are maintaining those key partnerships and effectively managing the negotiations with them. You will play a key role in building and sustaining their vendor relationships while driving savings and value for their internal business partners.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • You will be empowered to negotiate incoming contracts focusing on technology products (IaaS, SaaS, and PaaS) to secure advantageous terms.
  • Dive deep on our software and technology platforms to understand usage, cost drivers, and ROI to serve as a trusted advisor to internal teams related to procurement of those tools.
  • Partner with internal teams to develop strategies for upcoming renewals or establish requirements for new technology needs.
  • Source and engage reliable suppliers and vendors by providing RFI and RFP support to internal stakeholders as needed.
  • Partner with IT, Legal and Security to ensure terms are consistent with legal, regulatory, data security, and privacy requirements.
  • Assist with vendor qualification and onboarding processes.
  • Assist in driving and identifying potential cost savings.

Requirements

Your Background:

  • 8+ years in a technical procurement role

• SaaS experience required

  • Self-starting, enthusiastic, entrepreneurial attitude
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with diverse groups
  • Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills with experience driving six-figure, multi-year contracts to completion
  • Solid interpersonal and rapport building abilities
  • Strong time management and planning skills required to coordinate and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously while adapting to changes in business requirements
  • Technically savvy, including a demonstrated high level of proficiency in core SaaS technologies and trends
  • Familiarity with Zip and Ironclad a plus
  • Ability to demonstrate a strategic mindset to enable persuasive value conversations with vendors at an executive level
  • Strong operational business understanding of technology supply chain, including purchase ordering, expense reporting, procurement/sourcing, provisioning and reclamation, renewals, and contract management

Benefits

Compensation: $60-$64/hr

raw.title: Registered Nurse (RN) - Bilingual (Korean - English)
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Registered Nurse (RN) to join our team as a Telehealth Medicare Annual Wellness Visit Specialist - PRN.
raw.description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Registered Nurse (RN) to join our team as a Telehealth Medicare Annual Wellness Visit Specialist - PRN. In this remote role, you will be responsible for conducting Medicare Annual Wellness Visits (AWVs) via telehealth under the direct supervision of a physician. This position focuses on preventive healthcare, patient education, and the assessment of individual health risks, all conducted through virtual platforms to promote better health outcomes for our Medicare population.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Conducting Medicare Annual Wellness Visits via telehealth in accordance with CMS guidelines, ensuring all required assessments and screenings are completed.
  • Virtually reviewing and updating patient medical histories, including medication lists, immunization records, and family history.
  • Assessing patients’ current health status, including vital signs when available, cognitive function, and risk factors for chronic diseases, utilizing remote monitoring tools when applicable.
  • Providing patient education on preventive measures, lifestyle changes, and available community resources to promote overall health and well-being through virtual consultations.
  • Developing and updating personalized prevention plans based on individual patient needs and physician guidance.
  • Collaborating with the supervising physician to ensure accurate documentation and follow-up on any identified health concerns using electronic health record systems.
  • Identifying any HCC codes requiring recapture reporting to CMS.
  • Maintaining comprehensive and accurate patient records in compliance with HIPAA and organizational standards, particularly in a remote environment.
  • Facilitating virtual referrals to appropriate healthcare services and specialists as needed.
  • Monitoring patient progress and adherence to personalized prevention plans, providing support and making adjustments as necessary through telehealth follow-ups.
  • Staying current on Medicare guidelines, telehealth best practices, preventive care practices, and chronic disease management strategies.
  • Participating in virtual team meetings, training sessions, and continuing education to maintain and enhance clinical skills.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED FOR SUCCESS

  • Must be fully bi-lingual in Korean and English languages.
  • Must be located in GA.
  • Current and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of GA.
  • Availability for PRN work Monday through Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm, aproxametly 20 hours per week.
  • Minimum of 3 years of patient care nursing experience, preferably in a primary care, preventive care, or telehealth setting.
  • Experience with Medicare Annual Wellness Visits (AWVs) and telehealth platforms is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of Medicare guidelines, telehealth practices, and preventive care strategies preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to educate and engage patients effectively in a virtual environment.
  • Proficient in electronic health records (EHR) systems, telehealth technology, and remote medical documentation.
  • Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a remote work setting.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

The salary range for this role is $42/hour (PRN) plus language differential

ALIVE with Purpose: How We Thrive at Guidehealth

At Guidehealth, our values come to life in everything we do.

  • We are Driven by Accountability — grounded in transparency, reliability, and integrity as we navigate challenges and opportunities alike.
  • Always Growing, Always Learning — staying curious and continuously improving inspires us to shape a better future for healthcare.
  • With Collaborative Innovation, we solve problems creatively, making every experience better for our employees and the patients we serve.
  • At Guidehealth, Every Voice Matters — we believe our collective strength is rooted in the unique perspectives of each team member.
  • And through Empathy in Action, we build stronger connections with those who count on us.
  • This is what it means to be ALIVE with purpose. This is how we thrive — together — at Guidehealth.

BENEFITS:

While you are hard at work advancing value-based healthcare, we are here to ensure YOU have the care you and your family need and the opportunities for growth and development. Our commitments to you include:

  • Work from Home: Guidehealth is a fully remote company, providing you the flexibility to spend less time commuting and more time focusing on your professional goals and personal needs.
  • Keep Health a Priority: We offer comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans to keep you covered.
  • Plan for the Future: Our 401(k) plan includes a 3% employer match to your 6% contribution.
  • Have Peace of Mind: We provide Life and Disability insurance for those "just in case" moments. Additionally, we offer voluntary Life options to keep you and your loved ones protected.
  • Feel Supported When You Need It Most: Our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) is here to help you through tough times.
  • Take Time for Yourself: We offer paid time off plans helping you achieve work-life balance and meet your personal goals.
  • Support Your New Family: Welcoming a new family member takes time and commitment. Guidehealth offers paid parental leave to give you the time you need.
  • Learn and Grow: Your professional growth is important to us. Guidehealth offers various resources dedicated to your learning and development to advance your career with us.

All full-time employees of Guidehealth who work 30 hours per week or more are eligible for our comprehensive benefits package. Temporary employees and contractors are not eligible for benefits.

COMPENSATION:

The listed compensation range listed is paid bi-weekly per our standard payroll practices. Final base pay decisions are dependent upon a variety of factors which may include, but are not limited to: skill set, years of relevant experience, education, location, and licensure/certifications.

OUR COMMITMENT TO EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYMENT

Diversity, inclusion, and belonging are at the core of Guidehealth’s values. We are an equal opportunity employer. We enthusiastically accept our responsibility to make employment decisions without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation and identity, national origin, citizenship, religion, marital status, familial status, physical, sensory, or medical disability, Family and Medical Leave, military or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth or other related medical conditions, or any other classification protected by federal, state, and local laws and ordinances. Our management is fully dedicated to ensuring the fulfillment of this policy with respect to hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, termination, recruitment advertising, pay, and other forms of compensation, training, and general treatment during employment. 

OUR COMITTMENT TO PROTECTION OF PATIENT AND COMPANY DATA

This position is responsible for following all Security policies and procedures in order to protect all PHI and PII under Guidehealth’s custodianship as well as Guidehealth Intellectual Properties. For any security-specific roles, the responsibilities would be further defined by the hiring manager.

As a remote-first organization handling sensitive healthcare data, Guidehealth verifies candidate identity at multiple stages of the hiring and onboarding to safeguard patient privacy, data security, and compliance requirements.

REMOTE WORK TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Guidehealth is a fully remote company. We provide new employees with the necessary equipment to function in their role at no charge to the employee. Employees provide their own internet connection, capable of conducting video calls on camera and connecting to various internal and external systems. The required internet speed is a minimum of 100 mbps download, 10 mbps upload. Please run a speed test here to confirm your internet connection meets these requirements.

SECONDARY EMPLOYMENT

At Guidehealth, we value transparency and collaboration as part of our commitment to excellence. As your primary employer, we kindly ask all team members to disclose any secondary employment, regardless of whether it may present a potential conflict of interest.

To ensure smooth teamwork and availability, employees must be accessible during our stated working hours. We foster connection and engagement by asking team members to join virtual meetings with their cameras on.

WHO IS GUIDEHEALTH?

Guidehealth is a data-powered, performance-driven healthcare company dedicated to operational excellence. Our goal is to make great healthcare affordable, improve the health of patients, and restore the fulfillment of practicing medicine for providers. Driven by empathy and powered by AI and predictive analytics, Guidehealth leverages remotely-embedded Healthguides™ and a centralized Managed Service Organization to build stronger connections with patients and providers. Physician-led, Guidehealth empowers our partners to deliver high-quality healthcare focused on outcomes and value inside and outside the exam room for all patients. 

Join us as we put healthcare on a better path!!

raw.title: Field Clinical Specialist - West
raw.excerpt: ABOUT ORGANOX:OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure.
raw.description:
ABOUT ORGANOX:

OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543) strives to fulfill its mission of “Contributing to Society through Healthcare” by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

Position Summary

The Clinical Specialist will be primarily responsible for training and supporting users of our products. This includes teaching and training users in the correct manner to ensure our products are used safely and effectively - both for the preservation of organs prior to transplant, and for various clinical and non-clinical research studies. The role of Clinical Specialist will involve global travel, primarily within North America, visiting leading sites of transplantation surgery. This means the Clinical Specialist will be required to work after business hours, including nights, weekends and some very long days, which is the norm due to the unpredictable nature of organ donation and transplantation.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

  • Train and support organ retrieval and transplant teams in the use of the OrganOx metra according to OrganOx’s policies and procedures.
  • Generally, on-call 24/7 for about 15 days a month (including holidays and weekends) for remote and onsite support.
  • Organize Site Initiation & Refresher Visits, training sessions (in person and remote) and centralized training events.
  • Effective and timely communication with transplant teams, internal management and coworkers.
  • Create and write case study review with guidance for senior colleagues.
  • When not on call, the clinical specialist will support managers, directors and other internal staff in various assignments, either remotely or onsite.
  • May participate in R&D activities in lab settings under the direction of management.
  • Work with the liver transplant teams to collect data on livers perfused and preserved on the metra to build up a database of product performance and use.
  • Ensure vendor credentialing requirements are current and able to pass routine background checks and drug screens.
  • Attend local, regional, national, and international meetings and conferences, in person or virtually, on behalf of OrganOx as a supporter, participant, or presenter as needed.
  • Develop and maintain positive working relationships in connection with end users of all levels.
  • Perform administrative tasks related to expenses, email, and other communication activities.
  • Ensure personal understanding of all quality policy/system items that are personally applicable.
  • Follow all work/quality procedures to ensure quality system compliance and high-quality work.
  • Other duties as assigned by Director of Clinical Support.

Requirements

Essential Requirements:

  • BS degree in combination with equivalent medical experience, with 3+ years’ experience in ICU, ECMO, Cath Lab, OR, Transplant, and ED
  • Regardless of professional background, must possess the following qualifications:
  • Must be highly flexible and willing to support sites as needed within and across North America
  • Must be detail oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills; able to work collaboratively and build rapport with internal and external contacts
  • Excellent customer facing skills.
  • Ability to work calmly and professionally under pressure
  • Must be able to enthusiastically work at fast pace in dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities
  • Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint proficiency

Preferred Requirements:

  • A licensed RN, RT, RD and/or a health science-related degree
  • Industry experience in pharmaceutical or medical device

Other Qualifications:

  • Travel: Must be able to travel up to 50% of the time for training, investigator meetings, monitoring responsibilities, corporate meetings, and educational seminars.
  • Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk, hear, and speak. The position may require sitting for significant periods of the day while working on the computer. The employee must occasionally lift or move items weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Work Environment: This is a work-from-anywhere, remote job wherein meetings and collaborations can occur across multiple time zones.
  • Work Accessibility: Must live within an hour of a major airport.

A job description does not imply that the duties stated are the only ones to be performed by the job holder. Job holder will be required to follow any other job-related instruction as reasonably requested by their line manager or their designate.

Benefits

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits available from day one, including health, dental, vision, disability coverage, and flexible spending accounts. Additionally, we offer a 401(k)-retirement plan with company matching after 90 days, paid time off, holidays, and additional leave benefits, as well as employee discounts and access to our onsite wellness facility. OrganOx supports work-life balance and provides opportunities for ongoing professional development.

warum wir?

Compensation: $176K–$228K base | $220K–$285K OTE + meaningful equity
Visa: H-1B transfers and TN visas sponsored; O-1 considered case-by-case


About the Role

We’re hiring an AI Field Engineer / Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our AI’s high-velocity team

You’ll work directly with ambitious AI-native companies to turn complex AI challenges into production-ready systems. This is a highly hands-on role sitting at the intersection of AI engineering, product, and customer delivery.

You’ll build POCs, MVPs, and production integrations while working directly with customers, account executives, and engineering teams. You’ll also engage with technical and executive stakeholders to discuss architecture, strategy, and business outcomes.

This is not a traditional consulting or solutions role you’ll be hands-on-keyboard, writing code, deploying systems, solving technical problems, and contributing directly to our products and platform.

What You’ll Do

  • Work directly with customers to understand their technical and business challenges.

  • Design and build POCs, MVPs, and production AI applications.

  • Deploy and optimize LLM and generative AI workloads in production.

  • Work with open-source models, inference infrastructure, and AI/ML platforms.

  • Collaborate with customer engineering teams, account executives, and Fireworks product/engineering teams.

  • Translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions.

  • Troubleshoot complex AI, infrastructure, and deployment challenges.

  • Communicate technical architecture and tradeoffs to both engineers and executive stakeholders.

  • Contribute code and product improvements directly to the codebase.

  • Turn customer learnings into product feedback and help shape our roadmap.

  • Take ownership of projects from initial discovery through production deployment.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for engineers who combine strong technical depth with excellent customer-facing skills.

You may come from backgrounds such as:

  • Forward Deployed Engineer

  • AI/ML Engineer

  • Applied AI Engineer

  • AI Solutions Engineer

  • Solutions Architect

  • Sales Engineer

  • Customer Engineer

  • ML/AI Infrastructure Engineer

  • Customer Success Engineer with strong technical depth


Required

  • 3–10 years of experience in a client-facing technical or AI/ML engineering role.

  • Strong Python programming skills.

  • Experience building and deploying AI/ML or generative AI applications.

  • Experience working with LLMs and/or open-source AI models.

  • Ability to work directly with customers and communicate technical concepts clearly.

  • Experience building POCs and taking solutions toward production.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.

  • Willingness to work hands-on across engineering, customer delivery, and product.


Technical Experience

Experience with some of the following is highly relevant:

  • Python

  • vLLM

  • SGLang

  • TensorRT-LLM

  • Kubernetes

  • AWS, Azure, or GCP

  • AWS Bedrock / SageMaker

  • Azure AI Foundry

  • GCP Vertex AI

  • LLM fine-tuning, including SFT, DPO, or RFT

  • GPU infrastructure

  • Model inference and optimization

You do not need experience with every technology listed, but you should have strong fundamentals in AI/ML engineering and be comfortable learning quickly.


Why Join?

  • Work directly with cutting-edge AI companies.

  • Build real AI systems that move from prototype to production.

  • Work across engineering, product, and customer delivery.

  • Contribute directly to an AI infrastructure platform.

  • Join a highly technical, builder-first team.

  • Competitive compensation of $220K–$285K OTE + meaningful equity.

  • US visa support including H-1B transfers and TN visas.
