raw.title: Director, Email & Lifecycle Marketing
raw.excerpt: About the RoleAt BenefitHub, we connect millions of members across 22 markets with perks and benefits that make life a little better.
raw.description:
About the Role

At BenefitHub, we connect millions of members across 22 markets with perks and benefits that make life a little better. Email is central to how we engage our members and drive results for our advertising and merchant partners—and this role runs that engine.

We’re seeking a highly hands-on Director of Email & Lifecycle Marketing who lives and breathes newsletter strategy, deliverability, engagement, and monetization. This is a true player-coach role: you’ll shape the strategy, but you’ll also be in the work—building campaigns, solving problems, analyzing performance, testing, optimizing, and jumping in wherever needed, while leading a high-performing team.

You’ll own a high-volume program of 40+ campaigns per week plus automated lifecycle journeys, partnering closely with internal marketing stakeholders, Ad Sales and Merchant teams—advising on best practices and turning sold inventory and placements into engaging, effective campaigns. As a strategic right hand to the VP of Global Marketing, you’ll balance commercial performance with a great member experience while continuously pushing the program forward.

If you’re a hands-on email leader who wants to take a strong, high-volume program and make it even better—sharper targeting, cleaner deliverability, and more value for members and partners alike—we’d love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

Newsletter Excellence, Monetization, and Partner Performance

  • Execute the newsletter program as a high-performing media channel, optimizing how sponsored placements and commissionable offers are delivered to drive strong, defensible performance for our partners while protecting the member experience.
  • Serve as the email and newsletter expert to Ad Sales and the Merchant team, advising on inventory, placement, and campaign best practices and bringing data-backed recommendations that improve monetization to the teams responsible for what is sold and placed.
  • Report program and placement performance credibly to partners and leadership, using defensible, trustworthy metrics.
  • Own the execution and performance of every campaign, translating results into best-practice guidance and recommendations that help Ad Sales, Merchant, and Marketing teams improve outcomes over time.
  • Propose and, once approved, execute the global (22-market) newsletter strategy and roadmap, balancing send volume and frequency with engagement and long-term list health. Translate the strategy into a market-by-market campaign and inventory calendar used cross-functionally by Ad Sales, the Merchant team, and Marketing.

Campaign Execution and Deliverability Excellence

  • Oversee a full portfolio of concurrent campaigns—from planning through send and post-send analysis.
  • Build, QA, schedule, and deploy newsletter and email campaigns in our ESP, personally and through your team.
  • Manage dynamic, catalog-driven offer placement and per-segment/per-client targeting and suppression at scale.
  • Develop mobile-first templates flexible enough to A/B test any element, refreshed quarterly on performance, best practices, and trends; run an ongoing testing program across offers, segmentation, timing, and creative.
  • Own inbox placement, sender reputation, and deliverability across multiple sending domains and markets—IP/domain warm-up, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), list hygiene, audience data quality, and feedback loops—monitored with tools such as Validity/Everest, Google Postmaster Tools, and Microsoft SNDS.
  • Serve as the internal expert on deliverability best practices and mailbox-provider requirements.

Engagement, Lifecycle, and Product Campaigns

  • Balance commercial goals with a great member experience, delivering the right offer to the right member to drive discovery, clicks, and purchase activity.
  • Own audience segmentation and personalization by market, client, and member behavior, matching messaging and placements to the right audiences with a focus on engagement and deliverability, while ensuring client settings are always respected.
  • Design and run lifecycle and behavior-based journeys—activation, welcome, re-engagement, and win-back—to grow engagement and long-term value while reducing churn.
  • Own a smaller but strategically important set of product marketing and go-to-market sends that grow adoption of BenefitHub’s own products and verticals (e.g., home and auto insurance, the browser extension), in partnership with Marketing stakeholders.

Performance, Team, and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Define and track KPIs across performance, engagement, deliverability, and lifecycle—including weekly reporting on open rate, CTR, CTOR, and sender reputation—and lead regular performance updates to marketing leadership, the executive team, and the broader company on results, trends, and priorities, adjusting based on data.
  • Ensure advertiser- and partner-facing metrics are accurate and defensible, with an awareness of non-human/invalid traffic (bots, scanners, prefetch) and its impact on reported performance, partnering with analytics to mitigate it.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a growing team of email marketers and email marketing specialists responsible for executing our newsletter, email marketing, and journey programs.
  • Oversee, own, and continuously improve the operating framework for intake, QA, approvals, and reporting for efficiency and clear cross-departmental communication.
  • Manage vendor relationships (ESP, CDP, and deliverability tools) and act as a key stakeholder in ESP strategy, capabilities, and any platform evaluation or migration.
  • Ensure compliance with email and privacy regulations across our markets (e.g., CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR), and own consent, subscription, and preference management.

What You Bring—Required

  • 9+ years of hands-on email, CRM, or lifecycle marketing in a high-volume program, including monetizing a newsletter or email audience through sponsored placements and/or commissionable/affiliate revenue.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in email deliverability, compliance, and reputation management (IP/domain warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, list hygiene, mailbox-provider relations).
  • Hands-on mastery of a major enterprise ESP and CDP / marketing-automation stack—our current stack includes Iterable and Lytics—across segmentation, dynamic content, automation, lifecycle journeys, behavioral targeting, and reporting.
  • Proven success managing and developing a high-performing team.
  • Strong command of segmentation, personalization, automation workflows, triggered campaigns, and A/B testing methodologies.
  • Advanced knowledge of marketing analytics, attribution modeling, and performance measurement, building KPIs and dashboards and translating performance data into insights for partners and executives—with the judgment to distinguish genuine engagement from invalid traffic.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

What Sets You Apart—Preferred

  • Background at an ecommerce, marketplace, perks/benefits, affiliate, deals, or media/ad-monetization company (e.g., PerkSpot, EBG / Perks at Work, LifeMart, Rakuten, Groupon, RetailMeNot, or similar).
  • Understanding of the HR, benefits, and employee-engagement landscape.
  • Experience with multi-tenant programs, product-marketing/GTM email, global multi-market programs, and evaluating or migrating ESPs.

Benefits include:

  • Medical and Dental (employer pays 75% of monthly contributions)
  • Telehealth (employer paid 100%)
  • Vision insurance (employer pays 100% of monthly contributions)
  • Domestic partner coverage for all insurance plans
  • 100% employer-paid life insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan options, including employer contribution
  • Generous paid time off (PTO)
  • Generous sick time off (STO) program
  • Generous paid paternity and maternity leave policies
  • 11 holidays, including office closed the day after Thanksgiving
  • Flexible spending account program
  • Voluntary benefit programs (STD, LTD, life insurance, accident, cancer)

About BenefitHub

BenefitHub is the premier employee lifestyle benefits platform, connecting millions of employees with exclusive discounts, rewards, and perks. Our mission is to enhance the lives of employees worldwide while helping organizations attract, retain, and engage top talent through meaningful benefits.

Manager of Efficacy and Learning Research

Location: Remote US--Must live and work with in US.

Job Overview:


The Manager of Efficacy and Learning Research is a core strategic leader and member of the R&D leadership team at ExploreK12. This is a team that seeks empirical answers to crucial questions such as: are all students succeeding? under what conditions? How do we best communicate our ROI to stakeholders? What improvements should we make to our products and services to optimize student success? As a key cross-functional partner, this role drives the vision and execution of research across the organization.


This position will work in close collaboration with the SVP, Product Strategy to set the research roadmap for ExploreK12. The Manager will collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product Management, Data Analytics, Learning Experience Design, UX/UI Design, Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, Growth Marketing, and Customer Success to scope and lead research projects that generate actionable insights to guide product development, validate product effectiveness, and support sales and marketing efforts with compelling, evidence-based impact stories. This position also manages and mentors a growing team of researchers, developing efficient systems for research execution and impact across the company.


Qualified candidates will have deep expertise in designing, conducting and supervising education research and the demonstrated ability to successfully implement innovative studies to address strategic research objectives. This position calls for an education research expert with the abilities to think strategically, delegate responsibility, and communicate effectively.

Job Responsibilities:


Strategic Research Leadership

  • Define and lead the company-wide research roadmap in alignment with product, sales, and marketing goals.
  • Serve as the central research point of contact for internal stakeholders, scoping research needs and translating them into high-impact studies.
  • Ensure that research efforts deliver clear value to internal teams and external audiences by turning data into compelling, actionable insights.
  • Represent the research team in cross-functional planning, contributing research-informed perspectives to strategic decisions across the business.

Project Management

  • Oversee all phases of research, including the design, planning, and execution of research projects that assess product efficacy, inform product design, and identify key conditions for success.
  • Simultaneously manage several complex research projects from conception to completion.
  • Ensure that research projects are conducted with methodological rigor and in alignment with industry standards, privacy laws, and internal priorities.
  • Develop and refine efficient research processes, timelines, and reporting systems to support research scalability.
  • Oversee technical outputs and provide hands-on support for study design, data collection, analysis, and reporting.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, manage and grow a high-performing team of researchers to execute on strategic priorities.
  • Provide mentorship, coaching, and professional development support tailored to each team member’s career goals and growth areas.
  • Guide resource allocation and task delegation across team members to meet strategic priorities efficiently.

Organizational Thought Leadership

  • Collaborate with Marketing to translate research findings into accessible formats (e.g., blog posts, infographics, talking points, whitepapers) for external audiences.
  • Represent ExploreK12’s research at conferences, webinars, and industry events, contributing to our visibility as a leader in edtech efficacy.
  • Proactively identify gaps and opportunities in how research is integrated into product, sales, and customer success strategies.

Job Requirements:


  • Proven track record of designing and leading impactful education research studies in the U.S. K-12 EdTech industry..
  • 5+ years of experience in education research, data science, or analytics, preferably in applied or industry settings.
  • Deep expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodology, including study design, recruitment and data collection, and data interpretation.
  • Excellent analytic skills, including expertise in statistical analysis and experience using tools for statistical analysis (SPSS, SAS, Python, or R)
  • Demonstrated success turning research into actionable insights for cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Exemplary project management, organizational, and prioritization skills
  • Exceptional collaborative mindset and interpersonal skills to work across product, marketing, and sales functions.
  • Excellent communication and writing skills for both technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience with experimental design or program evaluation in the context of education or learning sciences and/or in EdTech
  • Experience working closely with cross-functional teams, including product, marketing, sales, and customer success
  • Experience working with external research partners or firms
  • Experience with learning analytics, educational data mining, and/or evidence-centered design
  • Track record of building systems that scale research insights across product and customer touchpoints.
  • Master’s degree in education, learning sciences, social science, or closely related field; PhD degree

Why Work for Us

When you join ExploreK12™, you become part of a mission to help educators unlock brighter futures for every student.


As a trusted leader in educational technology, we serve more than 17 million students and educators across 150+ countries with innovative, research-backed learning solutions that truly make a difference. Our flagship products—Gizmos™, Raz-Plus®, and Reflex™—are beloved by educators and students alike for being as practical and effective as they are fun.


To learn more about our organization and the exciting work we do, visit .


Remote First Work Environment

Our Remote First approach gives employees the flexibility and trust they need to effectively balance work with life. It creates a culture in which all employees are valued and where success is measured in results. It allows us to work collaboratively, inclusively and for greater positive impact, regardless of our individual locations.


If you will be working remotely, either occasionally or on a permanent basis, you must have a reliable internet connection through a cable or fiber-optic broadband service with minimum speeds of 10 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload.


The successful candidate will be expected to actively participate in video-based interviews during the recruiting process and ongoing virtual meetings with their camera on, as part of their role. To maintain confidentiality and ensure a fair evaluation process, the use of note-taking tools, reference materials, or AI-powered tools (including generative AI, language models, or similar technologies) during interviews or other selection activities is prohibited unless prior written approval has been obtained from the People Experience team. If you require an exception for medical, accessibility, or other reasons, please contact your Talent Acquisition team member to discuss accommodations in advance.


As part of our Remote-First benefits, Cambium offers reimbursement to help cover the cost of setting up your home or remote office.


An Equal Opportunity Employer

We are dedicated to fostering a culture that celebrates unique backgrounds, ideas, and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, age, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender, gender identity/expression, or sexual orientation), national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or genetic information (including family medical history).


We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. You may request an accommodation during the recruiting process with your Talent Acquisition team member.

Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning

At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, PepsiCo, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB InBev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.

We are seeking an experienced Principal Supply Chain Data Scientist with deep technical mastery in time series forecasting and predictive analytics to join our US Delivery & Solutions team. In this role, you will lead the customer implementations including the architecture, design/development, and deployment of state-of-the-art forecasting and demand sensing algorithms that drive multi-billion-dollar supply chain decisions for Fortune 500 clients.


What you’ll do for us

  • Technical Leadership & Delivery: Lead the end-to-end discovery, architectural design, prototyping, testing, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI/ML models (e.g., demand sensing, stochastic modeling, inventory and revenue optimization).
  • Strategic Client Partnership: Work directly with enterprise clients, solution architects, and executive stakeholders to translate complex supply chain challenges into high-value machine learning solutions.
  • Team Development: Mentor and guide cross-functional teams of data scientists and analytics consultants, maintaining high coding standards, modular design, and MLOps best practices.
  • AI Innovation: Leverage the latest advancements in GenAI, deep learning, time-series forecasting, and mathematical optimization to drive continuous product and client success.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with data engineering and project management teams to integrate custom analytical models seamlessly into the o9 Enterprise Knowledge Graph platform.

What you’ll have

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience in Data Science and Analytics with a proven track record as a technical lead delivering customer-facing solutions.
  • Education: Master’s or Ph.D. preferred (or Bachelor’s with equivalent experience) in Operations Research, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Analytics, Engineering, or Supply Chain.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of applied machine learning in supply chain planning (e.g., demand planning, price/assortment optimization, inventory management, or network optimization).
  • Technical Stack:
    • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.
    • Modern ML/DL frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn).
    • Scaled data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Spark, AWS/GCP/Azure).
    • Expertise in time-series analysis, mathematical optimization, ensemble methods, and neural networks.
  • Communication: Exceptional storytelling and stakeholder management skills; ability to articulate complex mathematical concepts to business executives.
This position at o9 Solutions has an annual salary range of $161,304-$221,792. Additionally, you may be eligible to participate in our medical, retirement, and other company-sponsored benefits.

**The above information reflects the expected base salary range, although the lower and upper bounds may vary based on location, skills, experience, certifications, licenses, or other relevant factors.

More about us…

At o9, transparency and open communication are at the core of our culture. Collaboration thrives across all levels—hierarchy, distance, or function never limit innovation or teamwork. Beyond work, we encourage volunteering opportunities, social impact initiatives, and diverse cultural celebrations.

With a $3.7 billion valuation and a global presence across Dallas, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Madrid, London, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, and Munich, o9 is among the fastest-growing technology companies in the world. Through our aim10x vision, we are committed to AI-powered management, driving 10x improvements in enterprise decision-making. Our Enterprise Knowledge Graph enables businesses to anticipate risks, adapt to market shifts, and gain real-time visibility. By automating millions of decisions and reducing manual interventions by up to 90%, we empower enterprises to drive profitable growth, reduce inefficiencies, and create lasting value.

o9 is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, ensuring a fair and unbiased hiring process. Join us as we continue our growth journey!

About Bauer Media Audio Ireland

Bauer Media Audio Ireland is the country’s largest commercial radio group, operating eight stations including national brands Today FM and Newstalk, alongside youth-focused SPIN stations in Dublin and the Southwest. The portfolio also includes iRadio across the Northeast and Northwest, 98FM in Dublin, Beat in the Southeast, and Red FM in Cork.

Beyond radio, Bauer Media Audio Ireland delivers a diverse and innovative audio offering. This includes Off the Ball, Ireland’s leading digital sports brand; GoLoud, a premium platform for radio, podcasts, and music; audioXi, the country’s largest digital audio advertising exchange; and Media Central, Ireland’s leading media sales house.

About the Role

We’re looking for a talented and reliable Freelance Imaging Producer to provide holiday cover for our audio/radio production team. The role involves creating high-quality station imaging, promos, sweepers and other branded audio assets that support the sound, identity and output of our brands. We’re after someone creative, dependable and easy to work with — someone who can quickly understand the sound of a brand, jump into an existing workflow and deliver slick, broadcast-ready audio.

This is a remote freelance opportunity, and we’re open to applications from candidates based in Ireland, the UK and further afield. You’ll be comfortable working independently, interpreting briefs quickly and delivering creative, polished and on-brand audio to tight deadlines.

This is an ad hoc holiday cover role, with work offered depending on team availability and production requirements. The successful candidate will need to be available during agreed cover periods and comfortable working to short turnaround times.

What You'll Do:

  • Produce station imaging, promos, trails, sweepers, IDs and other branded audio content.
  • Work from creative briefs and turn them into engaging audio that matches the station or brand tone.
  • Edit, mix and master audio to a professional broadcast standard.
  • Source and use music, sound design, effects and voiceover assets appropriately.
  • Liaise with producers, presenters, content teams and brand leads where required.
  • Manage workload efficiently during holiday cover periods, ensuring all deadlines are met.
  • Maintain consistency with existing station sound, branding and production guidelines.
  • Make quick amends based on feedback from stakeholders.
  • Ensure all produced content is technically suitable for broadcast and digital use.

What You'll Have:

  • Previous experience producing radio/audio imaging, promos or branded audio content.
  • Strong audio editing, mixing and sound design skills.
  • Confident using industry-standard production software such as Pro Tools.
  • Good understanding of radio station branding, tone of voice and audience targeting.
  • Ability to work quickly and accurately under deadline pressure.
  • Strong attention to detail, especially around levels, clarity, timing and compliance.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely if required.
  • Good communication skills and ability to take direction constructively.

Advantageous:

  • Experience working with commercial radio brands.
  • Access to own production setup and software.
  • Experience directing or working with voiceover artists.
  • Knowledge of broadcast compliance requirements.
  • Ability to write or polish short-form promo copy.

Ready to Apply?

Applicants should provide:

  • A short CV or summary of relevant experience.
  • 2 minute audio demo, with examples of work.
  • Details of availability.
  • Day rate or freelance rate expectations.
  • Confirmation of production software/equipment available.

The closing date for applications is 02 November 2026.

raw.description:
Who We Are + What We Do:

Booster is a mission-driven school fundraising company focused on cultivating virtuous leaders who want to change the world. Booster partners with over 6,000 schools each year and impacts over 3 million students across all 50 states. At the heart of our culture, our six virtues guide everything we do: Gratitude, Wisdom, Care, Courage, Grit, and Celebration. We deliver engaging, innovative, and active fundraising experiences for elementary and middle schools nationwide. From high-energy fun runs to all-in-one fundraising platforms and custom gear, we’ve helped schools raise over $1 billion for education. Booster is a fun, fast-paced, and purpose-filled place to work, where every day offers the opportunity to make a real impact in the lives of students and school communities.


Are You Booster’s Next Centralized Lead Qualifier?

As a Centralized Lead Qualifier on Booster’s Revenue team, you’ll help create a seamless experience for prospective customers while supporting several initiatives that help Booster reach and serve more schools.

You’ll be one of the first points of contact for inbound prospects—managing and qualifying leads, identifying the right Booster solution for their needs, and connecting qualified opportunities with the appropriate sales team. You’ll also support Commercial and MyBooster sales efforts, contribute to Booster’s social media presence, and help create resources that equip our Field Sales teams. This role is a great fit for someone who is an excellent communicator, highly organized, comfortable talking with prospective customers, and excited by a role that blends sales, relationship-building, administrative work, and creativity.

How You’ll Impact Booster’s Mission:

  • Manage and qualify inbound leads: Monitor incoming leads, filter non-sales inquiries, route opportunities to the appropriate owners, enter leads received through other channels, and maintain accurate information within our CRM.
  • Connect prospects with the right solution: Communicate with prospective customers through calls, texts, and emails to understand their needs, determine fit, schedule discovery meetings with Account Executives, and maintain engagement throughout the qualification process.
  • Redirect alternative opportunities: Develop an understanding of Booster’s broader products and solutions and help prospective clients who aren't a fit for our traditional program identify other potential options. Connect appropriate prospects with internal teams and potential pilot opportunities.
  • Support Commercial and MyBooster sales: Prepare for and lead virtual sales conversations, communicate with prospective buyers, send follow-up materials and contracts, maintain accurate records, and connect new clients with the teams that will support their partnership.
  • Support Sales projects and resources: Organize data, create and update presentations and resources, proofread sales materials, and provide project support that equips Field Sales teams to engage prospective customers effectively.
  • Collaborate across teams: Partner with Marketing, Sales, Account Executives, Research & Development, and other teams to improve the inbound lead experience, share insights, and identify opportunities to strengthen processes and workflows.

What You’ll Bring to the Table:

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to build relationships and establish trust with prospective customers
  • Strong time management, organization, and follow-through
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately manage data and information
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and shift comfortably between sales, administrative, and creative work
  • Curiosity and active listening skills
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams
  • Comfort leading virtual conversations with prospective customers
  • Ability to consistently work MST/PST business hours

Compensation: $18-$23/hour + commission

Location: Remote

Work Hours: Part time (15-20 hours/week)

Exempt/non-exempt: non-exempt

raw.description:
We’re seeking a strategic, results-driven Regional Sales Director to lead a high-performing team of Account Executives (AEs) and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) responsible for driving new business growth, expanding existing relationships, and ensuring customer success and retention.

This player-coach role combines strategic leadership with operational execution. You’ll own the region’s ARR target, set the vision for growth, and ensure seamless collaboration between Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven and empathetic leader who inspires excellence, develops talent, and delivers measurable impact across the full customer lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Growth

  • Define and execute the regional go-to-market strategy across new business, renewals, and expansions.
  • Own the region’s full ARR target, including pipeline generation, win rates, renewals, and customer growth.
  • Partner with GTM and Sales leadership to set annual plans, quotas, and coverage models aligned with company priorities.
  • Translate business objectives into actionable territory and segment strategies.

Team Leadership & Performance

  • Lead, coach, and develop AEs and CSMs to consistently exceed revenue, renewal, and adoption goals.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct regular pipeline and forecast reviews to ensure accuracy and focus on high-impact opportunities.
  • Coach team members on discovery, consultative selling, and executive engagement.
  • Identify and mentor future leaders to strengthen team depth and succession planning.

Revenue Growth & Retention

  • Drive strategies for new business acquisition and customer expansion in partnership with Marketing, Product, and Enablement.
  • Ensure balanced coverage across territories to maximize market penetration and customer value.

Customer Success & Advocacy

  • Ensure high customer satisfaction, adoption, and measurable outcomes across all accounts.
  • Support CSMs in developing success plans, executive business reviews, and expansion strategies.
  • Cultivate customer advocates to strengthen brand reputation and influence in the market.

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain high standards of forecast accuracy, data integrity, and CRM discipline (Salesforce, Gainsight, etc.).
  • Monitor key performance metrics—pipeline coverage, renewal risk, and expansion velocity—and proactively address gaps.
  • Leverage analytics and market intelligence to inform territory planning and resource allocation.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless customer experience from onboarding through renewal.

Market & Strategy

  • Stay current on market trends, competitive dynamics, and institutional challenges in the education technology sector.
  • Provide feedback to Product and Marketing based on customer insights and emerging opportunities.
  • Represent the company at industry conferences and events as a thought leader and advocate for innovation in education.
  • 10+ years of experience in EdTech SaaS or enterprise software sales, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role.
  • Proven record of leading teams to exceed aggressive ARR and retention targets across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Deep understanding of the education market, including institutional decision-making and procurement processes.
  • Exceptional leadership, strategic thinking, and executive communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, operational, and forecasting acumen with proficiency in Salesforce, Gainsight, and related GTM tools.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent preferred.

Success Metrics

  • Achievement of regional new business, expansion, and renewal targets.
  • Growth in market share and customer advocacy within the assigned segment.
  • Improved win rates, pipeline velocity, and forecast accuracy.
  • High team engagement and retention of top performers.
  • Consistent operational excellence and data discipline.

The expected annual base salary range for this position is: $125,550/year to $209,250/year. This position is commission-based.

Actual compensation will be provided in writing at the time of offer, if extended, and is determined by work location and a range of other relevant factors, including but not limited to: experience, skills, degrees, licensures, certifications, and other job-related factors. Internal equity, market and organizational factors are also considered.

Total Rewards @ Turnitin
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.

Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.

Our Mission is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.

Our Values underpin everything we do.

  • Customer Centric: Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
  • Passion for Learning: We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
  • Integrity: Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
  • Action & Ownership: We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
  • One Team: We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
  • Global Mindset: We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

Global Benefits

  • Remote First Culture
  • Health Care Coverage
  • Education Reimbursement*Competitive Paid Time Off
  • Self-Care Days
  • National Holidays
  • 2 Founder Days + Juneteenth Observed
  • Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Charitable Contribution Match
  • Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement
  • Access to Employee Assistance Program (mental health platform)
  • Parental Leave
  • Retirement Plan with match/contribution

Seeing Beyond the Job Ad
At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad. We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

Turnitin, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer- vets/disabled.

When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.

Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.

Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.

das erwartet dich bei uns

Berufseinstieg | Vollzeit | Remote – Wohnort im Ruhrgebiet (Raum Essen/Bottrop)

Mach aus guten Themen eine sichtbare Marke.

Du erkennst gute Geschichten, recherchierst gern und willst von Anfang an Verantwortung übernehmen?

Wir entwickeln ein digitales B2B-Produkt im HR-Bereich – einem Markt, der sich durch Technologie und künstliche Intelligenz gerade grundlegend verändert. Für den weiteren Aufbau unserer Marke und unserer Kommunikation suchen wir eine Person, die von Anfang an mitgestaltet.

Dabei geht es ausdrücklich nicht nur darum, einzelne Social-Media-Kanäle zu bespielen. Wir wollen relevante Themen erkennen, daraus gute Inhalte entwickeln und diese über die jeweils passenden Formate und Kanäle sichtbar machen.

über uns

Wir bauen eine HR-Tech-Lösung, die künstliche Intelligenz in die Personalarbeit von Unternehmen bringt. Hinter dem Produkt steht ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen, das Erfahrung aus IT-Beratung, Personalarbeit und Produktentwicklung verbindet. Wir stehen am Anfang des Markenaufbaus – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

welche menschen wir suchen

Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht einfach einen bestehenden Redaktionsplan abarbeitet, sondern sich fragt: Welches Thema interessiert unsere Zielgruppe? Welche Geschichte steckt dahinter? Und welches Format und welcher Kanal sind dafür am besten geeignet?

Dafür bekommst du früh Gestaltungsspielraum und arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und dem Produktteam zusammen.

was solltest du mitbringen?

  • ein gerade abgeschlossenes oder bald abgeschlossenes Studium, idealerweise auf Master-Niveau, z. B. in Marketing, Kommunikation/Onlinekommunikation, Medienmanagement, Digital Business, Kommunikationsdesign, Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Marketing-Schwerpunkt oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich – entscheidender als der genaue Studiengang ist, dass du Inhalte entwickeln und gut kommunizieren kannst
  • sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift
  • ein gutes Gefühl für Sprache, Inhalte und visuelle Kommunikation
  • Social Media verstehst du nicht nur als Nutzer, sondern als Kommunikationsinstrument
  • Interesse an digitalen Produkten, HR-Themen, Technologie und KI sowie die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue und teilweise komplexe Themen einzuarbeiten
  • selbstständiges Arbeiten, eigene Ideen und den Anspruch, Dinge pragmatisch umzusetzen
  • Lust, mit modernen Content- und KI-Tools zu arbeiten
  • erste praktische Erfahrungen durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeit, Hochschul- oder eigene Projekte oder einen eigenen Social-Media-Auftritt sind sehr willkommen
  • wünschenswert sind Kenntnisse in Canva, Adobe, Figma, CapCut oder vergleichbaren Tools

deine aufgaben

Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team unsere Content- und Social-Media-Aktivitäten weiter und setzt sie eigenständig um:

  • Themen und Content-Ideen recherchieren und entwickeln – aus Produktentwicklungen, Markttrends und Gesprächen im Team
  • Beiträge, Artikel, Grafiken, Kurzvideos und weitere Content-Formate erstellen; Foto-, Video- und Short-Form-Content konzipieren und teilweise selbst produzieren
  • unsere Präsenz auf LinkedIn, Instagram und weiteren geeigneten Kanälen aufbauen und betreuen
  • Inhalte für Website, Newsletter, Kampagnen und andere digitale Touchpoints entwickeln
  • geeignete KI-Tools für Recherche, Texterstellung, Bild, Video und Content-Produktion einsetzen
  • einfache Content- und Kampagnenpläne entwickeln und deren Umsetzung koordinieren
  • Reichweite, Interaktion und Performance der Inhalte analysieren und daraus Verbesserungen ableiten
  • Markt, Wettbewerber und relevante Trends im HR-Tech-Umfeld beobachten und neue Formate ausprobieren
Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du zunehmend Verantwortung für einzelne Kanäle, Kampagnen oder Themenbereiche.

was wir dir bieten

  • direkten Einstieg in ein wachsendes digitales Unternehmen
  • viel Gestaltungsspielraum statt enger Aufgabenpakete
  • kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Gründern und Management
  • die Möglichkeit, Content, Marke und Social-Media-Präsenz sichtbar mit aufzubauen
  • intensiven Einsatz moderner KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag
  • ein Umfeld, in dem du schnell Verantwortung übernehmen kannst

passt das zu dir?

Wenn du gerne recherchierst, gute Geschichten erkennst und Lust hast, aus einem jungen digitalen Unternehmen eine sichtbare Marke zu machen, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – gern mit Links zu Arbeitsproben oder eigenen Kanälen.

deine benefits

  • Einstiegsgehalt ab 36.000 € brutto pro Jahr
  • Remote-Arbeit mit Wohnort im Ruhrgebiet (Raum Essen/Bottrop)
  • ein kollegiales Team mit flachen Hierarchien
  • individuelle Weiterentwicklung
  • Diensthandy und Laptop
  • Workation nach Absprache

Make a difference. Be happy. Grow your career.

The Beacon Senior Analyst provides EHR design, build, testing and advanced troubleshooting services for Nordic’s more complex clients. They bring strong technical and soft skills. They perform most of the day-to-day work for our clients with oversight and assistance from Application Advisors and Senior Application Advisors.

They will be responsible for, but not be limited to:

Technical

  • Performing advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving within their application to ensure the integrity, integration, and stability of EHR applications for Nordic’s complex customers

  • Fulfilling system requests from customers by performing issue analysis within their application, translating needs into detailed requirement specifications, and performing system build and testing

  • Performing analysis of workflows system setup, and system audits, including participating in system upgrades and testing

Project and Issue Management

  • Exercising moderate judgment and contributing to decisions, under the supervision of Application Advisors, in support of Managed Services customers that could have impacts to patient safety, financial integrity, and regulatory compliance; contributing to decisions regarding what escalation is appropriate

  • Managing multiple customer assignments with minimal oversight from Application Advisors, including awareness of unique customer build and process, management of open issues in a ticketing system, email communication, and calendar management

  • Managing multiple complex clients and projects simultaneously with minimal oversight from Application Advisors, including maintaining awareness of unique customer build and process, managing open issues in a ticketing system, and monitoring customer specific email and calendar

  • Accurately completing up-to-date documentation in relevant ticketing system(s), regarding requests processed and incidents solved while still meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

  • Following proper change control policies for migrating application build and configurations

  • Working on projects that may be assigned on an ad hoc basis, and assisting in other internal initiatives as necessary, directed, assigned, or requested

Teamwork and Customer Service

  • Providing outstanding customer service by anticipating and meeting shifting customer needs, and delivering high quality support, and valuing and building relationships with customer IT and operations staff, including customer end-users, operations managers, IT analysts, and IT managers

  • Participating in communication and change-management of proposed changes, ensuring concerns and input from affected groups are addressed, and system changes are understood and properly used

  • Contributing to a supportive team culture where everyone is focused on the overall goals of Managed Services; Adapting their own focuses of time and energy, under the guidance of Managers and Application Advisors, to deliver on most-important priorities

  • Assisting in the onboarding of new team members to customer support team, including orienting to unique client configuration and processes, and introducing employees to customer counterparts

Growth and Mentorship

  • Understanding complex system setup, and able to explain and communicate that setup in ways that are easy to understand for internal staff and day-to-day customer counterparts

  • Taking on new responsibilities and challenges to continually grow and develop skills to meet the evolving needs of Managed Services and our customers

  • Seeking opportunities to delegate and explain less complicated tasks to peers and less-experienced team members; guiding and overseeing the completion of delegated tasks

Skills And Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field (relevant education and/or 8+ years’ industry experience).

  • Epic Certification in Beacon with strong understanding of functionality within that application

  • 3-5+ year of experience implementing, training, or supporting EHR modules

  • Must demonstrate and embody Nordic’s maxims

  • Ability to apply problem solving skills

  • Excellent communication skills, written and verbal

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to organize

  • Must be able to work independently, as well as within a team environment

  • Prior experience with ticketing systems and change management processes

  • Strong customer service track record

  • Knowledge of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) processes, previous management and project management experience, and participation in previous systems implementations, preferred

Additional Details

  • Ability to take on-call rotations outside of core business hours, including nights and weekends

  • Ability to travel up to 10%

We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply, including women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and veterans.

raw.description:
¡Trabaja en DaCodes!

Somos una firma de expertos en software y transformación digital de alto impacto.
Durante 10 años hemos creado soluciones enfocadas en la tecnología e innovación gracias a nuestro equipo de casi 300 talentosos #DaCoders, incluyendo desarrolladores, arquitectos, diseñadores UX/UI, PMs, QA testers y más. Nuestro equipo colabora en proyectos con clientes en LATAM y Estados Unidos, logrando resultados sobresalientes.
En DaCodes, tendrás la oportunidad de impulsar tu desarrollo profesional, trabajar en diversos proyectos dentro de distintas industrias, y contribuir al diseño, implementación y optimización de infraestructuras en la nube.
Nuestros DaCoders tienen un gran impacto en el éxito de nuestro negocio y el de nuestros clientes. Serás el experto que participará en nuestros proyectos y tendrás acceso a startups disruptivas y marcas globales.

¿Te interesa?

Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a de Datos Senior especializado/a en Snowflake para construir un almacén de datos confiable a partir de sistemas fuente como SAP ASE (Sybase), SQL Server, APIs REST y archivos.

Serás responsable de la capa de datos completa: extracción, modelado, calidad, conciliación, seguridad y operación. El objetivo es habilitar el consumo de información por agentes de IA capaces de responder preguntas de negocio con cifras exactas, trazables y sujetas a los permisos de cada usuario.

Trabajarás directamente con usuarios de negocio y con el ingeniero de IA para definir métricas, homologar información entre sistemas y validar que los resultados coincidan con las fuentes originales.

Modalidad: Remoto · Tiempo completo.
Ubicación: México y LATAM.
Seniority: Senior.
Idioma: Español nativo o profesional e inglés intermedio, con capacidad para comprender documentación técnica.

Requirements

Principales responsabilidades y funciones

Ingesta e integración

  • Construir procesos de extracción desde SAP ASE (Sybase) y SQL Server mediante ODBC, utilizando Openflow como patrón de conectores.
  • Integrar APIs REST con autenticación, renovación de tokens, paginación, control de límites de peticiones y reintentos.
  • Incorporar archivos y otras fuentes al almacén de datos, preservando el dato original y su marca de extracción.
  • Permitir el reproceso de datos desde la capa de aterrizaje sin volver a consultar los sistemas fuente.

Modelado y capa semántica

  • Construir las capas Bronze, Silver y Gold con dimensiones conformadas, historización y hechos de negocio con métricas certificadas.
  • Desarrollar modelos y transformaciones con dbt, incluyendo pruebas declarativas, materializaciones incrementales y documentación generada.
  • Definir con el cliente catálogos maestros homologados para unificar identificadores y nombres entre sistemas, mediante tablas de equivalencia versionadas y métricas de cobertura.
  • Diseñar con el ingeniero de IA modelos semánticos, consultas verificadas y un glosario de métricas para el consumo de los agentes.
  • Garantizar la trazabilidad de cada cifra a su fuente, tabla y fecha de corte, y exponer la información mediante vistas de consumo.

Calidad y operación

  • Implementar reglas de calidad y mecanismos de cuarentena para registros que no cumplan los criterios definidos.
  • Orquestar la ventana nocturna de procesamiento, con monitoreo y bitácoras de ejecución.
  • Conciliar la capa Gold contra los reportes vigentes del cliente y documentar las diferencias y sus causas.
  • Controlar el consumo de créditos y configurar mecanismos de monitoreo de recursos en Snowflake.
  • Colaborar en la evaluación de precisión y repetibilidad de las respuestas generadas por los agentes de IA.

Gobernanza y transferencia

  • Implementar RBAC, row access policies y políticas de masking conforme a la matriz de accesos acordada con el cliente.
  • Asegurar que los agentes consulten y respondan únicamente sobre información autorizada para cada rol.
  • Documentar el linaje, la operación de los pipelines y los procedimientos de reproceso.
  • Preparar la transferencia técnica y operativa al equipo del cliente.

Perfil deseado y requisitos obligatorios

  • Al menos cinco años construyendo almacenes de datos en producción y al menos dos años trabajando con Snowflake.
  • Dominio avanzado de Snowflake: warehouses, RBAC, row access policies, masking y resource monitors.
  • Experiencia avanzada en modelado dimensional: dimensiones conformadas, historización y esquemas estrella.
  • Dominio avanzado de dbt: pruebas declarativas, materializaciones incrementales y documentación generada.
  • SQL avanzado y experiencia en extracción desde SAP ASE (Sybase) y SQL Server, incluyendo ingeniería inversa de esquemas sin documentación.
  • Experiencia avanzada en ingesta desde APIs REST: autenticación, paginación, control de ritmo y reintentos.
  • Experiencia avanzada en orquestación de pipelines y calidad de datos con cuarentena.
  • Experiencia intermedia a avanzada integrando modelos LLM con almacenes de datos: modelos semánticos, text-to-SQL gobernado, consultas verificadas y evaluación de precisión y repetibilidad.
  • Experiencia intermedia diseñando capas de datos para agentes, con trazabilidad a la fuente y fecha de corte, vistas de consumo y control de créditos.
  • Experiencia trabajando directamente con usuarios de negocio para definir reglas, homologar catálogos y validar cifras.
  • Español nativo o profesional e inglés intermedio, con comprensión de documentación técnica.
  • Residencia en México o LATAM y disponibilidad para trabajar de tiempo completo de forma remota.

Habilidades clave

  • Ownership: asumir la responsabilidad de la capa de datos completa y dar seguimiento autónomo hasta su entrega.
  • Rigor con las cifras: validar la exactitud de los resultados y resolver diferencias contra la fuente.
  • Criterio de negocio: acordar las reglas de homologación con el cliente y documentar sus implicaciones.
  • Comunicación clara: explicar diferencias de conciliación a usuarios de negocio y decisiones técnicas a desarrolladores.
  • Capacidad para investigar sistemas sin documentación y convertir los hallazgos en soluciones mantenibles.

Deseables

  • Experiencia con Snowflake Intelligence, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Agents, Cortex Search o Snowflake CoCo.
  • Implementación de RAG sobre documentos no estructurados integrado al almacén de datos.
  • Experiencia con Openflow, Dynamic Tables o Snowpark.
  • Experiencia con ERPs de nicho sobre Sybase o SQL Server.
  • Certificación SnowPro Core o Advanced.

Benefits

🚀 Integración a marcas globales y startups disruptivas.

🏡 Trabajo remoto/Home office.

⏳ Horario ajustado a la célula de trabajo/proyecto asignado.

📅 Trabajo de lunes a viernes.

🎉 Día off en tu cumpleaños.

🏥 Seguro de gastos médicos mayores (aplica para México).

🛡️ Seguro de vida (aplica para México).

🎓 Acceso a cursos y certificaciones.

📡 Eventos virtuales de integración y grupos de interés.

📢 Clases de inglés.

🏅 Orgullosamente certificados como Great Place to Work.

The Team

You'll lead a delivery team within a cross-functional program that includes software engineers, solution and cloud architects, database administrators, DevSecOps engineers, quality assurance specialists, user experience professionals, business analysts, product managers, data analysts, accessibility and security specialists, and behavioral health subject matter experts. We partner with federal stakeholders to operate and modernize a mission-critical data collection and performance reporting platform used by grantees and program staff.


The Work

In this player-coach role, you will provide day-to-day technical leadership while remaining hands-on in the design, development, testing, and support of secure .NET applications. You will guide engineers through solution design and implementation, organize technical work, review code, resolve blockers, and help the team deliver dependable capabilities for data entry, batch ingestion, validation, workflow, reporting, and data exchange.

A key part of the work is improving the platform without disrupting active users. You will help the team modernize legacy components incrementally, strengthen engineering practices, improve performance and data quality, expand automated testing and deployment, and make production behavior easier to observe and troubleshoot. You will also coach engineers and communicate technical options, risks, and progress to program and client stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead a team of software engineers by organizing technical work, clarifying priorities, removing blockers, reviewing outcomes, and providing practical coaching and feedback.
  • Design, develop, and maintain production web applications using C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core or MVC, and modern JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Translate product, data, security, accessibility, and operational requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans.
  • Guide the design of REST APIs, domain models, SQL Server data structures, queries, and integrations with internal and external systems.
  • Oversee capabilities for data entry, batch upload, validation, duplicate detection, workflow, notifications, reporting, and data download.
  • Establish expectations for automated tests, code quality, peer review, branching, release readiness, and maintainable documentation.
  • Support continuous integration and deployment practices and coordinate application releases with cloud, DevSecOps, database, security, and quality assurance teams.
  • Lead investigation of production defects and performance issues using application logs, monitoring data, root-cause analysis, and tested corrective actions.
  • Ensure the team applies secure coding, least-privilege access, role-based authorization, privacy, Section 508, and WCAG requirements throughout delivery.
  • Participate in Agile planning, estimation, demonstrations, release activities, and user acceptance testing while communicating dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs to stakeholders.
  • Contribute to shared engineering standards and mentor less-experienced engineers across the program.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years developing and supporting resilient, well-tested production web applications, including 3+ years using C#, .NET or .NET Core, and ASP.NET MVC or Web API with object-oriented design.
  • 2+ years leading or providing technical direction to software engineers, including reviewing code, resolving technical blockers, documenting decisions, and communicating with stakeholders.
  • 3+ years working with SQL Server or another relational database, including data modeling, query development, and performance troubleshooting.
  • 2+ years developing REST APIs and browser-based applications using JSON, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or TypeScript, with a strong understanding of HTTP and HTTPS/TLS.
  • 2+ years using automated testing and Git-based development workflows, including pull requests, code reviews, and release management; 1+ year supporting cloud-hosted applications using containers or comparable deployment approaches.
  • 2+ years implementing authentication, authorization, role-based access, and secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Authorization to work in the United States, ability to perform all work within the United States, and ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination and complete required background screening.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading incremental modernization of legacy .NET applications while maintaining reliable production service.
  • Experience troubleshooting production performance and reliability issues in AWS or AWS GovCloud using monitoring and logging tools such as CloudWatch or Splunk.
  • Experience improving CI/CD pipelines, automated quality checks, container deployment, and repeatable environment configuration using infrastructure as code.
  • Experience integrating Okta or another federated identity platform for single sign-on and multifactor authentication.
  • Experience designing or supporting batch data ingestion, ETL, data validation, or business intelligence integrations such as Tableau.
  • Experience supporting federal or public health systems, with familiarity with NIST Moderate controls, FedRAMP, ATO processes, or Section 508/WCAG accessibility requirements.

raw.description:
About Revolution Prep

Revolution Prep is a high-growth, performance-driven company committed to transforming education while remaining true to our social mission.

Our people define the Revolution. Revolutionaries are talented, resourceful, and tenacious. To be a “Revolutionary” means to come to work ready to collaborate, achieve, and to inspire. As a result, passion and energy feed into a collegial, entrepreneurial, and fast-paced culture that permeates throughout our workspace.

Full-Time Professional Online Tutor – SAT/ACT English & Reading

Remote | Full-Time W-2 | $25/hr Starting Pay | Paid Training & Prep | Benefits

Make a Difference. Build a Career. Tutor from Home.

Make a meaningful impact on students’ academic journeys—all from the comfort of your home. Join Revolution Prep as a full-time tutor and enjoy the stability, benefits, and support of being a full-time W-2 employee—not an independent contractor.

We provide a dynamic, in-house curriculum and a wealth of teaching resources, so you can spend less time creating lesson plans and searching for materials and more time doing what you do best: helping students learn and succeed.

You’ll also receive paid training and prep time, along with a supportive community of fellow tutors who are passionate about education. Whether you’re helping a student master a challenging concept, build confidence, or reach an important academic goal, your work makes a real difference.

Schedule Requirements

This role requires a consistent weekly schedule and a minimum of 38 hours of availability, including evenings and weekends.

  • The goal is 30+ hours of tutoring per week, though actual hours may vary based on student demand and your subject expertise.
  • At least 8 hours of weekend availability required
  • Availability must remain consistent from week to week
  • Schedules are posted in 2-6 hour blocks and extend 9+ months into the future
  • Time-off requests should generally be submitted at least 4 weeks in advance
  • Minimum one-year employment commitment

Prime-time availability:

  • Monday–Thursday: 3–11 PM ET
  • Friday: 3–7 PM ET
  • Saturday: 9 AM–7 PM ET
  • Sunday: 9 AM–10 PM ET

What You'll Teach

  • SAT and ACT English and Reading test preparation
  • Middle and high school English
  • Executive function skills, including organization, planning, time management, and study strategies
  • Additional academic subjects based on your expertise and Revolution Prep’s needs

What You'll Do

  • Lead engaging online tutoring sessions using Revolution Prep's curriculum and resources
  • Help students understand challenging concepts and develop effective learning strategies
  • Prepare for sessions using company-provided materials
  • Communicate with students and families about academic progress
  • Build supportive relationships that motivate students to reach their goals
  • Participate in paid training and ongoing professional development
  • Collaborate with Faculty Leaders and fellow tutors to continuously improve your teaching

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • At least 1 year of professional teaching or tutoring experience
  • Comfortable teaching Middle School through High School Level English
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to explain challenging concepts clearly and patiently
  • SAT/ACT tutoring or test-preparation experience is a plus
  • AP subject expertise is a plus
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Authorized to work in the U.S. and currently residing in the U.S.

Why Join Revolution Prep?

  • Full-time W-2 employment
  • $25/hour starting rate for tutoring
  • Opportunity to earn up to $29/hour after the 90-day review, based on performance and subject coverage
  • Paid prep and training time
  • Health insurance
  • 401(k) options
  • Bonus opportunities
  • Paid onboarding and ongoing professional development
  • Proven curriculum and subject-specific materials provided
  • No need to compete for tutoring hours; hours are allocated based on availability and subject expertise
  • Support from experienced Faculty Leaders
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on students' academic and personal development

Technology Requirements

You'll need:

  • A Mac or PC desktop/laptop
  • Reliable high-speed internet with an Ethernet connection
  • At least 4GB available RAM
  • A quiet, professional workspace suitable for online instruction

Revolution Prep can provide a technology kit for tutors who need one, including a webcam, headset, ring light, green screen and annotation tablet.

Our Hiring Process

After submitting your application, candidates will receive a link to a required approximately 15-minute assessment. The assessment helps Revolution Prep evaluate subject knowledge and overall fit for the Professional Tutor role.

Candidates who advance in the process will also complete a comprehensive background check.

Q&A

Q: Are there additional responsibilities?

A: In addition to tutoring, you'll communicate with families about student progress and prepare for sessions using company-provided materials. Both collectively make up around 10% of your workload and are paid time. We also offer ongoing professional development which is paid.

Q: How flexible is the time-off policy?

A: Requests for time off must be submitted at least 4 weeks in advance. We understand emergencies happen, so we have systems in place for coverage in those events.

Q: Is ongoing training part of the role?

A: Yes, ongoing professional development is required – we offer 24 hours of paid training per year after the initial onboarding.

Connect With Us

Company Website, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube

Revolution Prep is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender, genetic information, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other status or classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain the SAP integration architecture, strategy, and technical standards.
  • Design end-to-end integrations across SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP cloud solutions, and third-party systems.
  • Lead architecture and technical design using SAP Integration Suite / CPI, SAP PI/PO, APIs, IDocs, OData, SOAP, REST, and RFC/BAPI.
  • Define appropriate integration patterns and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Review technical designs and provide guidance to integration developers, consultants, and vendors.
  • Support integration between SAP and enterprise platforms such as MES, LIMS, WMS, CRM, and cloud applications.
  • Work closely with SAP functional teams, Solution Architects, Security, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders.
  • Support modernization initiatives, including migration from SAP PI/PO to SAP Integration Suite / SAP BTP.
  • Ensure appropriate integration monitoring, error handling, security, and performance standards.
  • Support SAP transformation, migration, and global rollout programs.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as SAP Integration Architect, Technical Architect, or SAP Integration Consultant.
  • Extensive experience with SAP Integration Suite / SAP CPI.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP ECC integrations.
  • Experience with SAP PI/PO and SAP BTP integration capabilities.
  • Strong knowledge of REST, SOAP, OData, IDocs, RFC/BAPI, SFTP, XML, and JSON.
  • Strong understanding of API management, integration patterns, and integration security.
  • Experience integrating SAP with both SAP and non-SAP enterprise systems.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

Transforming Life Science Consulting Worldwide.

raw.title: Senior Solutions Architect – AI Infrastructure Networking
raw.excerpt: About the roleWe are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with deep networking expertise to join the Voyager team in the Mirantis Office of the CTO.
raw.description:
About the role

We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with deep networking expertise to join the Voyager team in the Mirantis Office of the CTO. You will own the network solutioning of k0rdent AI, our platform for building and operating GPU clouds and AI factories, from metal to model.

You will design how large GPU clusters are interconnected, how tenants are isolated, and how workloads reach the network from containers, virtual machines and bare metal nodes. You will turn that design into published reference architectures, working code and proofs of concept that run on real hardware with our customers and partners.

As part of the Office of the CTO, research is a core part of the job. You will explore designs and technologies before customers ask for them, prototype ideas that may not ship, and challenge established practice when a better approach exists. Your work will shape where k0rdent AI goes next, not only how it is deployed today.

This role combines research with hands-on, outward-facing work. You will split your time between exploring new designs, writing architecture, building and validating it in the lab, and explaining it to engineers, executives and conference audiences. You will work with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering colleagues across many countries and time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Reference architecture

  • Design and publish network reference architectures and solution designs for k0rdent AI, covering data center topologies from a single rack to multi-thousand-GPU clusters.

  • Define compute (east-west) fabrics on InfiniBand and on RoCEv2 Ethernet, including rail-optimised and fat-tree / Clos designs, oversubscription and failure-domain choices.

  • Define front-end, storage and management networks, and how they connect to customer data centers, public clouds and hybrid environments.

  • Specify multi-tenant isolation across the stack: InfiniBand partitions (PKeys), VRFs and EVPN-VXLAN on Ethernet, and Kubernetes-level network policy.

  • Document scale limits and trade-offs (cost, performance, operability, vendor lock-in) with defensible reasoning a customer can follow.

Host and platform networking

  • Define how Linux hosts expose NICs, DPUs and SuperNICs to workloads: PCI passthrough, SR-IOV virtual functions, IOMMU groups, NUMA and GPU-NIC affinity.

  • Design Kubernetes networking for AI workloads: primary and secondary CNIs, Multus, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, NVIDIA Network Operator, and Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA).

  • Design networking for virtual machines on KubeVirt, including passthrough and SR-IOV for GPU and RDMA traffic.

Research and exploration

  • Track and evaluate emerging technologies and standards in AI networking, such as Ultra Ethernet (UEC), SuperNIC and DPU offloads, scale-up and scale-across fabrics, and Kubernetes DRA network drivers.

  • Prototype alternative designs in the lab, including ones customers have not yet asked for, and measure them against current practice.

  • Challenge established or customer-preferred designs when evidence points to a better option, and make the case with data.

  • Publish findings as internal research notes and design proposals and, where appropriate, as external papers, blog posts or talks.

Code and proofs of concept

  • Build and run proofs of concept with customers and partners, on Mirantis lab hardware and on customer sites, and report results against agreed success criteria.

  • Write automation and tooling (Python, Go, Bash, Ansible, Helm, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform) that makes the reference architectures reproducible.

  • Run validation and benchmarking of fabrics and host configurations (e.g. NCCL tests, perftest, ib_write_bw) and turn findings into design guidance.

Customers, partners and community

  • Act as the network subject matter expert in customer discovery, design reviews and architecture workshops, bringing thought leadership and new ideas rather than only reflecting current practice.

  • Work with hardware and networking partners (e.g. NVIDIA, server OEMs, switch and network vendors) on joint designs and validations.

  • Innovate and feed research results back to Product and Engineering, and help shape the k0rdent AI roadmap.

  • Present at industry events, webinars and partner summits, and run hands-on workshops for technical audiences.

  • Write technical content: reference architecture documents, solution briefs, blog posts and internal enablement.

Education and experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years in network engineering or network architecture, with at least 3 years in data center, HPC or cloud infrastructure networking.

  • Customer-facing experience as a solutions architect, pre-sales engineer, consultant or technical lead.

Required technical skills

  • Data center network design: spine-leaf and Clos topologies, rail-optimised GPU fabrics, oversubscription, ECMP, and the operational challenges of scaling to thousands of nodes.

  • InfiniBand: subnet management, partitioning, adaptive routing, and how NCCL / RDMA traffic behaves on the fabric.

  • RoCEv2 on Ethernet: lossless and congestion-controlled designs (PFC, ECN, DCQCN), QoS, MTU and buffer tuning.

  • Routing and overlays: BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, VRFs and their use for multi-tenancy.

  • Hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity: interconnects, VPN, cloud provider networking constructs, and IP address and DNS planning across sites.

  • Linux networking: how the kernel and drivers manage NICs, PCI passthrough, SR-IOV, IOMMU, NUMA affinity, and tools such as iproute2, ethtool and devlink.

  • Kubernetes networking: CNI plugins (e.g. Cilium, Calico, OVN-Kubernetes), Multus and secondary networks, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, network policy and service exposure.

  • Virtualisation on Kubernetes: KubeVirt, and how VM networking, passthrough and SR-IOV are configured there.

  • Programming or scripting in at least one language (Python or Go preferred), and comfortable using Git, CI and infrastructure-as-code.

How you work

We hire for these behaviours as much as for technical depth, and will ask for concrete examples of each.

  • Curious. You dig into why a fabric behaves the way it does, read the specs and the source, and keep up with how AI networking is changing. You question established designs, including the ones customers are used to, when there is a better way.

  • Ownership. You take a reference architecture or a POC from the first sketch to a published, validated result, and you stand behind it.

  • Proactive. You spot gaps in the product, the documentation or a customer design before you are asked, and you act on them.

  • Fast learner. You get productive quickly in unfamiliar hardware, software or customer environments.

  • Business acumen. You connect network design choices to cost, time-to-value and risk, and explain them in those terms to decision makers.

Communication and collaboration

  • Excellent written and spoken English; you write documents others can build from.

  • Comfortable presenting to large audiences at conferences and events, and running hands-on workshops.

  • Able to adapt the message to the audience, from network engineers to customer executives.

  • Experience working in an international, distributed company, across time zones and different work cultures, with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering teams.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA networking: Quantum InfiniBand, Spectrum-X Ethernet, ConnectX SuperNICs, BlueField DPUs, UFM, and NVIDIA reference designs for AI factories.

  • Experience with GPU cloud, neocloud or HPC operators, or with NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) style deployments.

  • Bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle: Metal3, Ironic, Redfish, PXE / iPXE, and Cluster API.

  • Network automation and SDN controllers, and switch operating systems such as Cumulus Linux, SONiC or vendor equivalents.

  • Global load balancing and service exposure for distributed inference (GSLB, Gateway API, ingress).

  • Familiarity with Software-Defined Storage networking for AI (NVMe-oF, GPUDirect Storage).

  • Experience with Mirantis products, MKE, k0s, k0rdent networking.

  • Contributions to open-source networking or Kubernetes projects, or a track record of public talks and technical writing.

  • Participation in standards or industry bodies (e.g. Ultra Ethernet Consortium, OCP, IETF), or published research, patents or white papers.

  • Additional languages beyond English, for example a European language.

Location, travel and working model

This role is remote, open to candidates based in he United States (East Coast).

  • You will work with a team spread across many time zones; some meetings will fall outside standard local hours.

  • Travel of up to 25% for customer engagements, partner meetings, lab work and industry events, primarily within the EU and US.

  • Mirantis is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation and benefits are set according to the local market and employment arrangement.

Why you’ll love Mirantis

  • Build the observability foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises

  • Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence

  • Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success

It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to

By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities.

About Mirantis

Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.
