About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

Senior ML Ops Engineer

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or a related field, including at least 2 years of building and operating production ML or other data-intensive systems.
  • Demonstrated ownership of cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines, including Infrastructure as Code, AWS or Azure, CI/CD, and containerized applications.
  • Strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience with modern data and ML platforms such as Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow.
  • A production-first engineering mindset, with experience in testing, observability, debugging, performance optimization, reliability engineering, and delivering enterprise ML systems that meet operational SLAs.
  • Strong system design and communication skills, with the ability to define clean interfaces, evaluate architectural trade-offs, and make sound technical decisions in ambiguous environments.
  • Experience working in international, cross-functional organizations, supporting the full product lifecycle from pre-sales demonstrations through production deployment for global enterprise customers.

What You Will Work On

  • Design, build, and operate production-grade ML platforms and infrastructure across AWS and Azure in a globally distributed environment.
  • Bridge the gap between research prototypes and production systems by improving software quality, deployment workflows, automation, and operational processes.
  • Contribute to the technical architecture by identifying production risks, proposing pragmatic alternatives, and improving system reliability and scalability.
  • Improve engineering transparency through architectural decision records, dependency mapping, operational documentation, and post-incident reviews.
  • Mentor engineers across the team, promote engineering best practices, and help cultivate a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ML Ops platforms, model lifecycle management, feature stores, model monitoring, or AI evaluation infrastructure.
  • Experience deploying and operating LLM-based or agentic AI systems in production.
  • Familiarity with engineering maturity frameworks or organizational models such as CMMI, Cynefin, or similar approaches.
  • Experience working through periods of significant organizational or technical change, including mergers, platform migrations, or large-scale reorganizations.

What This Role Is Not

This is not a narrowly scoped implementation or ticket-driven engineering role. We are looking for an engineer who can work across software, infrastructure, ML systems, and engineering processes, helping shape technical direction while remaining hands-on. Success in this role requires sound technical judgment, ownership, and the ability to balance immediate delivery with long-term maintainability.

Job Description — Technical Recruiter (Remote / Offshore)

Work model: Remote (offshore), with 3–4 hours daily overlap with Sydney (AEDT/AEST)
Type: Contract (preferred) with potential to extend

About Komforce

Komforce is a specialist resource augmentation firm focused on Salesforce Industries / Communications Cloud (Vlocity) talent. We help telcos, digital service providers, and Salesforce partners/SIs build delivery teams fast with clear SLAs, strong candidate quality, and consistent reporting.

Role Summary

We're hiring a highly independent, reliable Technical Recruiter to own end-to-end sourcing and first-stage recruiting for niche Salesforce talent. This is not a post-and-pray role, you'll be doing deep research, targeted outreach, and structured pipeline management.

You'll succeed here if you're comfortable operating with autonomy, you're rigorous about process and data hygiene, and you can consistently produce strong shortlists for hard-to-find profiles (Architects, Developers, QA Leads, Solution Consultants, Project Leads) in the Salesforce Industries ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

1) Talent Research & Market Mapping (Core)

  • Build and maintain talent maps for priority skill sets (e.g., OmniStudio, Industries CPQ, EPC, Order Management, TMF-aligned telco processes, integrations).
  • Identify candidate pools across multiple channels: LinkedIn, communities, referrals, GitHub (where relevant), niche groups, and targeted databases.
  • Produce role-specific Boolean strings and sourcing strategies per market (APAC + global).

2) Outreach & Pipeline Generation (Core)

  • Run high-quality outbound outreach (email/LinkedIn) with personalised messaging and structured follow-ups.
  • Manage outreach sequences, track response rates, and iterate messaging based on results.
  • Keep warm pipelines for recurring roles so we can move quickly when demand spikes.

3) Screening, Shortlisting & Candidate Packaging

  • Conduct initial screens (skills, domain fit, communication, availability, rate expectations).
  • Validate fundamentals relevant to the role (practical delivery experience, project context, what they actually built).
  • Produce a clear candidate brief for each shortlisted profile: summary, strengths, risks/concerns, rate, notice period, timezone, and interview availability.

4) Interview Coordination & Process Discipline

  • Schedule interviews, manage comms, collect feedback, and keep candidates engaged through the funnel.
  • Maintain clean recruiting ops: ATS/CRM updates, status tracking, notes, and weekly reporting.

5) Reporting & SLA Delivery

  • Weekly (or more frequent) reporting on: pipeline volume, outreach activity, response rates, shortlist progress, bottlenecks, and next actions.
  • Work to defined SLAs, including time-to-shortlist and pass-through quality.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years in technical recruiting or sourcing (agency or in-house), with proven outbound sourcing strength.
  • Demonstrated ability to recruit for enterprise software / cloud / systems integration roles (Salesforce ecosystem experience is strongly preferred).
  • Strong research skills: can independently find the right talent pools and build lists without being told where to look.
  • Excellent written English and professional communication (candidate-facing).
  • Highly organised: consistent tracking, documentation, and follow-through.
  • Comfortable working directly with a founder and operating with high autonomy.

Strongly Preferred (Nice-to-Have)

  • Experience recruiting in Salesforce (especially Salesforce Industries / Vlocity / Communications Cloud).
  • Familiarity with telco delivery contexts (BSS/OSS, order-to-activation, TMF concepts).
  • Experience recruiting both contract and permanent roles across multiple regions/time zones.
  • Ability to use recruiting tools efficiently (ATS/CRM, sourcing automation, basic sequencing).

Tools & Workflow

We'll aligned on a simple operating rhythm and toolset (we can provide access where needed). You should be comfortable with:

  • LinkedIn, email outreach, spreadsheets/CRM discipline
  • ATS/CRM
  • Clear weekly reporting and pipeline dashboards

Work Hours / Overlap

  • Remote offshore role
  • Minimum 3-4 hours overlap daily with Sydney (AEDT/AEST) for intake, calibration, and fast feedback loops

What We Value

  • Independence + reliability (we need someone who just gets it done)
  • Proof-driven recruiting (signal over volume; quality shortlists)
  • Candidate experience (professional, responsive, respectful)
  • Process discipline (clean data, clear notes, consistent reporting)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work remotely
  • Solid base compensation boosted by bonus and commission incentives
  • Working directly with an AI-savvy founder at an early stage of the company

Position Overview

The Chief Growth Officer (CGO) is responsible for driving the organization's overall growth strategy by identifying new business opportunities, expanding market presence, increasing revenue streams, and enhancing customer acquisition and retention. The CGO works cross-functionally across sales, marketing, partnerships, product, and operations to accelerate sustainable business growth and strengthen competitive positioning.

Key Responsibilities

Growth Strategy & Business Expansion

Develop and execute enterprise-wide growth strategies aligned with organizational objectives.

Identify new revenue opportunities, customer segments, and market expansion initiatives.

Drive sustainable growth through innovation, strategic partnerships, and business development.

Revenue Growth & Market Development

Lead initiatives to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Analyze market trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscapes to identify growth opportunities.

Develop go-to-market strategies for new products, services, and regions.

Customer Acquisition & Retention

Oversee customer acquisition, engagement, and retention strategies.

Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to optimize conversion funnels and customer journeys.

Drive initiatives that improve customer lifetime value and loyalty.

Sales & Marketing Alignment

Ensure alignment between sales, marketing, and business development functions.

Develop performance-driven campaigns and lead generation strategies.

Support brand positioning and market awareness initiatives.

Partnerships & Strategic Alliances

Build and manage strategic partnerships, alliances, and channel relationships.

Identify opportunities for collaborations, joint ventures, and ecosystem growth.

Strengthen relationships with key stakeholders and industry partners.

Data Analytics & Performance Optimization

Establish KPIs and dashboards to measure growth performance.

Use analytics and market intelligence to guide strategic decisions.

Continuously optimize acquisition, conversion, and revenue-generation efforts.

Innovation & Digital Transformation

Drive innovation initiatives and digital growth strategies.

Leverage technology, automation, and data tools to improve scalability and efficiency.

Stay informed on industry trends and emerging business models.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Collaborate with operations, finance, product, technology, and customer success teams.

Ensure organizational alignment toward growth objectives.

Lead high-impact strategic initiatives across departments.

Leadership & Team Development

Lead and mentor growth, marketing, sales, and business development teams.

Build a high-performance, results-oriented culture.

Foster innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, or related field; MBA preferred.

12–15+ years of experience in growth strategy, business development, sales, marketing, or executive leadership roles.

Proven track record of driving revenue growth and market expansion.

Strong understanding of customer acquisition, digital growth, and strategic partnerships.

Key Skills & Competencies

Strategic thinking and commercial acumen.

Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.

Expertise in growth marketing and revenue optimization.

Analytical and data-driven decision-making abilities.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Performance Metrics

Revenue growth and profitability.

Customer acquisition and retention rates.

Market share expansion.

Conversion and pipeline performance metrics.

Success of strategic partnerships and growth initiatives.

Senior Meta Ads Strategist and Media Buyer (Client-Facing)

Job Overview

MVR Digital is hiring a Senior Meta Ads Strategist and Media Buyer to own Meta strategy and execution for a portfolio of premium and luxury DTC brands. You will be in Ads Manager daily building, testing, and scaling campaigns. You will also set the strategy and defend it on client calls.

About MVR Digital

MVR Digital is a performance marketing agency working with premium and luxury DTC and e-commerce brands to grow profitably online. Adweek named us one of the Fastest Growing Agencies. We work across Meta, Google, TikTok, and Connected TV, plus email, creative, and landing pages. The team is fully remote, direct, and focused on results.

Our Values

  • Act Like an Owner
  • Clarity over Complexity
  • Serve Clients’ Best Interest
  • We Win Together, We Lose Together
  • Data-Informed, Human-Led

What Success Looks Like

Your mission is to run 4 to 5 client accounts, each at $100K+ a month in Meta spend, so that performance moves toward target without leadership in the daily details. In your first year:

  • By month 4, 80% or more of your accounts are green against their monthly goals
  • Zero client-seen launch errors each quarter
  • Every test closes with a written verdict in the change log
  • By month 3, fewer than 2 media questions a month reach leadership from your clients

What You Will Do

  • Own Meta strategy and daily execution across your accounts: build, structure, budget pacing, testing, and scaling
  • Manage $100K+ per month in Meta spend against MER, ROAS, and CPA targets
  • Configure and QA tracking yourself: pixel, CAPI, event quality, catalog, and feed health
  • Run structured creative testing. Brief creative, critique what comes back, and connect creative performance to your in-platform decisions
  • Support Google, TikTok, and other channels where they affect your accounts, and hold a point of view on cross-channel budget allocation
  • Lead the Meta portion of client calls. Explain performance clearly, bring a recommendation, and push back when a request will not serve the client

What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of hands-on paid social at an agency or high-growth brand
  • Deep Meta expertise: Advantage+, CBO, signal quality, CAPI, and incrementality
  • Personally owned $100K+ monthly Meta budgets with documented efficiency gains
  • DTC or e-commerce ownership. Premium or luxury AOV experience is a strong differentiator
  • Working Google Ads knowledge. You do not need Google depth, but you can speak to it credibly
  • GA4, Looker Studio, Shopify, and attribution fluency
  • Fluent, confident English and strong client communication. This role is client-facing
  • Comfortable managing multiple accounts in a fast-moving remote environment

Role Details

  • Full-time independent contractor
  • Fully remote. Based in the US or Canada, with overlap with US time zones for client calls

Perks

  • Paid time off
  • Paid company holidays
  • Flexible Fridays
  • Remote-first collaboration
  • Quarterly bonus opportunities
Salary: Contract: $4000-$5500/month USD

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un.e Architecte logiciel pour concevoir et améliorer des composantes clés de l’infrastructure de développement et de livraison logicielle d’Intelerad. Dans ce rôle, vous transformerez les meilleures pratiques DevOps et cloud-native en pipelines, solutions d’automatisation et outils fiables qui permettront aux équipes de R&D de livrer des logiciels de haute qualité dans un environnement de soins de santé réglementé.

Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec les architectes principaux et les équipes de développement, en assumant la responsabilité technique des composantes qui vous sont confiées tout en développant progressivement une vision plus large de la plateforme.

Principales responsabilités:

  • Concevoir et livrer des composantes de plateforme : Assumer la conception, et l’amélioration de composantes définies du système de compilation et de la plateforme de livraison d’Intelerad. Veiller à ce que chaque composante respecte les exigences de performance, de fiabilité, de sécurité et de conformité.

  • Soutenir les équipes de développement : Accompagner les équipes dans l’adoption des pipelines CI/CD, de l’automatisation de l’infrastructure et de l’orchestration de conteneurs basée sur Kubernetes. Résoudre les enjeux techniques qui freinent la livraison des solutions.

  • Développer des fonctionnalités selon les standards architecturaux : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des fonctionnalités au sein des produits d’Intelerad en appliquant les modèles de conception établis, tout en équilibrant la qualité, la fonctionnalité et le respect des échéanciers.

  • Contribuer à l’orientation technique : Collaborer avec les architectes principaux et les dirigeants de la R&D sur les feuilles de route de la plateforme, l’évaluation des outils et les décisions architecturales. Documenter les normes et partager les connaissances afin d’accroître les capacités de l’équipe.

  • Planifier et assurer le suivi des livrables : Définir la portée des travaux, recueillir les exigences et estimer les efforts requis pour les initiatives sous votre responsabilité. Fournir des mises à jour précises sur l’avancement des travaux tout en conciliant les projets en cours et la maintenance continue de la plateforme.

Qualifications et expérience:

  • Baccalauréat en génie, en informatique ou expérience équivalente.
  • +3 ans d’expérience professionnelle à titre d’architecte logiciel, incluant :
    • le déploiement et l’exploitation d’applications conteneurisées à l’aide de Kubernetes;
    • la conception, le développement ou la maintenance de pipelines CI/CD et de processus de livraison logicielle.
  • Connaissance de l’environnement Microsoft et des technologies Azure.
  • Expérience de travail dans des environnements Linux/Unix, incluant l’utilisation de scripts shell.
  • Expérience pratique avec les services AWS (par exemple : EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch).
  • Bonne connaissance des modèles de conception logicielle (design patterns) et des principes d’architecture logicielle.
  • Expérience de travail au sein d’équipes Agile/Scrum.

Qualifications privilégiées et exigences particulières:

  • Expérience avec des outils d’infrastructure as code (IaC) tels que Terraform, Ansible ou des solutions équivalentes.
  • Expérience dans le développement de solutions de type Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) ou Platform as a Service (PaaS).
  • Connaissance des logiciels de technologies de l’information en santé ou des environnements de développement réglementés.
  • Expérience en développement Web ou avec des technologies full stack.

La présente description de poste ne constitue pas une liste exhaustive des tâches ou des exigences. Intelerad se réserve le droit de la modifier en tout temps.

Le salaire de base pour ce poste varie entre $93,750 - 125,000 /yr CAD. Le salaire peut varier en fonction des connaissances, des compétences et de l'expérience liées au poste. Job Title: Remote Industrial Automation Consultant

Hiring Company: The Hive Careers
Client: One of our leading FMCG manufacturing clients (based in the Caribbean)
Location: Remote (Site visits may be required)
Employment Type: Contract / Project-Based

About the Client

Our client is a well-established and rapidly growing FMCG manufacturing company in the Caribbean region. With an ambition to scale operations through smart manufacturing, the company is undergoing a digital transformation and seeks to upgrade its plant through industrial automation and Industry 4.0 integration.

About the Role

The Hive Careers is seeking a highly skilled Industrial Automation Consultant to join our team on a remote contract basis and work with one of our FMCG clients. This role involves leading the assessment, design, and deployment of automation technologies to optimize manufacturing efficiency, reduce downtime, and enhance product quality.

This is a remote-first role, but occasional on-site travel may be required during critical phases of implementation (travel expenses covered).

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct a remote audit of existing manufacturing systems and identify automation opportunities.
  • Design and propose automation workflows across production, refrigeration, packaging, and quality assurance.
  • Develop and guide deployment of PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems, coordinating with local teams.
  • Implement IoT-based predictive maintenance systems for equipment health monitoring.
  • Integrate AI-driven vision systems for automated quality control using smart cameras.
  • Enable ERP and MES system integration to create a unified, intelligent production environment.
  • Ensure food safety and compliance throughout the automation design and rollout.
  • Provide comprehensive documentation and remote training to client teams.
  • Offer ongoing virtual consultation, support, and system optimization.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Mechatronics, Automation, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in industrial automation, preferably in FMCG or food production.
  • Advanced knowledge of PLC programming (e.g., Siemens, Allen Bradley), and SCADA/HMI systems.
  • Experience with remote automation consulting, including supporting on-site teams.
  • Strong understanding of industrial IoT, sensor integration, and control system architecture.
  • Familiarity with food-grade automation and hygiene compliance standards.

Preferred Expertise

  • Experience automating dairy, ice cream, beverage, or frozen food production environments.
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML-powered visual inspection systems.
  • Experience integrating with ERP and MES platforms for process visibility and control.
  • Familiarity with Industry 4.0 tools and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in remote settings.

Engagement Details

  • Duration: 36 months (extendable)
  • Working Style: Remote-first with possible short-term site visits
  • Timezone Flexibility: Caribbean (GMT-5) collaboration required

By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.

Job Description:

*Remote work may be considered for the right candidate based on qualifications, experience, and business needs.

Who You'll Work With

At Design Group, you'll collaborate with experienced leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to solve complex challenges for some of the world's leading companies. You'll join a growing team of more than 1,500 professionals across 45 U.S. offices where you'll be empowered to make an impact, develop your expertise, and grow your career.


What You'll Do

In this role, you'll be responsible for leading contract negotiation and risk management for Design Group's design and construction projects. You'll work closely with the Executive Team, Project Leadership, Procurement, insurers, and outside counsel to negotiate complex agreements, guide practical risk decisions, and support project teams from kickoff through close-out. This position plays an important role in protecting client trust and supporting responsible growth across our architecture, engineering, and construction management entities, giving you the opportunity to influence strategy at both project and enterprise levels.


  • Negotiate complex design, EPC, design-build, and construction management contracts with clients and project partners
  • Draft and revise AIA, EJCDC, ConsensusDocs, DBIA, and owner-drafted agreements to align with business and project needs
  • Lead contract negotiations in partnership with the Executive Team, Project Leadership, and Procurement
  • Maintain the firm's contract and template library to support consistency and speed in deal execution
  • Advise project teams on risk mitigation, project selection, and delivery methodology
  • Support business development through proactive contract strategy and direct client engagement
  • Guide project teams through legal and risk considerations from kickoff through close-out
  • Manage dispute resolution matters, including client discussions, liens, mediation, arbitration, litigation, and settlements
  • Coordinate with insurers and outside counsel on professional liability, builder's risk, and construction-specific insurance matters
  • Support licensing, corporate governance, and risk management strategy across Design Group entities

What You'll Bring

Qualifications

• JD from an accredited law school

  • Licensed to practice law in at least one U.S. state
  • 5+ years of legal experience supporting construction, commercial contracts, or project delivery work
  • Experience drafting and negotiating design-build, EPC, and construction management contracts
  • Working knowledge of construction insurance, including professional liability, and ability to travel up to 15%

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with architecture, engineering, construction management, or EPC organizations
  • Experience with AIA, EJCDC, ConsensusDocs, DBIA, or owner-drafted contract forms

​

About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

Job Specification: UI Engineer - Mocks and Wireframes Specialist

Location: Remote

Position Type: Permanent

Job Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled UI Engineer with expertise in creating mockups, wireframes, and interfaces for data-driven applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for translating design concepts into visually appealing and functional user interfaces. This role requires a strong understanding of user experience (UX) principles, proficiency in designing mockups and wireframes, and the ability to interface with APIs for seamless data integration.

Key Responsibilities:

Mockup and Wireframe Design:

  • Develop high-fidelity mockups and interactive wireframes that align with the project requirements and design guidelines.

  • Collaborate closely with UX designers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand user needs and business objectives.

Interface Design:

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, user-friendly features and products using TypeScript, React and TailwindCSS.

  • Create intuitive, scalable, and high-performance user experiences through interactive UI components and effective application state management.

  • Implement responsive design principles to ensure compatibility across various devices and screen sizes.

Data Integration:

  • Interface with APIs to integrate data seamlessly into the user interface.

  • Collaborate with backend developers to understand data structures and optimize data presentation within the UI.

Prototyping:

  • Create interactive prototypes to demonstrate the flow and functionality of the proposed user interfaces.

  • Gather feedback from stakeholders and iterate on designs to achieve optimal results.

Usability Testing:

  • Conduct usability testing on prototypes and finalized interfaces, incorporating user feedback into design improvements.

  • Stay informed about industry best practices and emerging trends in UI/UX design.

Documentation:

  • Document design decisions, guidelines, and specifications to ensure consistency and clarity for development teams.

  • Work with cross-functional teams to maintain design documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

Qualifications:

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, React, TailwindCSS and extensive experience building complex web applications with React.js.

  • Proficiency in design tools such as Sketch, Figma, or Adobe XD.

  • Experience working with APIs and integrating data into user interfaces.

  • Knowledge of user-centered design principles and usability testing methodologies.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate ideas and collaborate effectively across teams.

If you are passionate about creating visually stunning and user-centric interfaces while excelling in collaborative environments, we invite you to apply for this exciting UI Engineer position. Join our team and contribute to building cutting-edge data-driven applications that redefine user experiences.

Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information.

Location: Remote Germany, Germany

We Say HI*

Customer Engineer Pre-Sales (w/m/d)

Thales ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Spitzentechnologien für die Bereiche Verteidigung, Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Cyber Security und Digital Identity.

Deutsche Unternehmen und die öffentlichen Verwaltungen hierzulande sind bereit, ihre digitale Transformation und den Einsatz von KI zu beschleunigen – aber sie werden niemals Kompromisse bei der Sicherheit ihrer sensibelsten Daten eingehen. Genau hier setzen wir als Thales Deutschland in Partnerschaft mit Google Cloud und unserem neuen, in Gründung befindlichen Unternehmen an. Mit einer neuen, zu 100 % deutschen Unternehmenseinheit geben wir eine konkrete Antwort auf die strengen Anforderungen des BSI. Was wir hier schaffen, ist eine lokal und vollständig autonom betriebene ‚Trusted Cloud‘. Sie ermöglicht den Zugriff auf das breiteste Service-Portfolio am Markt, während alles strikt unter europäischer Gerichtsbarkeit bleibt. Durch die Zusammenführung deutscher und französischer Standards wie SecNumCloud, C5 und C3-A bieten wir unseren Kunden eine beispiellose Resilienz und Business Continuity. Dies ist ein Wendepunkt für unsere Branche und ein entscheidender Schritt hin zu einem starken, souveränen digitalen Europa.

Ihre Mission als Customer Engineer:

  • Übernahme von Verantwortung als zentrale Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen internen Engineering-Teams und Kunden zur technischen Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung von Cloud-Lösungen aus dem Google Cloud Services-Portfolio
  • Konzeption und Durchführung von technischen Deep-Dive-Workshopsfür strategische Kunden, insbesondere zu Themen wie Verschlüsselung und technischer Umsetzung
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Customer Success Management (CSM) zur Förderung der aktiven Workload-Nutzung und zur Unterstützung bei der Erreichung von Cloud-Zielen
  • Unterstützung bei Implementierung, Troubleshooting und technischer Problemlösung sowie Reduzierung langfristiger Abhängigkeiten von Managed Services
  • Nutzung, Anpassung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender technischer Dokumentationen und Google-Reseller-Guides sowie aktiver Wissenstransfer innerhalb der technischen Organisation

Darauf freuen wir uns:

  • Erfahrung im technischen Pre-Sales sowie in der Präsentation von Cloud-Lösungen, der Bearbeitung von Ausschreibungen und der technischen Kundenberatung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Cloud-Architektur und mit Infrastruktur-Migrationen, insbesondere im Bereich Landing Zones
  • Expertise im Bereich technischer Souveränität, insbesondere hinsichtlich Datenresidenz, operativer Autonomie und relevanter Standards wie C5, C3A und ISO 27001
  • Fähigkeit zur Analyse und Klassifizierung von Kunden-Workloads sowie zur Bewertung von Anforderungen und Risiken im Kontext von Mission- und Business-Critical Workloads
  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code (IaC) und der Übertragung bzw. Anpassung von Workloads aus der Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in Dedicated-Cloud-Umgebungen
  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands ür regelmäßige Workshops, Team-Meetings und Kunden-Besuche

Thales investiert jährlich mehr als 4,5 Milliarden Euro in Forschung und Entwicklung in Schlüsseltechnologien wie künstliche Intelligenz, Cybersicherheit, Quanten- und Cloud-Technologien.

Im Jahr 2025 erwirtschaftete die Gruppe einen Umsatz von 22,1 Milliarden Euro.

Für mehr als 85.000 Mitarbeitende in 65 Ländern eröffnen wir zukunftsweisende Perspektiven, verwirklichen individuelle Karrierewege und ermöglichen kreative Freiräume. Dies gelingt durch Mut, Vielfalt und den festen Willen, die anspruchsvollen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit sicherer und inklusiver zu gestalten. Mit unserer nachhaltigen, werteorientierten Personalführung treten wir aktiv für Diversität ein.

Say HI* – Ihr Weg zu uns

Job Title: Data Engineering Manager - (GCP, AI/ML & GenAI)

Experience: 15+ Years

Location: Remote (USA)

Primary Focus: GCP Data Engineering & AWS, AI/ML & GenAI

Note: Preferrably we are looking for hands on experience as a Head of Engineering/ Engineering manager in GCP Platform and if you are currently working as a Senior/Lead Data Engineer then your profile is not suitable for the current requirement.

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager with strong hands-on expertise in AWS and GCP Data Engineering to lead a large-scale AWS-to-GCP data platform migration.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience designing enterprise data platforms on AWS and migrating them to Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The role requires a combination of technical architecture, hands-on engineering, migration leadership, team management and stakeholder management.

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience with AWS services such as S3, Glue, Redshift, Athena, Step Functions and AWS DMS, along with strong GCP expertise across BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage and Cloud Composer.

The Engineering Manager will work closely with US-based stakeholders, architects, engineers, DevOps teams, Data Science and BI teams to define the migration strategy and ensure successful execution.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI/ML, Generative AI & MLOps

  • Design and implement AI/ML and Generative AI solutions on GCP using Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, and related GCP-native services.
  • Build production-grade machine learning pipelines for data preparation, model training, validation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle management.
  • Develop Generative AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, including enterprise search, document intelligence, AI assistants, summarization, semantic search, embeddings, vector search, and knowledge-management applications.
  • Design scalable ingestion, transformation, chunking, embedding, indexing, and retrieval pipelines for structured and unstructured enterprise data.
  • Implement MLOps practices using Vertex AI Pipelines, Model Registry, model endpoints, Terraform, GitHub, Cloud Build, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Establish standards for model versioning, experiment tracking, data and feature validation, automated testing, deployment approvals, rollback, and environment promotion.
  • Implement monitoring for model performance, data drift, latency, reliability, inference cost, response quality, retrieval accuracy, and GenAI risks such as hallucination and prompt injection.
  • Ensure responsible AI, data privacy, security, governance, access control, auditability, and human-review processes are incorporated into AI/ML and GenAI solutions.
  • Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Product, BI, Security, and US-based stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-value AI/ML and GenAI use cases.

2. GCP Data Platform Architecture

Architect and implement scalable enterprise data platforms on GCP.

Design Data Lake and Lakehouse architectures using GCS and BigQuery.

Define Bronze, Silver and Gold/Atomic data layers.

Design scalable data ingestion, transformation and consumption frameworks.

Establish standards for data modeling, partitioning, clustering and storage.

Design multi-tenant and multi-location data architectures.

Define schema-on-read and schema-on-write strategies.

3. AWS Data Platform Expertise

Analyze and optimize existing AWS data platforms before migration.

Work with:

Amazon S3

AWS Glue

AWS Glue Data Quality

Amazon Redshift / Redshift Serverless

Amazon Athena

AWS Step Functions

AWS DMS

AWS Lake Formation

Understand existing AWS ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, workloads and dependencies.

Identify equivalent or improved GCP services for each AWS workload.

Prepare technical mapping and migration plans between AWS and GCP services.

4. GCP Streaming & Real-Time Data Engineering

Architect real-time data pipelines using:

Google Pub/Sub

Dataflow / Apache Beam

BigQuery

Cloud Storage

Design high-volume event ingestion, enrichment and transformation pipelines.

Implement event-driven architectures and appropriate delivery guarantees.

Optimize streaming pipelines for latency, throughput and scalability.

Design BigQuery streaming ingestion patterns.

Implement monitoring, logging and alerting for real-time workloads.

5. ETL / ELT & Data Processing

Design and implement scalable batch and real-time ETL/ELT pipelines.

Migrate AWS Glue-based pipelines to appropriate GCP services.

Develop transformation frameworks using:

Python

PySpark

SQL

Dataflow / Apache Beam

BigQuery

dbt

Design CDC pipelines and real-time ingestion patterns.

Build orchestration workflows using Cloud Composer / Airflow.

Optimize data processing jobs and query performance.

6. AWS to GCP Migration Leadership

Lead the end-to-end migration of enterprise data platforms from AWS to GCP.

Assess existing AWS architecture, data pipelines, workloads, dependencies and operational processes.

Define the target-state GCP architecture and migration roadmap.

Develop migration strategies for:

Amazon S3 → Google Cloud Storage

Amazon Redshift → BigQuery

AWS Glue → Dataflow / Dataproc / BigQuery

AWS Step Functions → Cloud Composer / Workflows

AWS DMS → GCP-native CDC solutions

Amazon Athena → BigQuery

Identify opportunities to modernize AWS workloads rather than performing a simple lift-and-shift migration.

Define migration phases, technical dependencies, risks and rollback strategies.

Lead architecture reviews and technical design discussions.

7. Data Modeling & BigQuery

Design enterprise data models for analytics and reporting.

Define dimensional, normalized and denormalized data models.

Develop multi-tenant data structures.

Design BigQuery partitioning and clustering strategies.

Optimize BigQuery SQL and query execution.

Design data models supporting both real-time and batch workloads.

Work closely with BI and Analytics teams to create scalable consumption models.

8. Data Governance, Security & Quality

Establish data governance and data quality standards across the GCP platform.

Implement automated data quality checks and validation frameworks.

Establish data lineage, metadata and ownership standards.

Ensure appropriate security controls across all GCP data layers.

Implement:

IAM

Least-privilege access

Encryption

Service accounts

Network security

Data access policies

Work with governance and security teams to ensure compliance requirements are met.

Experience with Dataplex, Data Catalog and data lineage is preferred.

9. DevOps, Infrastructure & Automation

Lead infrastructure automation using Terraform.

Build repeatable and secure GCP infrastructure deployments.

Implement CI/CD pipelines for data engineering workloads.

Work with:

Terraform

Git

GitHub

Cloud Build

CI/CD pipelines

Automate data pipeline deployment, testing and infrastructure provisioning.

Establish Dev, QA, UAT and Production deployment standards.

10. Performance & Cost Optimization

Lead performance optimization initiatives across GCP data workloads.

Optimize:

BigQuery query performance

Partitioning and clustering

Dataflow pipelines

Spark workloads

Cloud Storage

Streaming workloads

Analyze AWS workloads and determine the most cost-effective GCP architecture.

Develop cloud FinOps and cost optimization strategies.

Establish performance benchmarks and SLAs for critical workloads.

11. Engineering Management & Team Leadership

Lead and mentor a team of Data Engineers, Senior Data Engineers and Technical Leads.

Provide technical direction and establish engineering standards.

Conduct architecture and code reviews.

Define technical roadmaps and engineering priorities.

Break complex migration requirements into actionable deliverables.

Track engineering progress, risks, dependencies and delivery milestones.

Promote best practices around coding, testing, CI/CD, security and documentation.

Mentor engineers on GCP, data architecture and modern data engineering practices.

12. Stakeholder & Client Management

Act as the primary technical point of contact for US-based stakeholders.

Work closely with Business, Product, Data Science, BI and DevOps teams.

Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

Present architecture decisions, migration strategies and technical roadmaps.

Communicate technical risks, dependencies, timelines and trade-offs.

Collaborate with business teams to define operational and analytical KPIs.

Tasks

  • 15+ years of experience in GCP Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Cloud Engineering, AI/ML Engineering, or related technology leadership roles.
  • 5+ years of strong hands-on GCP Data Engineering Experience.
  • 3+ years of strong hands-on AI/ML & Gen AI Experience.
  • Proven experience delivering AWS-to-GCP migration projects.
  • Strong experience designing enterprise Data Lake and Lakehouse platforms on GCP.
  • Strong hands-on experience with BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, IAM, and Terraform.
  • Experience migrating AWS data workloads, pipelines, and platforms to GCP.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS and GCP service mapping, migration patterns, modernization strategies, and cloud architecture best practices.
  • Experience designing, building, and deploying AI/ML solutions on GCP using Vertex AI.
  • Hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLM-based applications, RAG architectures, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, and enterprise AI assistants.
  • Strong understanding of MLOps, including model training, model registry, CI/CD/CT, model deployment, monitoring, retraining, governance, and rollback strategies.
  • Experience implementing secure and responsible AI solutions, including data privacy, model evaluation, access controls, auditability, and governance.
  • Expert-level SQL and strong Python and PySpark skills.
  • Strong data modeling, data warehousing, batch processing, and real-time data engineering experience.
  • Experience with Terraform, Git, GitHub, Cloud Build, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation.
  • Experience managing and mentoring data engineering and cross-functional technical teams.
  • Strong communication skills with experience working with US-based stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer certification.

  • Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification.
  • Experience with Vertex AI Agent Builder, Vertex AI Search, Gemini models on Vertex AI, or enterprise Generative AI platforms.
  • Experience with dbt, Apache Airflow, Kafka, Apache Spark, Kubernetes, Cloud Run, and API-driven architectures.
  • Experience with Dataplex, Data Catalog, data lineage, metadata management, data governance, master data management, and data-quality frameworks.
  • Experience supporting enterprise or regulated environments with strong data privacy, security, compliance, audit, and governance requirements.

Requirements

Required Technical Skills:

AIML & GenAI Technology Skills

AI/ML: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, NLP, Deep Learning, ML AlgorithmsGenerative AI: GenAI, LLMs, GPT, Gemini, Claude, Llama, Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning
RAG: RAG, Embeddings, Vector Databases, Semantic Search, Hybrid Search, Reranking
LLM Frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, Hugging Face, Transformers
Agentic AI: AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, Tool/Function Calling, Multi-Agent Systems, MCP
MLOps: MLflow, Kubeflow, Model Registry, Model Deployment, Monitoring, CI/CD
GCP / Vertex AI: Vertex AI, Vertex AI Studio, Gemini, Vertex AI Pipelines, Model Garden, Vector Search
AI Application Development: Python, FastAPI, Flask, REST APIs, SQL, Docker, Kubernetes
Cloud & Data: GCP/AWS/Azure, BigQuery, Dataflow, Spark, Databricks, Data Lakes
AI Evaluation & Security: LLM/RAG Evaluation, Ragas, LangSmith, Guardrails, AI Governance & Security

Data Engineering Skills

Cloud Platforms: GCP, AWS, BigQuery, GCS, AWS S3, Pub/Sub, AWS KinesisData Engineering: Advanced Python, Expert SQL, PySpark, Apache Spark, ETL, ELT, CDC

Location: Remote (Nashville/Southern California) | Approximately 50% Travel

Salary Range: $80,000–$90,000 annually

About TMC Hospitality

TMC Hospitality is a hospitality management and development company dedicated to creating thoughtfully designed destinations that bring people together through exceptional experiences, memorable spaces, and genuine hospitality.

Our portfolio includes Drift Hotels, Bode, Maleza Restaurants, and Buttonwood Farm & Winery—each with its own unique identity but united by a commitment to design, culture, and community. From boutique hotels and destination restaurants to vineyards and event venues, we create places that inspire connection and celebrate a sense of place.

At Drift, we blend minimalist design with authentic local experiences, creating hotels that feel both elevated and approachable. At Bode, we reimagine group travel by combining the comforts of home with the amenities and service of a boutique hotel. Maleza brings together vibrant hospitality, thoughtful cuisine, and community-driven experiences, while Buttonwood offers a distinctive wine country destination rooted in agriculture, events, and hospitality.

With properties in California, Tennessee, and Baja California Sur, TMC Hospitality continues to grow while remaining focused on one core belief: hospitality should feel personal, intentional, and unforgettable.

If you're passionate about creating exceptional guest experiences and want to be part of a team that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous growth, we'd love to meet you.

About the role

TMC Hospitality is seeking a creative and driven Social Media & Content Manager to lead social media and content creation across our growing portfolio of boutique hotels, restaurants, bars, and experiences, including Drift, Bode, Maleza, and Buttonwood.

This role will oversee 10+ social media accounts, bringing each brand's unique identity to life through compelling storytelling, photography, video, and engaging digital content. The ideal candidate is a hands-on content creator and strategic thinker who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced hospitality environment.

This is a remote position based in Nashville or Southern California, requiring approximately 50% travel to our properties for content creation, events, and brand initiatives.

What you'll do

  • Develop and execute social media strategies across multiple hospitality brands, maintaining distinct brand voices and consistent engagement.
  • Manage social media accounts, content calendars, publishing schedules, and community engagement across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn.
  • Capture, produce, and edit high-quality photography, short-form videos, Reels, and other creative assets showcasing our properties, dining experiences, events, and destinations.
  • Plan and execute organic and paid social campaigns that drive brand awareness, website traffic, hotel bookings, dining reservations, and event attendance.
  • Develop and manage blog and editorial content, incorporating storytelling, local experiences, and SEO best practices.
  • Collaborate with property leadership, food and beverage teams, and marketing partners to support promotions, events, seasonal campaigns, and brand initiatives.
  • Identify and coordinate influencer partnerships, user-generated content, and creative collaborations that align with our brands.
  • Track and analyze social media performance, engagement, audience growth, and campaign effectiveness to inform ongoing strategy.
  • Travel regularly to properties for content production, photoshoots, and events, including occasional evenings and weekends.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in social media management, content creation, or digital marketing, preferably managing multiple brands or accounts.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating original photography, videography, video editing, copywriting, and successful social media campaigns.
  • Proficiency with social media platforms, content creation and editing software, scheduling tools, and performance analytics.
  • Experience managing paid social campaigns and using data to optimize engagement and results.
  • Strong creative instincts, storytelling ability, and attention to detail, with the ability to adapt content to different brand identities.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to independently manage competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Passion for hospitality, travel, food and beverage, design, and local culture.
  • Experience with influencer partnerships, blogging, SEO, or website publishing is a plus.
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 50% of the time, including occasional evening and weekend commitments.

To apply: Please submit your resume and a portfolio or examples of social media accounts you've managed, highlighting original photography, video, written content, and measurable results.

raw.description:
Nous sommes à la recherche d’un.e Architecte logiciel pour concevoir et améliorer des composantes clés de l’infrastructure de développement et de livraison logicielle d’Intelerad. Dans ce rôle, vous transformerez les meilleures pratiques DevOps et cloud-native en pipelines, solutions d’automatisation et outils fiables qui permettront aux équipes de R&D de livrer des logiciels de haute qualité dans un environnement de soins de santé réglementé.

Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec les architectes principaux et les équipes de développement, en assumant la responsabilité technique des composantes qui vous sont confiées tout en développant progressivement une vision plus large de la plateforme.

Principales responsabilités:

  • Concevoir et livrer des composantes de plateforme : Assumer la conception, et l’amélioration de composantes définies du système de compilation et de la plateforme de livraison d’Intelerad. Veiller à ce que chaque composante respecte les exigences de performance, de fiabilité, de sécurité et de conformité.

  • Soutenir les équipes de développement : Accompagner les équipes dans l’adoption des pipelines CI/CD, de l’automatisation de l’infrastructure et de l’orchestration de conteneurs basée sur Kubernetes. Résoudre les enjeux techniques qui freinent la livraison des solutions.

  • Développer des fonctionnalités selon les standards architecturaux : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des fonctionnalités au sein des produits d’Intelerad en appliquant les modèles de conception établis, tout en équilibrant la qualité, la fonctionnalité et le respect des échéanciers.

  • Contribuer à l’orientation technique : Collaborer avec les architectes principaux et les dirigeants de la R&D sur les feuilles de route de la plateforme, l’évaluation des outils et les décisions architecturales. Documenter les normes et partager les connaissances afin d’accroître les capacités de l’équipe.

  • Planifier et assurer le suivi des livrables : Définir la portée des travaux, recueillir les exigences et estimer les efforts requis pour les initiatives sous votre responsabilité. Fournir des mises à jour précises sur l’avancement des travaux tout en conciliant les projets en cours et la maintenance continue de la plateforme.

Qualifications et expérience:

  • Baccalauréat en génie, en informatique ou expérience équivalente.
  • +3 ans d’expérience professionnelle à titre d’architecte logiciel, incluant :
    • le déploiement et l’exploitation d’applications conteneurisées à l’aide de Kubernetes;
    • la conception, le développement ou la maintenance de pipelines CI/CD et de processus de livraison logicielle.
  • Connaissance de l’environnement Microsoft et des technologies Azure.
  • Expérience de travail dans des environnements Linux/Unix, incluant l’utilisation de scripts shell.
  • Expérience pratique avec les services AWS (par exemple : EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch).
  • Bonne connaissance des modèles de conception logicielle (design patterns) et des principes d’architecture logicielle.
  • Expérience de travail au sein d’équipes Agile/Scrum.

Qualifications privilégiées et exigences particulières:

  • Expérience avec des outils d’infrastructure as code (IaC) tels que Terraform, Ansible ou des solutions équivalentes.
  • Expérience dans le développement de solutions de type Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) ou Platform as a Service (PaaS).
  • Connaissance des logiciels de technologies de l’information en santé ou des environnements de développement réglementés.
  • Expérience en développement Web ou avec des technologies full stack.

La présente description de poste ne constitue pas une liste exhaustive des tâches ou des exigences. Intelerad se réserve le droit de la modifier en tout temps.

Le salaire de base pour ce poste varie entre $93,750 - 125,000 /yr CAD. Le salaire peut varier en fonction des connaissances, des compétences et de l'expérience liées au poste. Intelerad est une entreprise qui offre une rémunération globale. Le salaire dépend du poste proposé. Des bonus et d'autres formes de rémunération peuvent être accordés dans le cadre d'un programme de rémunération globale, en plus d'une gamme complète d'avantages sociaux médicaux, financiers, de retraite, de congés payés et/ou autres.

Tous les candidats répondant aux qualifications minimales devront effectuer une évaluation en ligne de 30 minutes dans le cadre de leur candidature.

Tous vos renseignements seront gardés confidentiels conformément aux lignes directrices de l'EEO.

Intelerad is committed to the principles of equal employment. We are committed to complying with all federal, state and local laws providing equal employment opportunities and all other employment laws and regulations. Applicants, employees and former employees are protected from employment discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age , disability and genetic information (including family medical history). Intelerad is dedicated to the fulfillment of this policy regarding all aspects of employment, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, placement, transfer, training, promotion, rates of pay, and other compensation, termination, and all other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment.

 

Intelerad is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity for qualified individuals with disabilities. Intelerad uses the Americans with Disabilities Act (“ADA”)as a standard for global recruiting and hiring purposes. This prohibits discrimination against qualified individuals with disabilities. The ADA defines “disability” as a physical or mental impairment that substantially limits one or more of the major life activities of an individual, a record of such impairment, or being regarded as having such an impairment

Chez Intelerad, nous croyons que le chemin vers les réponses en matière de soins de santé doit être clair, que vous attendiez un diagnostic ou que vous essayiez d'en accélérer un. Nos solutions d’imagerie médicale rationalisent le flux d’informations, simplifient les processus complexes, maximisent l’efficacité et mettent en lumière l’inconnu. Nous permettons aux médecins d'apporter aux patients les réponses dont ils ont besoin plus rapidement et d'améliorer les résultats pour tous. Grâce à une imagerie plus accessible, on sort les patients de l’obscurité.

Basée à Raleigh, en Caroline du Nord, et à Montréal, Intelerad compte près de 800 employés dans des bureaux répartis dans quatre pays. L'entreprise offre à près de 2 000 organisations de soins de santé à travers le monde la rapidité, l'évolutivité et la simplicité nécessaires pour augmenter les performances de l'entreprise tout en, surtout, en améliorant les résultats des patients. Les solutions d'entreprise modernes d'Intelerad ont été récompensées par le prix « Best in KLAS », se classant à la première place dans la catégorie « PACS Europe (UK/Irlande) » du rapport « Best in KLAS : Global Software (Non-US) » de 2026.

Job Title: Remote Industrial Automation Consultant

Hiring Company: The Hive Careers
Client: One of our leading FMCG manufacturing clients (based in the Caribbean)
Location: Remote (Site visits may be required)
Employment Type: Contract / Project-Based

About the Client

Our client is a well-established and rapidly growing FMCG manufacturing company in the Caribbean region. With an ambition to scale operations through smart manufacturing, the company is undergoing a digital transformation and seeks to upgrade its plant through industrial automation and Industry 4.0 integration.

About the Role

The Hive Careers is seeking a highly skilled Industrial Automation Consultant to join our team on a remote contract basis and work with one of our FMCG clients. This role involves leading the assessment, design, and deployment of automation technologies to optimize manufacturing efficiency, reduce downtime, and enhance product quality.

This is a remote-first role, but occasional on-site travel may be required during critical phases of implementation (travel expenses covered).

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct a remote audit of existing manufacturing systems and identify automation opportunities.
  • Design and propose automation workflows across production, refrigeration, packaging, and quality assurance.
  • Develop and guide deployment of PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems, coordinating with local teams.
  • Implement IoT-based predictive maintenance systems for equipment health monitoring.
  • Integrate AI-driven vision systems for automated quality control using smart cameras.
  • Enable ERP and MES system integration to create a unified, intelligent production environment.
  • Ensure food safety and compliance throughout the automation design and rollout.
  • Provide comprehensive documentation and remote training to client teams.
  • Offer ongoing virtual consultation, support, and system optimization.

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Mechatronics, Automation, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in industrial automation, preferably in FMCG or food production.
  • Advanced knowledge of PLC programming (e.g., Siemens, Allen Bradley), and SCADA/HMI systems.
  • Experience with remote automation consulting, including supporting on-site teams.
  • Strong understanding of industrial IoT, sensor integration, and control system architecture.
  • Familiarity with food-grade automation and hygiene compliance standards.

Preferred Expertise

  • Experience automating dairy, ice cream, beverage, or frozen food production environments.
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML-powered visual inspection systems.
  • Experience integrating with ERP and MES platforms for process visibility and control.
  • Familiarity with Industry 4.0 tools and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in remote settings.

Engagement Details

  • Duration: 36 months (extendable)
  • Working Style: Remote-first with possible short-term site visits
  • Timezone Flexibility: Caribbean (GMT-5) collaboration required

About Us:

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food & beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology.Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.

Job Description:

*Remote work may be considered for the right candidate based on qualifications, experience, and business needs.

Who You'll Work With

At Design Group, you'll collaborate with experienced leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to solve complex challenges for some of the world's leading companies. You'll join a growing team of more than 1,500 professionals across 45 U.S. offices where you'll be empowered to make an impact, develop your expertise, and grow your career.


What You'll Do

In this role, you'll be responsible for leading contract negotiation and risk management for Design Group's design and construction projects. You'll work closely with the Executive Team, Project Leadership, Procurement, insurers, and outside counsel to negotiate complex agreements, guide practical risk decisions, and support project teams from kickoff through close-out. This position plays an important role in protecting client trust and supporting responsible growth across our architecture, engineering, and construction management entities, giving you the opportunity to influence strategy at both project and enterprise levels.


  • Negotiate complex design, EPC, design-build, and construction management contracts with clients and project partners
  • Draft and revise AIA, EJCDC, ConsensusDocs, DBIA, and owner-drafted agreements to align with business and project needs
  • Lead contract negotiations in partnership with the Executive Team, Project Leadership, and Procurement
  • Maintain the firm's contract and template library to support consistency and speed in deal execution
  • Advise project teams on risk mitigation, project selection, and delivery methodology
  • Support business development through proactive contract strategy and direct client engagement
  • Guide project teams through legal and risk considerations from kickoff through close-out
  • Manage dispute resolution matters, including client discussions, liens, mediation, arbitration, litigation, and settlements
  • Coordinate with insurers and outside counsel on professional liability, builder's risk, and construction-specific insurance matters
  • Support licensing, corporate governance, and risk management strategy across Design Group entities

What You'll Bring

Qualifications

• JD from an accredited law school

  • Licensed to practice law in at least one U.S. state
  • 5+ years of legal experience supporting construction, commercial contracts, or project delivery work
  • Experience drafting and negotiating design-build, EPC, and construction management contracts
  • Working knowledge of construction insurance, including professional liability, and ability to travel up to 15%

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with architecture, engineering, construction management, or EPC organizations
  • Experience with AIA, EJCDC, ConsensusDocs, DBIA, or owner-drafted contract forms

About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

Job Specification: UI Engineer - Mocks and Wireframes Specialist

Location: Remote

Position Type: Permanent

Job Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled UI Engineer with expertise in creating mockups, wireframes, and interfaces for data-driven applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for translating design concepts into visually appealing and functional user interfaces. This role requires a strong understanding of user experience (UX) principles, proficiency in designing mockups and wireframes, and the ability to interface with APIs for seamless data integration.

Key Responsibilities:

Mockup and Wireframe Design:

  • Develop high-fidelity mockups and interactive wireframes that align with the project requirements and design guidelines.

  • Collaborate closely with UX designers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand user needs and business objectives.

Interface Design:

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, user-friendly features and products using TypeScript, React and TailwindCSS.

  • Create intuitive, scalable, and high-performance user experiences through interactive UI components and effective application state management.

  • Implement responsive design principles to ensure compatibility across various devices and screen sizes.

Data Integration:

  • Interface with APIs to integrate data seamlessly into the user interface.

  • Collaborate with backend developers to understand data structures and optimize data presentation within the UI.

Prototyping:

  • Create interactive prototypes to demonstrate the flow and functionality of the proposed user interfaces.

  • Gather feedback from stakeholders and iterate on designs to achieve optimal results.

Usability Testing:

  • Conduct usability testing on prototypes and finalized interfaces, incorporating user feedback into design improvements.

  • Stay informed about industry best practices and emerging trends in UI/UX design.

Documentation:

  • Document design decisions, guidelines, and specifications to ensure consistency and clarity for development teams.

  • Work with cross-functional teams to maintain design documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

Qualifications:

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, React, TailwindCSS and extensive experience building complex web applications with React.js.

  • Proficiency in design tools such as Sketch, Figma, or Adobe XD.

  • Experience working with APIs and integrating data into user interfaces.

  • Knowledge of user-centered design principles and usability testing methodologies.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate ideas and collaborate effectively across teams.

If you are passionate about creating visually stunning and user-centric interfaces while excelling in collaborative environments, we invite you to apply for this exciting UI Engineer position. Join our team and contribute to building cutting-edge data-driven applications that redefine user experiences.

Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information.

Location: Remote Germany, Germany

We Say HI*

Customer Engineer Pre-Sales (w/m/d)

Thales ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Spitzentechnologien für die Bereiche Verteidigung, Luft- und Raumfahrt sowie Cyber Security und Digital Identity.

Deutsche Unternehmen und die öffentlichen Verwaltungen hierzulande sind bereit, ihre digitale Transformation und den Einsatz von KI zu beschleunigen – aber sie werden niemals Kompromisse bei der Sicherheit ihrer sensibelsten Daten eingehen. Genau hier setzen wir als Thales Deutschland in Partnerschaft mit Google Cloud und unserem neuen, in Gründung befindlichen Unternehmen an. Mit einer neuen, zu 100 % deutschen Unternehmenseinheit geben wir eine konkrete Antwort auf die strengen Anforderungen des BSI. Was wir hier schaffen, ist eine lokal und vollständig autonom betriebene ‚Trusted Cloud‘. Sie ermöglicht den Zugriff auf das breiteste Service-Portfolio am Markt, während alles strikt unter europäischer Gerichtsbarkeit bleibt. Durch die Zusammenführung deutscher und französischer Standards wie SecNumCloud, C5 und C3-A bieten wir unseren Kunden eine beispiellose Resilienz und Business Continuity. Dies ist ein Wendepunkt für unsere Branche und ein entscheidender Schritt hin zu einem starken, souveränen digitalen Europa.

Ihre Mission als Customer Engineer:

  • Übernahme von Verantwortung als zentrale Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen internen Engineering-Teams und Kunden zur technischen Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung von Cloud-Lösungen aus dem Google Cloud Services-Portfolio
  • Konzeption und Durchführung von technischen Deep-Dive-Workshopsfür strategische Kunden, insbesondere zu Themen wie Verschlüsselung und technischer Umsetzung
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Customer Success Management (CSM) zur Förderung der aktiven Workload-Nutzung und zur Unterstützung bei der Erreichung von Cloud-Zielen
  • Unterstützung bei Implementierung, Troubleshooting und technischer Problemlösung sowie Reduzierung langfristiger Abhängigkeiten von Managed Services
  • Nutzung, Anpassung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender technischer Dokumentationen und Google-Reseller-Guides sowie aktiver Wissenstransfer innerhalb der technischen Organisation

Darauf freuen wir uns:

  • Erfahrung im technischen Pre-Sales sowie in der Präsentation von Cloud-Lösungen, der Bearbeitung von Ausschreibungen und der technischen Kundenberatung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Cloud-Architektur und mit Infrastruktur-Migrationen, insbesondere im Bereich Landing Zones
  • Expertise im Bereich technischer Souveränität, insbesondere hinsichtlich Datenresidenz, operativer Autonomie und relevanter Standards wie C5, C3A und ISO 27001
  • Fähigkeit zur Analyse und Klassifizierung von Kunden-Workloads sowie zur Bewertung von Anforderungen und Risiken im Kontext von Mission- und Business-Critical Workloads
  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code (IaC) und der Übertragung bzw. Anpassung von Workloads aus der Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in Dedicated-Cloud-Umgebungen
  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands ür regelmäßige Workshops, Team-Meetings und Kunden-Besuche

Thales investiert jährlich mehr als 4,5 Milliarden Euro in Forschung und Entwicklung in Schlüsseltechnologien wie künstliche Intelligenz, Cybersicherheit, Quanten- und Cloud-Technologien.

Im Jahr 2025 erwirtschaftete die Gruppe einen Umsatz von 22,1 Milliarden Euro.

Für mehr als 85.000 Mitarbeitende in 65 Ländern eröffnen wir zukunftsweisende Perspektiven, verwirklichen individuelle Karrierewege und ermöglichen kreative Freiräume. Dies gelingt durch Mut, Vielfalt und den festen Willen, die anspruchsvollen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit sicherer und inklusiver zu gestalten. Mit unserer nachhaltigen, werteorientierten Personalführung treten wir aktiv für Diversität ein.

Say HI* – Ihr Weg zu uns

Wenn die Zeichen der Zeit auf Veränderung stehen, sind unsere internationalen Teams da, um der Komplexität von heute mit den branchenführenden Technologien von morgen zu begegnen. Sind Sie dabei?     - Organize and control long and short-term projects.
    - Build collaborative relationships with others.
    - Work with established guidelines and follow set policies and procedures as related to job duties to ensure timeliness, data reliability and accuracy.

The ideal candidate for this position will have:
- One (1) year supervisory experience; or two (2) years work experience equivalent to a Child Support Specialist in Arizona State Service. Any combination of training and experience that meet the knowledge, skills, and abilities (KSAs) may be substituted.
- Experience in leadership, organizing/processing workflow.

Job Title: Data Engineering Manager - (GCP, AI/ML & GenAI)

Experience: 15+ Years

Location: Remote (USA)

Primary Focus: GCP Data Engineering & AWS, AI/ML & GenAI

Note: Preferrably we are looking for hands on experience as a Head of Engineering/ Engineering manager in GCP Platform and if you are currently working as a Senior/Lead Data Engineer then your profile is not suitable for the current requirement.

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager with strong hands-on expertise in AWS and GCP Data Engineering to lead a large-scale AWS-to-GCP data platform migration.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience designing enterprise data platforms on AWS and migrating them to Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The role requires a combination of technical architecture, hands-on engineering, migration leadership, team management and stakeholder management.

The candidate should have strong hands-on experience with AWS services such as S3, Glue, Redshift, Athena, Step Functions and AWS DMS, along with strong GCP expertise across BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage and Cloud Composer.

The Engineering Manager will work closely with US-based stakeholders, architects, engineers, DevOps teams, Data Science and BI teams to define the migration strategy and ensure successful execution.

Key Responsibilities

1. AI/ML, Generative AI & MLOps

  • Design and implement AI/ML and Generative AI solutions on GCP using Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, and related GCP-native services.
  • Build production-grade machine learning pipelines for data preparation, model training, validation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle management.
  • Develop Generative AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, including enterprise search, document intelligence, AI assistants, summarization, semantic search, embeddings, vector search, and knowledge-management applications.
  • Design scalable ingestion, transformation, chunking, embedding, indexing, and retrieval pipelines for structured and unstructured enterprise data.
  • Implement MLOps practices using Vertex AI Pipelines, Model Registry, model endpoints, Terraform, GitHub, Cloud Build, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Establish standards for model versioning, experiment tracking, data and feature validation, automated testing, deployment approvals, rollback, and environment promotion.
  • Implement monitoring for model performance, data drift, latency, reliability, inference cost, response quality, retrieval accuracy, and GenAI risks such as hallucination and prompt injection.
  • Ensure responsible AI, data privacy, security, governance, access control, auditability, and human-review processes are incorporated into AI/ML and GenAI solutions.
  • Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Product, BI, Security, and US-based stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-value AI/ML and GenAI use cases.

2. GCP Data Platform Architecture

Architect and implement scalable enterprise data platforms on GCP.

Design Data Lake and Lakehouse architectures using GCS and BigQuery.

Define Bronze, Silver and Gold/Atomic data layers.

Design scalable data ingestion, transformation and consumption frameworks.

Establish standards for data modeling, partitioning, clustering and storage.

Design multi-tenant and multi-location data architectures.

Define schema-on-read and schema-on-write strategies.

3. AWS Data Platform Expertise

Analyze and optimize existing AWS data platforms before migration.

Work with:

Amazon S3

AWS Glue
