Amazon Athena

AWS Step Functions

AWS DMS

AWS Lake Formation

Understand existing AWS ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, workloads and dependencies.

Identify equivalent or improved GCP services for each AWS workload.

Prepare technical mapping and migration plans between AWS and GCP services.

4. GCP Streaming & Real-Time Data Engineering

Architect real-time data pipelines using:

Google Pub/Sub

Dataflow / Apache Beam

BigQuery

Cloud Storage

Design high-volume event ingestion, enrichment and transformation pipelines.

Implement event-driven architectures and appropriate delivery guarantees.

Optimize streaming pipelines for latency, throughput and scalability.

Design BigQuery streaming ingestion patterns.

Implement monitoring, logging and alerting for real-time workloads.

5. ETL / ELT & Data Processing

Design and implement scalable batch and real-time ETL/ELT pipelines.

Migrate AWS Glue-based pipelines to appropriate GCP services.

Develop transformation frameworks using:

Python

PySpark

SQL

Dataflow / Apache Beam

BigQuery

dbt

Design CDC pipelines and real-time ingestion patterns.

Build orchestration workflows using Cloud Composer / Airflow.

Optimize data processing jobs and query performance.

6. AWS to GCP Migration Leadership

Lead the end-to-end migration of enterprise data platforms from AWS to GCP.

Assess existing AWS architecture, data pipelines, workloads, dependencies and operational processes.

Define the target-state GCP architecture and migration roadmap.

Develop migration strategies for:

Amazon S3 → Google Cloud Storage

Amazon Redshift → BigQuery

AWS Glue → Dataflow / Dataproc / BigQuery

AWS Step Functions → Cloud Composer / Workflows

AWS DMS → GCP-native CDC solutions

Amazon Athena → BigQuery

Identify opportunities to modernize AWS workloads rather than performing a simple lift-and-shift migration.

Define migration phases, technical dependencies, risks and rollback strategies.

Lead architecture reviews and technical design discussions.

7. Data Modeling & BigQuery

Design enterprise data models for analytics and reporting.

Define dimensional, normalized and denormalized data models.

Develop multi-tenant data structures.

Design BigQuery partitioning and clustering strategies.

Optimize BigQuery SQL and query execution.

Design data models supporting both real-time and batch workloads.

Work closely with BI and Analytics teams to create scalable consumption models.

8. Data Governance, Security & Quality

Establish data governance and data quality standards across the GCP platform.

Implement automated data quality checks and validation frameworks.

Establish data lineage, metadata and ownership standards.

Ensure appropriate security controls across all GCP data layers.

Implement:

IAM

Least-privilege access

Encryption

Service accounts

Network security

Data access policies

Work with governance and security teams to ensure compliance requirements are met.

Experience with Dataplex, Data Catalog and data lineage is preferred.

9. DevOps, Infrastructure & Automation

Lead infrastructure automation using Terraform.

Build repeatable and secure GCP infrastructure deployments.

Implement CI/CD pipelines for data engineering workloads.

Work with:

Terraform

Git

GitHub

CI/CD pipelines

Automate data pipeline deployment, testing and infrastructure provisioning.

Establish Dev, QA, UAT and Production deployment standards.

Lead performance optimization initiatives across GCP data workloads.

Optimize:

BigQuery query performance

Partitioning and clustering

Dataflow pipelines

Spark workloads

Cloud Storage

Streaming workloads

Analyze AWS workloads and determine the most cost-effective GCP architecture.

Develop cloud FinOps and cost optimization strategies.

Establish performance benchmarks and SLAs for critical workloads.

11. Engineering Management & Team Leadership

Lead and mentor a team of Data Engineers, Senior Data Engineers and Technical Leads.

Provide technical direction and establish engineering standards.

Conduct architecture and code reviews.

Define technical roadmaps and engineering priorities.

Break complex migration requirements into actionable deliverables.

Track engineering progress, risks, dependencies and delivery milestones.

Promote best practices around coding, testing, CI/CD, security and documentation.

Mentor engineers on GCP, data architecture and modern data engineering practices.

12. Stakeholder & Client Management

Act as the primary technical point of contact for US-based stakeholders.

Work closely with Business, Product, Data Science, BI and DevOps teams.

Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

Present architecture decisions, migration strategies and technical roadmaps.

Communicate technical risks, dependencies, timelines and trade-offs.

Collaborate with business teams to define operational and analytical KPIs.

Tasks

  • 15+ years of experience in GCP Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Cloud Engineering, AI/ML Engineering, or related technology leadership roles.
  • 5+ years of strong hands-on GCP Data Engineering Experience.
  • 3+ years of strong hands-on AI/ML & Gen AI Experience.
  • Proven experience delivering AWS-to-GCP migration projects.
  • Strong experience designing enterprise Data Lake and Lakehouse platforms on GCP.
  • Strong hands-on experience with BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, IAM, and Terraform.
  • Experience migrating AWS data workloads, pipelines, and platforms to GCP.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS and GCP service mapping, migration patterns, modernization strategies, and cloud architecture best practices.
  • Experience designing, building, and deploying AI/ML solutions on GCP using Vertex AI.
  • Hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLM-based applications, RAG architectures, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, and enterprise AI assistants.
  • Strong understanding of MLOps, including model training, model registry, CI/CD/CT, model deployment, monitoring, retraining, governance, and rollback strategies.
  • Experience implementing secure and responsible AI solutions, including data privacy, model evaluation, access controls, auditability, and governance.
  • Expert-level SQL and strong Python and PySpark skills.
  • Strong data modeling, data warehousing, batch processing, and real-time data engineering experience.

  • Experience managing and mentoring data engineering and cross-functional technical teams.
  • Strong communication skills with experience working with US-based stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer certification.

  • Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer certification.
  • Experience with Vertex AI Agent Builder, Vertex AI Search, Gemini models on Vertex AI, or enterprise Generative AI platforms.
  • Experience with dbt, Apache Airflow, Kafka, Apache Spark, Kubernetes, Cloud Run, and API-driven architectures.
  • Experience with Dataplex, Data Catalog, data lineage, metadata management, data governance, master data management, and data-quality frameworks.
  • Experience supporting enterprise or regulated environments with strong data privacy, security, compliance, audit, and governance requirements.

Requirements

Required Technical Skills:

AIML & GenAI Technology Skills

AI/ML: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, NLP, Deep Learning, ML AlgorithmsGenerative AI: GenAI, LLMs, GPT, Gemini, Claude, Llama, Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning

Data Engineering Skills

Cloud Platforms: GCP, AWS, BigQuery, GCS, AWS S3, Pub/Sub, AWS KinesisData Engineering: Advanced Python, Expert SQL, PySpark, Apache Spark, ETL, ELT, CDC

DevOps & Infrastructure: Terraform, Git/GitHub, Cloud Build, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code
Data Governance & Quality: Data Lineage, Metadata Management, Data Quality, Monitoring, OpenLineage

Benefits

  • Lead AWS-to-GCP cloud transformation & AIML GenAI initiatives.
  • Work on Data Lakehouse and analytics modernization.
  • Flexible remote work.
  • Exposure to global customers.
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture.
  • Continuous learning and certification.

Lead transformative AI/ML & GCP innovations as Head of Engineering at Naveera Tech. Join a global team to revolutionize data into business value. Remote role, USA-based. Apply today!

About TMC Hospitality

TMC Hospitality is a hospitality management and development company dedicated to creating thoughtfully designed destinations that bring people together through exceptional experiences, memorable spaces, and genuine hospitality.

Our portfolio includes Drift Hotels, Bode, Maleza Restaurants, and Buttonwood Farm & Winery—each with its own unique identity but united by a commitment to design, culture, and community. From boutique hotels and destination restaurants to vineyards and event venues, we create places that inspire connection and celebrate a sense of place.

At Drift, we blend minimalist design with authentic local experiences, creating hotels that feel both elevated and approachable. At Bode, we reimagine group travel by combining the comforts of home with the amenities and service of a boutique hotel. Maleza brings together vibrant hospitality, thoughtful cuisine, and community-driven experiences, while Buttonwood offers a distinctive wine country destination rooted in agriculture, events, and hospitality.

With properties in California, Tennessee, and Baja California Sur, TMC Hospitality continues to grow while remaining focused on one core belief: hospitality should feel personal, intentional, and unforgettable.

If you're passionate about creating exceptional guest experiences and want to be part of a team that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous growth, we'd love to meet you.

About the role

TMC Hospitality is seeking a creative and driven Social Media & Content Manager to lead social media and content creation across our growing portfolio of boutique hotels, restaurants, bars, and experiences, including Drift, Bode, Maleza, and Buttonwood.

This role will oversee 10+ social media accounts, bringing each brand's unique identity to life through compelling storytelling, photography, video, and engaging digital content. The ideal candidate is a hands-on content creator and strategic thinker who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced hospitality environment.

This is a remote position based in Nashville or Southern California, requiring approximately 50% travel to our properties for content creation, events, and brand initiatives.

What you'll do

  • Develop and execute social media strategies across multiple hospitality brands, maintaining distinct brand voices and consistent engagement.
  • Manage social media accounts, content calendars, publishing schedules, and community engagement across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn.
  • Capture, produce, and edit high-quality photography, short-form videos, Reels, and other creative assets showcasing our properties, dining experiences, events, and destinations.
  • Plan and execute organic and paid social campaigns that drive brand awareness, website traffic, hotel bookings, dining reservations, and event attendance.
  • Develop and manage blog and editorial content, incorporating storytelling, local experiences, and SEO best practices.
  • Collaborate with property leadership, food and beverage teams, and marketing partners to support promotions, events, seasonal campaigns, and brand initiatives.
  • Identify and coordinate influencer partnerships, user-generated content, and creative collaborations that align with our brands.
  • Track and analyze social media performance, engagement, audience growth, and campaign effectiveness to inform ongoing strategy.
  • Travel regularly to properties for content production, photoshoots, and events, including occasional evenings and weekends.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in social media management, content creation, or digital marketing, preferably managing multiple brands or accounts.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating original photography, videography, video editing, copywriting, and successful social media campaigns.
  • Proficiency with social media platforms, content creation and editing software, scheduling tools, and performance analytics.
  • Experience managing paid social campaigns and using data to optimize engagement and results.
  • Strong creative instincts, storytelling ability, and attention to detail, with the ability to adapt content to different brand identities.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to independently manage competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Passion for hospitality, travel, food and beverage, design, and local culture.
  • Experience with influencer partnerships, blogging, SEO, or website publishing is a plus.
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 50% of the time, including occasional evening and weekend commitments.

To apply: Please submit your resume and a portfolio or examples of social media accounts you've managed, highlighting original photography, video, written content, and measurable results.

raw.title: Head of People Operations
raw.excerpt: We're looking for a hands-on Head of People Operations who loves making things work well, every single day.
raw.description:
We're looking for a hands-on Head of People Operations who loves making things work well, every single day. The foundations are already here: our HR systems, policies, and core processes are in place. What they need now is someone who'll sharpen them, make them consistent across every country we operate in, and keep them running smoothly as we grow.

This isn't a pure strategy role. You'll spend most of your time close to the work: advising managers on tricky employee relations cases, checking that a contract in Kenya meets local law, fixing the onboarding step that keeps tripping people up, and finding ways AI can take the admin off everyone's plate. You'll also own our yearly company offsite, from the agenda to the moment you open it on day one.

Equally vital, you will champion and embody our company culture. You will safeguard our core values, model them in daily interactions, and comfortably lead challenging discussions when expectations aren't met. Acting as a trusted advocate for employees with leadership, you will champion their interests while thoughtfully balancing staff needs, corporate values, and business priorities.

Job Details

  • Job Title: Head of People Operations
  • Reporting To: Chief Operating Officer
  • Grade: M7 (Head of)
  • Location: Remote in United Kingdom (but open to GMT +/- 3 hours time zone if you have UK HR Experience)
  • Compensation: 60,000-70,000 GBP but this will be adjusted to a local benchmark if you are based outside of the UK
  • Contract Structure: Permanent

Key Responsibilities

  • Culture carrier. You'll protect and live our culture and values every day, and hold others to them too. You'll run engagement surveys, turn the results into specific actions, and follow through, keeping our culture strong across a remote-first, multi-country team.
  • Employee relations. You'll be the go-to person for managers and staff regarding grievances, disciplinary matters, performance concerns, absences, and exits. You handle cases fairly, document them properly, and close them out, and you know when to bring in local counsel.
  • Multi-country compliance. You'll make sure our contracts, handbooks, and policies comply with employment law in each country where we hire, whether through our own entities or an Employer of Record. That means tracking legal changes, keeping country-specific terms up to date, and flagging risk early. As a project-based business, you'll also make sure people are classified correctly (permanent, fixed-term, project-funded, consultant or contractor) as projects start and end, with the right contracts, notice terms and exit processes for each.
  • Refining systems and processes. Most of what we need already exists. Your job is to audit it, spot the gaps, and tighten it up: onboarding, offboarding, probation, performance reviews, leave, contract changes, etc.
  • Using AI to work smarter. You'll look for practical ways AI can save time and improve quality across the people function, such as drafting initial versions of letters and policies, answering routine employee questions, cleaning up HR data, or summarising survey results. You'll roll these out safely, with clear guidance on data privacy.
  • People operations and HR data. You'll own the accuracy of our HRIS and people data, support payroll and benefits administration across countries, and produce clean, reliable reporting for the leadership team. Every process should be documented, owned, and easy to follow.
  • Annual company offsite. You'll lead the yearly offsite end-to-end: shaping the agenda with the leadership team, managing the venue, travel, visas, budget, and logistics, and hosting the sessions on the day. People should leave feeling more connected and clearer on where we're going.
  • Supporting managers. You'll coach managers through the people side of their jobs and give them simple tools, templates, and training so they can handle more on their own.
  • Clear, warm communication. You write clearly, explain policy in plain language, and can handle difficult conversations with empathy and directness.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 3 months: you've reviewed every core people process and policy, met each manager, most of the company, and shared a prioritised list of fixes with the leadership team.
  • By 6 months: the top-priority processes are refined, documented, and owned. Open employee relations cases are handled consistently, and managers and employees feel supported
  • By 9 months: at least two AI-supported workflows are live and saving the team measurable time, with guidance in place on how to use them safely.
  • By 12 months: you've delivered a well-run annual offsite that people rate highly, and managers say HR is fast, clear, and easy to work with.

Requirements

  • Solid HR generalist experience. You've got 7+ years in HR, with at least 2 years leading the people function or a significant part of it, including managing a small team. You'll lead 3 direct reports here.
  • Employee relations know-how. You've handled a wide range of ER cases yourself, from the first conversation to the final outcome, and you're confident, calm, and fair under pressure.
  • Labour law across multiple countries. You've worked with employment law in the UK but also in more than one jurisdiction and understand how contracts, notice periods, leave and termination rules differ between them. You know your way around Employer of Record models and when to call local counsel.
  • Project-based business experience. You understand how people work in organisations funded by projects or grants. You know the difference between permanent, fixed-term, project-funded and contractor roles, how to classify people correctly in each country, and how to manage contract renewals and endings when funding changes.
  • A process builder with an eye for detail. You can take a messy or inconsistent process and turn it into something simple and reliable. You notice the typo in the offer letter and the missing step in the leaver checklist, and you fix them.
  • Comfort with HR systems and AI tools. You're confident using an HRIS and comfortable experimenting with AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot to make work faster and better. You can show us examples of where you've done it.
  • Event planning experience. You've planned and run in-person events, ideally a company offsite or retreat for 50+ people, including agenda design, logistics, budget and facilitation.
  • Clear, warm communication. You write clearly, explain policy in plain language and can handle difficult conversations with empathy and directness.
  • Happy to travel. You're comfortable travelling occasionally to our sites in Africa

Nice to have

  • Experience working in Africa. You've supported teams or employed people in African countries such as Kenya, Uganda, Ghana, Nigeria and Ethiopia, and you understand local labour law, payroll and cultural context there.
  • Global health or NGO background. You've worked in a mission-driven organisation
  • CIPD Level 5 or above, or an equivalent HR qualification. Not required, but a plus.
  • UK-based. The role is fully remote, but a UK base would be ideal.

Benefits

5 Reasons to Join Simprints

Life is short. We believe work should be inspirational, meaningful and fun. At Simprints, we’re taking on global development’s biggest challenges, powered by an amazing culture and incredible people. Work with us, and you will grow faster, learn more, and take on great responsibilities with the potential to make lasting change.

1. Genuine Impact. Work directly with our partners and users to deliver technology that has the potential to impact millions of lives across the globe. At Simprints, you’ll be part of a team that is passionate about driving real change.

2. An incredible, diverse team. Our work is at the intersection of technology and global development, and we’ve managed to build an amazing team drawn from all over the world. But don’t take our word for it—we’re an externally recognised as a Great Place to Work, and a 2025 Best Workplace for Women amonst many other accolades.

3. Mutual Flex. We champion a work culture where autonomy and trust are paramount, steering clear of mere face-time metrics. Whether it's managing life's essentials like healthcare appointments or adapting work hours to match your peak productivity times, we've got you covered. In return, we count on your reciprocal flexibility when mission-critical moments arise, like stepping up for a crucial client discussion on a Friday or tackling unexpected technical glitches beyond regular hours.

4. Ultimate work-life balance. As long as you're driving results and fostering teamwork, we encourage you to strike that perfect balance between your professional and personal life. Our commitment to this model's success is solidified through semi-annual productivity assessments with our board, ensuring that our high standards of performance are consistently met.

5. Professional development. We promote continual learning and put our money where our mouth is with development plans and access to global experts through the GLG network. We also have a generous professional development budget for each colleague – “Eduprints”. Is there some training you’d like, or maybe you could benefit from professional coaching? Simply provide a business case that shares your aspirations and the resources you need, and we'll do our best to support you. We care about both your development in Simprints and your holistic long-term career goals. Simprints Alumni have gone on to work for Google, World Bank, Gavi, Save the Children, and other top players.

raw.title: B2B Lead Generation Specialist (Staffing & BPO)
raw.excerpt: About Bamboo WorksBamboo Works helps growing companies and ambitious entrepreneurs build global teams without handling recruitment themselves.
raw.description:
About Bamboo Works

Bamboo Works helps growing companies and ambitious entrepreneurs build global teams without handling recruitment themselves. We place vetted, English-fluent professionals, from service and support staff to accountants, engineers, and marketers, who work as part of our clients' onshore teams. Our services range from single specialist placements to fully managed offshore departments and recruitment-as-a-service. We've served 200+ clients so far and invest in our people through our own AI Academy. We were built remotely on purpose, and we care about the quality of each hire more than the number of hires.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an exceptional Lead Generation Specialist to fuel our growth by connecting us with the companies that need great offshore teams the most.

If you're passionate about finding opportunities others miss, starting meaningful conversations, and helping businesses grow through great people, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you'll own the top of our sales funnel, from identifying the right companies through booking qualified meetings for our sales team. You'll build a predictable pipeline from scratch, targeting companies that could realistically hire offshore staff, and find the buying signals that show when a business is ready to build a remote team.

This is a highly autonomous role where you'll work closely with our sales team and internal leadership to test new channels, refine our ideal customer profile, and hand over opportunities that are warm, qualified, and ready to close.

Your success will be measured not only by the number of qualified meetings you generate, but also by the quality of those opportunities, your creativity in finding new ways to reach prospects, and the long-term clients they turn into.

Role Details

Commitment: Part-Time/Full-Time
Working Hours: Flexible with overlap across international clients
Location: Fully Remote
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Start Date: ASAP
Monthly Rate: Competitive rate based on experience, consisting of base pay + high incentives

What You'll Do

  • Build a steady flow of qualified meetings with companies looking to hire offshore staff.
  • Define and refine the ideal customer profile. Spot buying signals (hiring activity, growth triggers, operational strain) that show when a company is ready to offshore.
  • Run outreach across email, LinkedIn, phone, and less conventional channels. Test, measure, and double down on what converts.
  • Qualify and warm up prospects so our sales team receives opportunities that are ready to close.
  • Keep our CRM clean and accurate. Report full-funnel metrics from first touch through closed client, and use them to improve results month over month.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • At least 3 years in B2B lead generation, with a proven record of generating clients for a staffing, recruitment, outsourcing, or BPO firm itself (not for one of its clients).
  • You can share real funnel numbers, including outreach volume, reply rates, meetings booked, show-up rates, and closed clients, as well as the KPIs you were held to.
  • You can build targeted lead lists and find buying signals on your own. You're creative with outreach and don't depend on an expensive stack of paid tools.
  • You have hands-on experience with at least one CRM (e.g., GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Zoho) and keep detailed, up-to-date prospect and opportunity records.
  • You write and speak English excellently, and you're comfortable owning targets independently in a fully remote setup.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience running qualification or discovery calls before handing prospects over to sales
  • Familiarity with the Western SMB market (US, UK, EU, AU) and its offshore hiring needs
  • Experience with cold calling or appointment-setting software
  • Experience with corporate markets, such as accounting
  • Uses AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Clay, etc.) to speed up research and personalization
  • Experience with outreach beyond cold email and LinkedIn, such as partnerships, referrals, events, communities, or content-led prospecting

Ideal Candidate Profile

This role is ideal for someone who:

  • Is driven by targets and motivated by seeing the pipeline grow.
  • Takes ownership of results rather than waiting for leads to come to them.
  • Spots opportunities and buying signals that others miss.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where you're building from scratch.
  • Handles rejection with resilience and keeps outreach consistent day after day.
  • Gets creative with outreach instead of relying on expensive tools or one-size-fits-all templates.
  • Balances high activity with high-quality, well-qualified opportunities.
  • Is data-driven, tracking every number in the funnel and using it to improve.
  • Enjoys starting conversations with business owners and understands how great offshore talent helps companies grow.

Why Join Bamboo Works?

  • Join a growing international company with ambitious expansion plans.
  • Work directly with businesses across multiple industries and countries.
  • Build meaningful, long-term client relationships where your work has visible impact.
  • Collaborate with a supportive, high-performing remote team.
  • Enjoy a high degree of autonomy, trust, and ownership in your role.
  • Benefit from a competitive base salary plus high incentives.
  • Work directly with company founders

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview
  2. Interview with the Founders
  3. Offer & Onboarding

raw.excerpt: DomainTools is looking for an experienced Public Sector Account Director to accelerate growth by acquiring new government customers across Federal, State and Local, and Education (FED/SLED) markets.
raw.description:
DomainTools is looking for an experienced Public Sector Account Director to accelerate growth by acquiring new government customers across Federal, State and Local, and Education (FED/SLED) markets. This is an individual contributor "hunter" role with no direct reports, who is the quarterback of the Public Sector team responsible for managing a defined public sector territory and achieving bookings targets,The ideal candidate is an accomplished government sales professional with a proven track record of selling into complex federal, state and municipal accounts, and building trusted relationships with executive, program, technical, and procurement stakeholders across public-sector organizations.

The Public SectorAccount Director will own the full-cycle new business sales process within assigned target agencies and institutions, including:from outbound prospecting, identifying, and qualifying opportunities, expanding DomainTools existing footprint through to developing business cases, navigating procurement and contracting requirements, and closing net-new business.

This role requires close partnership across Sales Development, Sales Engineering, Sales Operations, Marketing, Partner Alliances, Product, and our Executive Team. Strong cross-functional influence, communications and orchestration are essential to success.

The successful candidate will combine strategic territory planning, operational rigor, executive presence, consultative selling skills, deep familiarity with government procurement, and a relentless hunter mentality to deliver consistent new business acquisition and predictable business results.

Key Responsibilities

New Business Revenue and Territory Ownership

  • Own the net-new revenue target and sales quota for an assigned Public Sector territory and target agency/institution list.
  • Identify, develop, and close new revenue opportunities across DomainTools' government ICP, including federal civilian and defense agencies, state and local governments.Develop and execute strategic territory plans that prioritize the highest-potential agencies, institutions, and target organizations based on mission need, budget cycle, and contract vehicle access.
  • Manage and direct the complete sales process from outbound prospecting and discovery through opportunity qualification, business case development, procurement navigation, and close.
  • Generate and maintain sufficient pipeline coverage (both self-sourced and marketing supported) to support current and future new business revenue objectives.
  • Apply repeatable sales strategies and methodologies, adapted to government buying cycles, to produce predictable new bookings.
  • Meet or exceed assigned sales targets and role-specific KPIs.
  • Maintain ownership and accountability for the progression, accuracy, and outcome of new opportunities, including alignment to fiscal-year budget and procurement timelines.

Strategic Account Acquisition

  • Penetrate target agencies and institutions to develop trusted-advisor relationships with key stakeholders, including program managers, mission owners, technical leaders, contracting officers, and procurement teams.
  • Build champions and navigate complex government organizational structures to identify all required stakeholders, departments, and offices necessary to secure new wins.
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of each prospect's mission and cybersecurity environment, agency priorities, budget drivers, technical requirements, and procurement processes.
  • Communicate the business and technical value of DomainTools and its critical role within a modern security architecture supporting government missions.
  • Conduct MEDDPICC based discovery to identify agency challenges, desired mission outcomes, decision criteria, competitive considerations, and opportunities for immediate impact.
  • Build compelling business cases that clearly articulate mission outcomes, value realization, competitive differentiation, and justification for net-new investment within available budget and contract vehicles.
  • Partner with Sales Engineering and agency stakeholders to define positive mission and technical outcomes for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and evaluations.
  • Navigate complex organizational structures, procurement regulations (e.g., FAR/DFARS, state and local procurement codes), contract vehicles, and sales cycles across federal, state, local, and education entities.

Prospect Engagement and Value Realization

  • Execute high-touch prospecting and engagement strategies to land initial meetings and drive active evaluations with agency and institutional stakeholders.
  • Lead executive briefings, capability presentations, and strategic alignment sessions with government prospects.
  • Maintain visibility into prospect engagement and technical validation during PoCs to ensure momentum and mitigate competitive risks.
  • Support seamless customer transitions and handoffs to the Customer Success Management team upon contract execution.
  • Serve as a market advocate internally by communicating agency requirements, emerging use cases, competitive intelligence, and government market trends back to the Product team.

Pipeline, Forecasting, and Operational Excellence

  • Maintain rigorous pipeline management, opportunity qualification, and forecasting discipline across the assigned government territory.
  • Deliver accurate, timely, and predictable forecasts to sales leadership, accounting for government fiscal-year cycles and appropriations timing.
  • Maintain complete and accurate prospect, pipeline, opportunity, and forecasting data in Salesforce and other designated systems, including relevant contract vehicle and procurement details.
  • Monitor pipeline quality, quantity, velocity, conversion, and coverage, taking corrective action when performance falls below expectations.
  • Consistently execute against forecasted commitments and clearly communicate changes — including procurement delays or budget shifts — that could affect expected business results.
  • Keep sales leadership informed of significant opportunities, competitive developments, and other factors (e.g., continuing resolutions, budget cycles, policy changes) that may affect new business revenue.
  • Use market data, intent signals, and pipeline analytics to prioritize agencies and identify prime targets.
  • Follow DomainTools' sales methodology, qualification standards, opportunity-management requirements, and forecasting processes.
  • Maintain strong documentation of prospect interactions, next steps, decision criteria, stakeholders, and mutual action plans (MAPs).

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Marketing to build and execute targeted outbound account strategies and to identify and execute prospect acquisition campaigns, programs, and targeted account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives for government audiences.
  • Collaborate with Sales Engineering to develop technical strategies, demonstrate solution value, validate use cases, and ensure successful PoCs for agency evaluations.
  • Partner with Partner Alliances and System Integrator/channel teams to identify opportunities for joint account penetration, teaming, and co-selling on government contract vehicles.
  • Coordinate internal resources to support complex opportunities and deliver a high-quality, professional buying experience tailored to government procurement expectations.
  • Represent DomainTools at prospect meetings, industry events, and trade shows relevant to the federal, state, local, and education markets as required.

Requirements

  • Sales Experience & Impact: 5+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience focusing on net-new business acquisition (hunter role) within government markets, with a proven track record of exceeding quotas and closing six-figure new logo deals within federal, state, local, or education organizations.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of the cybersecurity landscape (Threat Intelligence, DNS, or Internet infrastructure) and the mission and budget drivers influencing government security investments.
  • Government Procurement Knowledge: Working familiarity with government contracting and procurement processes, including relevant contract vehicles, RFP/RFI/RFQ processes, and regulations such as FAR/DFARS or state and local equivalents.
  • Strategic Methodology: Expert application of consultative sales frameworks (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or Challenger) to conduct discovery, build ROI-based business cases, and navigate complex government sales cycles.
  • Executive Engagement: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills with the ability to cold-engage, build relationships, and influence senior government executives, program leaders, and technical stakeholders.
  • Operational Rigor: Strong analytical approach to territory planning, pipeline generation, and forecasting using Salesforce, accounting for government fiscal-year and budget cycles.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Ability to orchestrate cross-functional teams (CSM, SE, Marketing, Partner Alliances, Product) and work autonomously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Clearance/Location: U.S. citizenship required; existing federal security clearance a plus. Based within the U.S. with the ability to travel regularly for prospect meetings, trade shows, and internal events.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to:

  • Meet or exceed assigned new bookings and quota targets across the FED/SLED territory.
  • Generate and maintain healthy, predictable self-sourced and marketing-supported pipeline coverage.
  • Successfully land strategic new logos within federal, state, local, and education markets.
  • Establish trusted relationships with executive, technical, procurement, and program stakeholders at net-new agencies and institutions.
  • Expand DomainTools footprint within existing agencies.
  • Improve pipeline conversion, opportunity velocity, and forecast accuracy for new business, accounting for government budget and procurement timing.
  • Develop compelling business cases that connect DomainTools capabilities to measurable mission outcomes to win competitive bake-offs.
  • Deliver accurate forecasts and maintain strong CRM and opportunity-management discipline.
  • Seamlessly transition closed-won accounts to the post-sales teams to ensure long-term retention and growth.

Total Compensation: $250K – $325K (50% base / 50% variable)

Benefits

DomainTools is the global leader for Internet intelligence and the first place security practitioners go when they need to know. The world’s most advanced security teams use our solutions to identify external risks, investigate threats, and proactively protect their organizations in a constantly evolving threat landscape. DomainTools constantly monitors the Internet and brings together the most comprehensive and trusted domain website and DNS data to provide immediate context and machine-learning driven risk analytics delivered in near real-time.

DomainTools offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees that includes fully paid medical, dental and vision insurance premiums, a 401k retirement plan with company matching, basic life insurance, flexible PTO and additional well-being benefits.

DomainTools embraces diversity, equity and inclusion to its fullest as an equal opportunity employer. We build our teams so creativity and innovation can flourish. We believe inclusivity and equity fosters innovation and growth, and we harness this mindset to drive a culture that serves our employees and our customers. We encourage people of all backgrounds, ages, perspectives and skill sets to apply; and do not discriminate based on age, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by law.

raw.title: Technical Account Manager, Observe
raw.excerpt: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise.
raw.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Observe by Snowflake is a high-growth SaaS observability platform built on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, enabling businesses to troubleshoot modern distributed applications 10x faster. Now, as a core part of Snowflake, we’ve reached a major milestone in the evolution of the Snowflake platform. By bringing AI-powered observability directly into the Snowflake ecosystem, we’ve created the first truly unified platform for telemetry and business data.

We’re looking for a Technical Account Manager to partner with our most strategic enterprise customers and ensure they derive sustained operational value from Observe.

This is a hands-on, post-sales technical role focused on long-term platform adoption, optimization, and technical partnership. You will work directly with SRE, DevOps, platform, and engineering teams to embed Observe into daily workflows, evolve telemetry strategy over time, and continuously improve reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

This role is ideal for an experienced observability practitioner who enjoys being deeply embedded with customer teams, solving real production challenges, and acting as a trusted technical advisor in complex enterprise environments.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the primary technical owner and trusted advisor for assigned strategic accounts

  • Build deep familiarity with customer architectures, datasets, use cases, and operational goals

  • Partner with SRE, DevOps, and platform teams to integrate Observe into day-to-day operational workflows

  • Optimize datasets, queries, dashboards, and alerts for reliability, signal quality, performance, and cost

  • Lead regular health checks, architecture reviews, and proactive improvement initiatives

  • Identify new use cases and expansion opportunities aligned to customer outcomes

  • Coordinate technical escalations and advocate across Support, Engineering, and Product when needed

  • Provide clear technical guidance during change events, scaling initiatives, and complex operational scenarios

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, platform engineering, observability engineering, or customer-facing technical advisory roles

  • Strong hands-on experience operating production observability platforms

  • Direct experience with leading observability solutions such as Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk, New Relic, Grafana, Elastic (ELK), or similar platforms

  • Practical experience with OpenTelemetry, including signals (logs, metrics, traces), instrumentation strategies, collectors, and telemetry pipelines

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and modern DevOps practices

A Moving Experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and operate a single, integrated compliance management system spanning quality, HSE, security, privacy, legal/regulatory, and internal controls.
  • Define and maintain enterprise compliance policies, standards, controls, and evidence frameworks that are audit-ready and scalable.
  • Establish clear governance and accountability, including a cross-functional compliance RACI across Legal, Security, Quality, HSE, Product, Engineering, and Finance.
  • Drive awareness and prioritization of regional regulatory obligations (EU, US, APAC, China, etc.)
  • Maintain customer facing Trust Center.
  • Chair compliance workgroup, establish workflow and pipeline for strategic compliance and certification investments.
  • Plan, coordinate, and lead internal/external audits, including certification, customer, and regulator audits; drive pragmatic corrective actions and strategic solutions.
  • Ensure quality, safety, and process compliance supports OEM contractual and product approval requirements.
  • Partner with Security, Product, and Engineering to ensure compliance with key security and automotive cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001/27017, TISAX, ISO 21434, ASPICE) and secure development expectations.
  • Support operationalizing global privacy compliance (e.g., GDPR/UK GDPR), including DPIAs, privacy risk assessments, and defensible records of processing and data flows.
  • Monitor regulatory change and translate legal requirements into actionable controls, working closely with legal to support compliance representations and customer due diligence.
  • Serve as the primary compliance interface to the CFO’s Internal Audit team and support SOX-adjacent/internal-control testing where applicable.
  • Maintain a consolidated view of enterprise compliance risk, drive risk-based prioritization, and provide regular reporting to executive leadership and the Audit Committee.
  • Convert local laws and regulations to actionable requirements (e.g., China GB44495, Germany, EU CRA).

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • 8+ years (Senior Manager) in compliance, risk, quality, security, or regulatory roles within software, automotive, cloud, or regulated technology industries.
  • Demonstrated experience owning multiple compliance domains simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of ISO-based management systems and audit operations.
  • Experience interfacing with internal audit, external auditors, and regulators.
  • Ability to translate legal and regulatory requirements into operational controls.
  • Proven stakeholder management across Legal, Engineering, Product, Security, Finance, and Operations.
  • Systems thinker who understands how compliance, engineering, security, and finance interlock.
  • Pragmatic and risk‑based, not checkbox‑driven.
  • Comfortable operating with executive leadership and boards.
  • Credible with engineers, auditors, and lawyers alike.
  • Calm, structured, and decisive in audit or regulatory pressure situations.
  • Self-starter who works well both independently and on collaborative teams.

Preferred

  • Exposure to connected-vehicle, cybersecurity, or AI regulatory regimes.
  • Experience building or maturing integrated compliance programs at scale.
  • International experience working across regions and regulatory frameworks.

All compensation and benefits are subject to the terms and conditions of the underlying plans or programs, as applicable, and may be amended, terminated, or replaced from time to time.

raw.description:
About Kojo

It's time to build. Whether it's creating more housing, upgrading our infrastructure, or adapting to climate change, one thing is clear: the construction industry is at the center of solving our biggest problems. We’re making buildings cheaper and easier to build by transforming the way commercial construction companies buy their materials. Join us.

Founded in 2018, Kojo is now one of the fastest-growing construction technology companies in the world. Construction accounts for $10 trillion in global spend annually and we can’t live without its output - our roads, schools, hospitals, and offices. Despite this, there’s been very little innovation over the past 70 years in how materials - which constitute up to 40% of project costs - are bought and sold. This is our opportunity.

About the Opportunity

Reporting to the Head of Marketing, this role will be responsible for both creating and capturing demand through performance marketing, the website, account-based and signal-based programs, and the ops and analytics underneath all of it.

This isn't a traditional channel-manager role. We want someone who is part growth marketer and part "Gen" marketer: someone who builds AI agents and workflows to get the output of a much larger team, runs integrated campaigns instead of optimizing channels in isolation, and is comfortable producing and distributing their own campaign assets. You'll pull in contractors, agencies, and AI tools as needed, and you'll have real ownership of strategy, budget, and results.

Strategy and ownership

  • Growth Marketing Strategy: Set channel strategy and plan campaigns to meet pipeline and revenue goals.

  • Own the pipeline number: Set demand gen strategy, channel mix, and quarterly plans to hit pipeline and revenue targets.

  • Cross-functional partnership: Work with sales on target accounts, handoffs, and follow-ups; with product marketing on messaging and launches; and with events to convert leads into pipeline.

  • Own the martech stack: Build a modern tech stack and lead the way on experimenting and implementing new tactics and tools like automated outbound, signal-based campaigns, ABX tactics, etc.

Performance marketing

  • Paid search and paid social: Own strategy, execution, and budget across Google, LinkedIn, Meta, and other paid channels, with clear efficiency targets.

  • Test and scale: Run a steady cadence of creative, audience, and offer experiments, cut what doesn't work, and scale what does.

Website, CRO, and search

  • Conversion: Own website conversion. Build landing pages, run A/B tests, and improve the paths from visit to demo.

  • SEO, AEO, and GEO: Grow organic discovery in both traditional search and LLMs (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) through technical optimization, structured content, and measurement.

ABX, signal-based, and outbound

  • Signal-based campaigns: Use intent, engagement, and first-party data to trigger timely, automated plays across ads, email, and outbound.

  • Outbound with SDRs: Design automated and signal-driven outbound sequences, build target lists, and work with SDRs/BDRs to turn engagement into meetings.

AI-first execution and campaign orchestration

  • Build with AI: Create AI agents and workflows for account research, outbound, campaign production, and reporting, and help the rest of the team adopt them.

  • Create and distribute: Produce campaign assets yourself (content, ads, emails, landing pages, social) with help from AI, and get the most out of existing content by repurposing and distributing it across channels.

About You

  • 7-10+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, primarily in demand generation or growth, at startups from Seed to Series C. Experience with a sales-led, ENT-focused motion is a plus.

  • Pipeline ownership: You've owned a marketing-sourced pipeline target and can talk through how you planned for it, what levers you’ve pulled to hit it, and what you'd do differently.

  • Performance marketing depth: Hands-on experience running and scaling paid search and paid social, including managing budget and improving CAC.

  • Web, CRO, and search: Experience improving website conversion, and driving meaningful growth through SEO, AEO, and GEO.

  • Maker instincts: You can write and produce solid campaign assets with AI's help, and you care about quality.

  • ABX and signal-based experience: You've built account-based programs and used intent or engagement signals to trigger campaigns and outbound.

  • Ops and analytics: You can run HubSpot and a modern martech stack without help, from attribution and routing to dashboards leadership trusts.

  • AI builder: You've built AI agents or workflows (in tools like Clay, n8n, Zapier, or with LLM APIs) that made you or your team measurably faster. Bring examples.

  • Strategic and scrappy: You're as comfortable setting strategy as you are building in the tools yourself. You like ambiguity, test constantly, and hold a high bar.

Working at Kojo

Salary: Your salary will be dependent upon many factors, including your experience level, skillset, market dynamics and balancing internal equity relative to other Kojo employees. The compensation and benefits information that we provide is based on Kojo’s good-faith estimate as of the date of the job posting and may be modified in the future.

Benefits: This position is also eligible for a new hire equity grant and all US-based full time employees are eligible for our full suite of perks and benefits. For more information about our perks and benefits, check out

Location: Kojo’s team members work from home 100% of the time across North and South America. If applicable, we’ll identify the travel and/or location-specific requirements of a position in the text above. Otherwise, team members can expect to work business hours congruent with their local time zone and remotely.

Inclusive Workplace: Kojo values diverse perspectives and is committed to building an inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, citizenship, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.



Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of Kojo. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Kojo will never ask for any personal account information, such credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process.

Compensation Range: $75K - $100K

raw.description:
We are a growth stage company that creates software solutions combining lean principles, predictive and prescriptive analytics, and machine learning to transform hospital and infusion center operations. More than 190 health systems and over 1,200 hospitals and centers across 49 states rely on our award-winning products and expert change management services to increase patient access, decrease wait times, and reduce healthcare delivery costs. We have raised more than $300 million from top-tier investors such as Bain Capital, Insight Partners, and Goldman Sachs. We have been named among the top 100 AI companies in the world.
Please note that while this role is listed as available for remote, we are currently employing in the following states: AK, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MO, MT, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV. If your state is not listed, we may not be able to proceed with your application. We have offices in Santa Clara, CA and Charlotte, NC for employees who prefer to work regularly or occasionally from an office.

Join our Customer Onboarding team, where we partner with hospitals and health systems to implement technology that improves patient flow, optimizes capacity, and helps patients get the right care at the right time.

As a Senior Program Manager supporting Inpatient Flow, you will own healthcare technology implementations from pre-kickoff through go-live, serving as the primary driver of the project plan and day-to-day execution. You will bring together customer and LeanTaaS teams to manage the many interconnected pieces of a successful implementation—from discovery and technical readiness to workflow alignment, testing, training, go-live preparation, and launch.

You will build and manage detailed project plans, drive customer meetings and decisions, coordinate clinical and technical workstreams, manage risks and dependencies, and ensure teams remain aligned and accountable to their commitments. You’ll anticipate what could impact the implementation, create clear paths to resolution, and keep customers and internal stakeholders informed and moving forward.

Our implementations range from individual hospitals to complex, enterprise-wide deployments spanning multiple workflows, facilities, and stakeholder groups. You will partner closely with Clinical Workflow Implementation Managers, Product Implementation, Data Engineering, Customer Success and customer teams to bring structure and accountability to each engagement and ensure customers are prepared for a successful go-live.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

    Lead Customer Implementations

  • Own and lead a portfolio of complex Inpatient Flow implementations from kickoff through go-live and transition to Customer Success
  • Build, maintain, and execute detailed implementation plans, including milestones, deliverables, dependencies, resources, decisions, and timelines
  • Lead implementations that span multiple workflows in multiple hospitals across a health system
  • Run customer and internal implementation meetings, establish clear action items and owners, and drive accountability for commitments across customer and LeanTaaS teams
  • Coordinate discovery, technical implementation, workflow design, training, testing, readiness, and go-live activities across all implementation workstreams
  • Maintain implementation momentum by proactively following up on deliverables, resolving blockers, and ensuring decisions are made when needed
  • Drive high-quality implementations by ensuring consistent execution against established standards, proactively identifying gaps, and maintaining a high bar for customer experience and delivery excellence
  • Coordinate and participate in onsite meetings and activities

    • Manage Risk, Dependencies & Escalations

  • Continuously assess implementation health and proactively identify risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and decisions that could impact delivery
  • Develop and drive mitigation plans before risks become implementation delays or customer escalations
  • Identify and escalate issues requiring additional leadership, product, technical, or clinical support and ensure they remain actively managed through resolution
  • Manage changes to implementation scope and timelines, clearly communicating impacts and establishing alignment on the path forward
  • Maintain clear documentation of decisions, risks, action items, dependencies, and customer commitments throughout the implementation
  • Provide internal and customer stakeholders with clear, consistent visibility into implementation status, risks, accomplishments, and next steps

    • Drive Customer & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Build strong working relationships with customer project leaders, executives, clinical leaders, operational stakeholders, and technical teams
  • Facilitate customer governance and implementation meetings that drive decisions, resolve open issues, and maintain alignment across stakeholders
  • Partner closely with Clinical Workflow Implementation Managers to incorporate workflow transformation, change management, training, and adoption activities into the overall implementation plan
  • Coordinate across Product Implementation, Data Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and other LeanTaaS teams to ensure workstreams and dependencies remain aligned
  • Navigate competing priorities and differing stakeholder perspectives while maintaining focus on implementation goals and customer outcomes
  • Ensure a thorough handoff to Customer Success at the completion of implementation, including outcomes, open items, commitments, risks, and opportunities for continued optimization
  • Understand the overall implementation strategy and translate it into a delivery approach that aligns project execution with customer needs, implementation goals, and desired business outcomes

    • Contribute to Implementation Excellence

  • Apply established implementation methodologies, tools, and best practices consistently across customer engagements
  • Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, templates, tools, and documentation based on lessons learned from customer engagements
  • Share implementation insights and best practices with the broader team to improve consistency and execution across future implementations

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent years of related experience) in Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
  • 5+ years of hands-on project or program management experience leading complex healthcare implementations
  • Experience directly managing implementations through the full lifecycle, from kickoff and discovery through testing, training, go-live, and transition
  • Experience leading health system-wide initiatives involving multiple hospitals, workstreams, stakeholder groups, or technology solutions
  • Strong project management fundamentals, including project planning, dependency management, risk mitigation, issue management, scope management, and stakeholder communication
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple customer implementations and priorities simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail
  • Proven ability to drive accountability and results across cross-functional teams without direct authority
  • Experience working directly with executives, clinical leaders, operational teams, technical teams, and project stakeholders within hospitals or health systems
  • Ability to translate complex implementation details into clear project plans, decisions, risks, and next steps
  • Strong communication, facilitation, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • Proficiency with project management tools and methodologies
  • Resourceful, results-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment
  • Willingness to travel 30–40% of the time

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

  • Experience implementing enterprise healthcare technology or SaaS solutions
  • Experience with inpatient hospital operations, patient flow, capacity management, or related operational workflows
  • Experience managing multi-product or multi-site implementations across large health systems
  • Experience working in JIRA and Smartsheet
  • Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, or other process improvement training or certification

WHAT YOU'LL GET

  • Intellectual and emotional satisfaction of solving tough operational problems in healthcare while improving patient access and saving lives!
  • Competitive compensation package that includes base salary, target bonus, and stock options
  • 401(k) Match
  • Comprehensive healthcare benefits
  • Generous Paid Time Off and Parental Leave
  • Monthly reimbursement for Skill Building
  • Monthly reimbursement for Wellness, Transportation, and/or Home Office
  • Education Reimbursement for select courses/programs

We are currently seeking a Full Time Contact Center Advisor to join our team. The role of the Contact Center Advisor is to assist members with their Credit Union needs over the phone and explaining products and services, opening new accounts, processing loan requests, responding to problems, making recommendations to satisfy member needs, and directing members to the appropriate individuals as needed. Successful candidates will be responsible to attain established goals for cross selling credit union products and services. The ability to speak Spanish is an asset for this position. This role includes Saturdays and rotating shifts during the week to be a part of the regularly scheduled workweek.

This is a remote position; candidates must be local and reside within a 25-mile radius of any of our branch locations. Candidates must be able to report to a branch if necessary.

Responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to:

  • Accurately completing transactions while assisting members in the Contact Center, while maintaining confidentiality and complying with MHV's policies and procedures, as well as maintaining productivity standards in support of department goals regarding service levels and speed.
  • Maintaining a highly developed knowledge level of MHV's products and services to assists members and potential members with inbound telephone requests and multimedia inquiries while upholding MHV Service Standards, including open and close accounts, answer questions about products and services, resolve problems that are within authority to resolve and refer problems that are beyond authority to a supervisor, along with recommendations.
  • Identifying all cross-selling opportunities and actively promoting and selling credit union products and services through daily telephone contact with existing and potential members.
  • Processing loan requests, answering loan related questions, researching and solving lending problems, providing members with information on rates, terms, and alternate methods of financing. This also includes promoting and educating members about debt protection products.
  • Assisting members with our Home Banking suite of products, including but not limited to, answering the proprietary e mails from our Home Banking vendor on a daily basis, and answering the Web site e mail daily.
  • Accepting information relating to domestic wire transfers, performing OFAC inquiries, completing the verification process and obtaining necessary authorizations prior to submission to the Accounting Department.

Performance Measurements include:

  • Adhering to member service standards set by the Contact Center Advisor playbook and all annual performance metrics.

Staying abreast of current trends affecting the financial services industry and has an overall knowledge of the credit union, as well as its policies and procedures, and continually expanding knowledge and developing skills.
  • Processing member transactions with minimal errors, maintaining good work quality with few exceptions, directing phone calls to the appropriate area with minimum transfers, demonstrating sound judgment when making decisions in normal situations and accepting loan applications in the directed manner.

About Us

Pro Coffee Gear is a dynamic and rapidly expanding e-commerce company that specializes in providing top-tier espresso machines and related parts to coffee enthusiasts worldwide. We pride ourselves on offering high-quality products alongside exceptional customer service to ensure that every coffee aficionado can enjoy the perfect cup.

Job Description

Were looking for an experienced and analytical SEO Specialist to take ownership of our organic growth strategy. You will be responsible for increasing Pro Coffee Gears visibility in search engines, driving qualified organic traffic, and improving the user experience across our content and product pages. This role requires deep SEO expertise, a passion for performance-driven content, and a collaborative mindset.

Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Execution

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive SEO strategy to drive organic traffic, improve rankings, and increase conversions.
  • Conduct keyword research to identify high-impact opportunities and gaps across our product and content categories.
  • Optimize on-page SEO, including site structure, metadata, internal linking, and content enhancements.
  • Own technical SEO efforts in collaboration with engineering to improve site speed, crawlability, indexation, and structured data implementation.

Link Building & Off-Page SEO

  • Develop and lead a scalable link-building strategy to grow domain authority and rankings for competitive keywords.
  • Identify and build relationships with relevant websites, bloggers, publishers, and industry partners for guest posting, mentions, and backlinks.
  • Leverage digital PR tactics, product-led content, and partnership outreach to acquire high-quality, white-hat backlinks.
  • Track and report on backlink profile health and link acquisition performance.

Content Optimization & Collaboration

  • Partner with the content team to ensure SEO best practices are embedded into all editorial, product, and landing pages.
  • Define and oversee a scalable content roadmap driven by search demand and business priorities.
  • Collaborate with creative, product, and UX teams to enhance SEO performance and on-site engagement.

Performance Analysis & Growth

  • Monitor and analyze site performance using tools like Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, and SEMrush.
  • Regularly audit the website and prioritize fixes based on impact.
  • Stay on top of SEO algorithm changes, trends, and new tools. Implement best practices and future-proof strategies.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience in a fast-paced e-commerce or DTC environment.
  • Proven success with building and executing link acquisition strategies.
  • Deep understanding of technical SEO, content strategy, on-page and off-page optimization.
  • Proficiency with SEO and analytics tools (e.g., Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, GA4, GSC, SEMrush).
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data to inform decisions.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (content, dev, UX, marketing).
  • Familiarity with Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms is a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Benefits

  • Opportunity to make a direct impact on a growing global e-commerce brand.
  • Remote role with flexible hours and a collaborative international team.
