raw.description:
Remote option is available for this position.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.

Are you eager to develop your excellence in an inclusive, collaborative, and empowering community? Are you excited about joining a company that strives to make a difference – for its employees, clients, and society? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Workplace Management team and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

This role provides senior HSEQ leadership across Ramboll’s EPC/EPCM project portfolio in Ramboll Americas, supporting the safe delivery of complex engineering, procurement, construction management, commissioning, and turnover activities. The role is responsible for establishing consistent HSEQ governance, aligning contractors and project teams, supporting high-risk work planning, and enabling effective execution across multiple concurrent projects. The successful candidate will bring significant hands-on experience from large-scale EPC/EPCM construction environments and will be able to operate confidently at both strategic and field execution levels.

The ideal candidate will be a credible HSEQ leader with significant field experience on large-scale construction or EPC/EPCM projects, strong contractor management capability, and the confidence to influence senior project, client, and contractor stakeholders. They will be comfortable working across multiple projects, balancing strategic governance with practical field-based support, and helping project teams create consistent, risk-based HSEQ execution.

Your key responsibilities will be:

Strategic HSEQ Leadership

  • Lead the development of a portfolio-wide HSEQ approach that enables consistent standards, scalable processes, and project-specific execution across all EPC/EPCM projects.
  • Serve as primary HSEQ advisor to Project Directors and EPC/EPCM leadership teams.
  • Drive adoption of Ramboll’s HSEQ program and translate its expectations into practical project-level behaviours, controls, and leadership routines.
  • Provide strategic HSEQ guidance during proposals and contract negotiations to align client expectations and establish the conditions needed for effective safety management.
  • Provide HSEQ leadership within an EPC/EPCM delivery model, ensuring clear boundaries, responsibilities, and interfaces between Ramboll, clients, construction contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers.
  • Safety Program Organization & Implementation
  • Define HSEQ organization structures that are scalable with the ability to support multi-project EPC/EPCM delivery on a nationwide basis.
  • Clarify roles, responsibilities, interfaces, and governance models required for integrated EPC/EPCM/ safety programs.
  • Establish standardized HSEQ execution plans across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and turnover.
  • Establish construction readiness expectations, including contractor mobilisation, competency assurance, risk review, and field execution controls.

  • Contractor & Multi-Party Coordination

  • Align HSEQ expectations, execution standards, and performance requirements across contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and third-party stakeholders.
  • Lead contractor onboarding, alignment sessions, audits, and recurring performance reviews.
  • Ensure HSEQ requirements are embedded into contracting strategies, procurement packages, bid documents, mobilisation plans, and contractor management processes.
  • Support project teams in translating Ramboll and client HSEQ requirements into practical field execution requirements for contractors and subcontractors.

  • Risk Management, Governance and Assurance

  • Provide governance and assurance over EPC/EPCM risk management processes, including hazard identification, construction risk assessments, high-risk work reviews, and site controls.
  • Support project HSEQ resources and project leadership in establishing consistent risk management expectations, while ensuring accountability remains clear within the project delivery structure.
  • Review and challenge the effectiveness of controls for high-risk activities, including lifting, electrical work, confined space entry, work at height, ground disturbance, energisation, commissioning, and simultaneous operations.
  • Provide oversight, escalation support, and subject matter input for high-potential or higher-severity incidents, ensuring investigations are completed and lessons learned are embedded across relevant projects.
  • Conduct site visits, leadership engagements, and assurance reviews to verify that project HSEQ controls are effective, understood, and consistently applied by the relevant project teams and contractors.

  • Safety Culture & Engagement

  • Demonstrate visible HSEQ leadership that builds trust, accountability, and proactive safety behaviours across project teams and contractors.
  • Coach project and contractor leadership teams to strengthen leading indicators, reinforce expectations, and promote consistent safety leadership.
  • Promote open communication, psychological safety, learning, and continuous improvement across the EPC/EPCM project portfolio.

  • Regulatory & Compliance Oversight

  • Provide oversight of compliance with applicable health, safety, and environmental regulations, client requirements, and Ramboll HSEQ standards across EPC/EPCM projects.
  • Support project teams in translating regulatory and contractual HSEQ requirements into practical controls and assurance activities.
  • Represent Ramboll in client audits, regulatory inspections, and EPC/EPCM governance meetings, ensuring actions are effectively tracked, communicated, and closed.

  • Performance Management & Reporting

  • Establish consistent HSEQ performance reporting across EPC/EPCM projects, using leading and lagging indicators to identify trends, drive accountability, and improve performance.
  • Translate performance data into clear insights, actions, and recommendations for project leadership, clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

About you

  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive on-site HSEQ leadership experience with substantial large-scale EPC/EPCM project exposure.
  • Strong background supporting multi-contractor, high-risk industrial construction environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Proven experience supporting construction management delivery models where HSEQ performance is delivered through contractor execution and strong client/contractor interface management.
  • Working knowledge of construction-phase HSEQ controls, contractor management, incident investigation, assurance, and regulatory compliance.
  • Ability to travel regularly to project locations and engage effectively with field teams, project leadership, clients, and contractors.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred:

  • Professional certifications (CSP, CMIOSH, NEBOSH, CRSP, or equivalent).
  • Experience with energy transition, power, renewables, industrial de-carbonisation, chemicals, manufacturing, mining, or major infrastructure projects.
  • Experience supporting owner’s EPC/EPCM models across multiple concurrent projects.
  • International or remote project experience.

What we can offer you

  • Investment in your development
  • Being valued for the unique person you are
  • Never being short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
  • The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $136,497 - $197,515 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do. Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. raw.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Browser (New Products)
raw.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role

Mozilla is seeking experienced browser engineers to join a small team exploring new applications of browser technology. The work combines deep systems engineering, rapid experimentation, and close collaboration across technical disciplines.

We are looking for a browser engine specialist who enjoys turning difficult systems questions into working experiments. You will investigate browser behavior, implement changes deep in the engine, and establish which ideas produce meaningful improvements. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership of engine-level investigations and implementation, working closely with the team’s technical lead.

The work suits someone who has built or substantially changed browser internals, understands the tradeoffs embedded in those systems, and enjoys applying that knowledge to unfamiliar problems. Your experiments will help inform technical direction.

What you'll do:

Design and implement experiments within browser engine subsystems. Investigate how internal data structures and execution behavior affect performance, correctness, and the interfaces exposed to developer tools.

Evaluate ways to represent and expose browser state efficiently and accurately. Identify the tradeoffs in each approach, including information loss, implementation complexity, and compatibility with dynamic web content.

Prototype engine capabilities that support reliable programmatic interaction with web content. Investigate how document structure, layout, navigation, and event handling affect correctness and performance.

Instrument browser behavior and evaluate changes against repeatable tasks. Measure performance and correctness, isolate the effect of each change, and document unsuccessful experiments as clearly as successful ones. Check that gains hold beyond the workloads used to develop the prototype.

Profile the overhead introduced by new capabilities and pursue improvements where measurements justify them. Use AI tools to accelerate coding and analysis, and verify their output through debugging, tests, and measurement.

What you'll bring:

  • Deep hands-on expertise in at least one browser engine subsystem, such as DOM and Web APIs, layout and rendering, accessibility, JavaScript runtimes, or networking and process architecture. You have implemented substantial changes and can trace their effects into neighboring subsystems.
  • Strong proficiency in C++ or Rust, experience navigating a large systems codebase, and practical knowledge of memory ownership, concurrency, object lifetimes, and performance debugging. You can build the JavaScript and scripting tools needed to exercise and measure your work.
  • A demonstrated ability to investigate unfamiliar code, form a precise hypothesis, construct a useful prototype, and interpret the results. You can separate the effects of your implementation from variability in websites, workloads, or model behavior.
  • A strong understanding of web platform behavior and compatibility. You can reason about how document structure, script execution, rendering, and user interaction relate, including cases where the browser’s internal state is difficult to expose accurately to another system.
  • Experience with profiling, tracing, regression tests, or conformance tests, and a habit of grounding performance claims in reproducible evidence. You can explain both the benefit of an optimization and the circumstances in which it fails.
  • Curiosity about AI agents and a willingness to work directly with agent harnesses and coding tools. You can connect a low-level implementation choice to the information an agent receives and the work it must do next.

Nice to have:

  • Contributions to Gecko, Servo, Blink, WebKit, or another browser engine
  • Experience maintaining an open-source project
  • Technical leadership in a small team building a new product
  • Experience with accessibility infrastructure, browser security, profiling, or automated evaluation of agent workflows

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

raw.description:
Remote-based in the US

Overview

GoodPower is a global organization working to unlock the economic potential of decarbonization through research, innovation, strategic communications, and disruptive technology. We focus on advancing more affordable and reliable energy, expanding economic opportunity, strengthening energy security, supporting healthier and more resilient communities, and accelerating the transition to a predictable, secure, modern low-carbon economy.

Operating at the intersection of data, digital media, emerging technology, behavioral research, and public engagement, GoodPower develops and deploys scalable strategies designed to accelerate the adoption of decarbonized technologies and infrastructure—including renewable energy, regenerative agriculture, energy storage, and electric transportation. Our work combines rigorous research and experimentation with advanced communications and innovation capabilities to better understand public attitudes, test effective interventions, and help build the social, economic, and market conditions necessary for large-scale transformation.

GoodPower is at a pivotal stage of organizational growth as we approach completion of the first year of our 2030 Strategic Plan. Over the next five years, we intend to significantly expand our reach, capabilities, and impact—investing deeply in innovation, AI-enabled systems, data and analytics, research and development, and next-generation communications infrastructure to help accelerate the global energy transition and the economic opportunities it creates.

Job Summary

The Content Creator’s primary role will be to provide social-first video production across GoodPower and its affiliated brands and partners, with a focus on producing mobile-first content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts and paid media. The Content Creator is a resourceful, trend-aware creative professional with a versatile skillset, a natural and engaging on-camera presence, sharp editing skills and a dedication to GoodPower’s mission to advance a zero-carbon economy. They will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to produce timely, platform-specific content that is brand aligned, visually engaging and compelling.

In this position, the Content Creator will support and execute all phases of the short-form content production process, including concept development, scripting, filming, on-camera hosting, editing and platform-ready delivery for GoodPower and its affiliated entities, social media channels and online media campaigns. The Content Creator brings strong creative instincts and the ability to move quickly from concept to finished product, while producing both planned and rapid response content. This role will focus on translating GoodPower’s research, campaigns and narrative priorities into accessible, social-first content that reflects platform-specific best practices, internet culture, creator trends and audience behavior.

While this position will focus primarily on short-form video and social content, the Content Creator will also support basic social creative needs including Instagram carousels, static memes and Canva-based assets as needs and capacity shift based on priorities. The Content Creator reports to the Senior Director of Video on the Agency team.

This is a full-time position based anywhere in the United States. The Content Creator will work from home, meet as required by video chat with teams, and have weekly national full staff meetings with colleagues online. Some domestic travel may be required for content capture, relevant events, staff retreats and other convenings as needed.

Key Responsibilities

Video Production:

  • Own short-form, mobile-first video production end to end, including concept development, scripting, on-camera hosting, filming, editing and platform-ready delivery for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and paid media

  • Translate complex issues related to affordability, clean energy, jobs and economic opportunity into clear and engaging social content

  • Create content that reflects platform-specific best practices, including pacing, visual storytelling and audience behavior

  • Support creative experimentation by testing new formats, platform features, creator trends and rapid-turn concepts

  • Help steward GoodPower’s brand voice across creator-led and social-first content

  • Produce basic social media creative, including Instagram carousels, static memes and Canva-based assets

  • Manage multiple video projects simultaneously, including rapid response production and turnaround, ensuring timely delivery, adherence to project requirements and high-quality output

Collaborative Projects:

  • Collaborate closely with Agency and Social teams, outside vendors and across teams to ensure project success

  • Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including team leads to understand priorities and needs to deliver exceptional content

Other Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement and implementation of our content processes and workflows to increase speed, efficiency and scalability

  • Perform other content production-related tasks as needed to support GoodPower and its partners

  • Adapt to the evolving needs of a fast-paced organization with flexibility and creativity

Qualifications

Experience & Skills

  • 3–5 years of experience creating and starring in social content for a brand, nonprofit, agency, campaign, creator business or personal channel, with a portfolio showing strong short-form video production, editing and on-camera presence

  • Proven ability to independently concept, script, shoot and edit social video content

  • Strong mobile-first video editing skills (Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro X, CapCut, InShot or similar)

  • Natural, confident on-camera presence, with the range to shift between clear explanation, storytelling and entertainment-driven content

  • Strong grasp of hooks, pacing, visual storytelling and platform-specific best practices across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts and emerging platforms

  • Deep familiarity with internet culture, creator trends, memes and short-form formats

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills in English, plus solid general computer skills (Google Apps, etc.)

Attributes

  • Strong creative judgment — brings ideas, not just edits

  • Self-starter with strong organizational skills, comfortable juggling multiple projects and moving between planned content calendars and rapid-response needs while maintaining attention to detail

  • Collaborative team player who also works well independently, communicates across teams, and is eager to pitch in beyond assigned duties

  • Proactive, flexible and solutions-oriented, with a commitment to innovation and to fostering a culture of excellence, quality and inclusivity

  • Open to constructive feedback and skilled at finding solutions to notes or critiques

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience creating content for advocacy, political, nonprofit, clean energy or issue-based campaigns

  • Experience using Canva or similar tools to create social graphics, carousels, memes or other lightweight creative assets

  • Experience producing rapid response content tied to news, platform trends or campaign moments

  • Comfort interpreting research, policy or campaign messaging and turning it into clear, accessible social content

  • Existing expertise in the climate, renewable energy and democracy spaces

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to support content production, scripting, research, ideation, editing workflows or creative experimentation, or a willingness to learn and integrate AI tools into the production process

This description reflects GoodPower’s assignment of essential functions; it does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. GoodPower retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time. Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship. GoodPower has a zero-tolerance standard for abuse and inappropriate behavior by staff members.

Job Summary

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks

  • Annual salary range: $80,000-87,000, commensurate with experience
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance with employee and dependent premiums paid at 95-100% by GoodPower.
  • 2-4 weeks of paid vacation annually, depending on seniority
  • 13 paid holidays and 2 floating holidays
  • 2 weeks of US office closure
  • 10 days of paid sick leave annually.
  • 403(b) with 3% employer contribution/match.
  • Charitable giving: 1:1 match for charitable contributions ($250 per year), plus 2 paid days off for volunteering.
  • Education reimbursement up to $1,500 per year.
  • Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings options
  • Stipend of $200/month (for cell phone, wellness expenses, etc.)
  • 8 weeks of paid sabbatical after 5 years of employment
  • 8 weeks of paid parental leave

GoodPower offers competitive compensation and benefits packages to employees around the world. Because we operate in multiple countries, benefits will vary based on local laws, regulations, customary practices, and organizational policies applicable in each location.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Statement

GoodPower is an equal-opportunity employer that highly values diversity, equity, and inclusion and views the climate crisis as a social justice crisis.

People who identify as Black, Indigenous, and People of Color (BIPOC), people who experience gender oppression, people with disabilities, and people who identify as members of the LGBTQIA+ community are particularly encouraged to apply.

GoodPower is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with disabilities. Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, GoodPower will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of the position. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or employment process, please contact

Automated Application Review Disclosure

To help us process high volumes of applications fairly and efficiently, GoodPower utilizes Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDTs). These tools scan, evaluate, and rank candidate resumes based on how closely their skills, experience, and qualifications match the core requirements of this job posting.

  • Data Privacy: Your resume data will only be processed for this specific application and will be handled securely in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
  • Human Oversight: Final hiring decisions are always made by a human recruiter or hiring manager.

By submitting an application, you consent to the use of automated tools to review and assess your application materials for this position.

The Financial Analyst II is responsible for preparing analysis for utilization and financial trends, costs, revenues, financial commitments and obligations incurred to predict future revenues and expenses; as well as understand financial impacts of decisions and communicate those to management.

  • Prepare analysis for utilization and financial trends, costs, revenues, financial commitments and obligations incurred to predict future revenues and expenses; understand financial impacts of decisions and communicate those to management
  • Highly involved in the development, production, and validation of reports from detailed claims, eligibility, pharmacy and clinical data
  • Compile and analyze financial and clinical information, including but not limited to preparing the evaluation of medical contracts, product lines, generating and managing medical and administrative cost saving initiatives, etc.
  • Ensure integrity of information obtained for analysis; keep an up-to-date knowledge of the computer information system
  • Develop competitive analysis and present findings to senior management
  • Prepare revenue and medical expense forecast and budget and monitor monthly variances to identify trends
  • Identify and research trends and patterns using standard departmental reports and databases, as well as leveraging other processes and data sources for data mining
  • Make appropriate improvements to internal analysis processes ensuring that practices are in line with the overall goals of the organization
  • Support the financial control environment by reconciling internal data sets vs information provided by the State (such as, reconcile enrollment files to reimbursement records, etc.)
  • Utilize key analysis experience and knowledge to analyze and report medical, contract and administrative activity
  • Make appropriate changes to ensure compliance with MAR, regulatory and other organization requirements

  • Two to Four (2-4) years of experience in financial field is required
  • Managed care or healthcare experience is preferred

  • SQL and/or SAS experience strongly preferred
  • Advanced proficiency level with Microsoft Excel
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Power Point, Access and Word
  • Familiar with a variety of analysis concepts, practices and procedures
  • Relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals
  • Perform a variety of tasks under general supervision

  • Ability to work with others and work independently

AECOM is seeking experienced On-Call Paleontologist's to join our U.S. West Rockies Environmental Planning and Permitting team.

*This remote position is a part-time, on-call role meaning hours will vary and will be dependent on our project-based needs. Candidates should ideally be located in Utah, Nevada, New Mexico, Arizona, Montana or Colorado regions.

Duties and Responsibilities will include, but not limited to:

  • Paleontological fieldwork experience in Western US.
  • Ability to provide taxonomic identification of vertebrate and/or invertebrate fossils to genus- or species-level for various projects.
  • Should possess expertise in field monitoring operations.
  • Strong, concise writing, research and data management skills.
  • Candidates must have the ability to travel and conduct fieldwork throughout Western US

About AECOM’s Environment Business Line
Join AECOM to be part of an expert global team who is connected through a well-developed, worldwide, internal technical practice network through which you can learn from and brainstorm with the best in the world. AECOM is an industry-leading, world class environmental firm, and we want you to succeed within it. We respect and encourage your own pathway to excellence via our Freedom to Grow initiative.

AECOM is known for our award-winning technical excellence, leading-edge science and innovative project delivery. We provide sustainable solutions for some of the world’s most challenging issues. Our global clients and their projects span a variety of market sectors and geographies and require innovative technical solutions to solve wide-ranging environmental problems.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in paleontology or related field such as geology or biology.
  • 2 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education focused on paleontological fieldwork and technical reports.
  • Outdoor activity may involve walking/trekking in uneven terrain over long distances in extreme weather conditions for extended periods of time.
  • Valid U.S driver's license is required for this role; and must be able to travel to job sites safely.
  • Due to the nature of the work, US Citizenship is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • M.S or Ph.D. in Paleontology preferred or related field such as geology or biology.
  • 6+ years of relevant paleontology experience.
  • Candidates may be dual qualified in Archaeology.
  • Strong understanding of federal, state and local environmental regulations.
  • Knowledge and understanding of the regional geology of the Western U.S.
  • Ability to direct field recovery of fossil specimens in the field.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to read topographic maps, geological maps, and project maps.
  • Able to work cooperatively with crew members, supervisors, and clients.
  • Relocation is not available for this position.
  • THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY NOVEMBER 30, 2026.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

About:

Do you remember the teacher who inspired you to reach your full potential? At Vanguard, we pay it forward every day. We are an elite, rapidly expanding college prep team that rejects "test tricks" in favor of deep, foundational learning. Unlike typical part-time tutoring gigs, we offer full-time careers with continuous professional growth, creative freedom, and a collaborative team environment.

Compensation:

  • Base Pay: $21.00 – $24.00 / hour (40 hours/week)
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO), paid sick days, plus fully paid winter vacations

As a Math Instructor, you will be expected to:

  • Teach and Inspire: Instruct small “core” groups of students in their math core skills to drive long-term mastery of topics and top ACT/SAT scores
  • Track Growth: Monitor your students’ progress using Vanguard’s multi-phase curriculum, engaging students in individualized growth and improvement opportunities along the way.
  • Organize: Model professionalism and strong organizational skills by replying to students in a timely manner, maintaining and updating student lesson schedules on our online platform, and holding students accountable for assignments.
  • Innovate: Spearhead the development and creative execution of ever-evolving lesson plans and curriculum.
  • Mentor: Guide middle and high school students with empathy as they navigate an increasingly competitive college prep landscape.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in mathematics, education, or related STEM field from US Schools(Master’s or higher preferred; open to those near graduation)
  • Teaching experience in math and/or experience working in a community college or college-level tutoring center (1+ years)
  • Academic history demonstrating high achievement (e.g., 3.5+ GPA)
  • Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, MS PowerPoint, and G-Suites
  • Access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace

The ideal candidate will also possess:

  • Robust understanding of classroom pedagogy, and the ability to create customized, engaging lesson plans that use practical, real-world examples to inspire a love for learning
  • Desire to help students recognize, reach for, and realize their fullest potential
  • Engaging communicator who can make complex math feel approachable
  • The ability to work both independently and in a team environment
  • Mastery of SAT and ACT Math, especially the following subjects:
    • Pre-Algebra
    • Algebra I & II
    • Geometry
    • Trigonometry
    • Statistics

Why you want to teach with Vanguard College Prep:

  • Paid training and comprehensive preparation
  • Distinctive and individualized approach to test prep with a strong track record of producing top-tier students and nationally-ranked test scores
  • Opportunity to work with our distinctly engaged, enthusiastic, and driven client base of students energized by Vanguard’s commitment the highest-quality client experience
  • Elite team of instructors, counselors, and specialists from Ivy League and top universities across the nation who are passionate about fostering student success
  • Quickly-growing start-up environment that emphasizes creativity, collaboration, and leadership, with opportunities for long-term career growth
  • Competitive compensation structure (dependent on experience) with benefits

About Vanguard College Prep:

​​Vanguard College Prep is a full-service educational company whose mission is to enable the future leaders of our globalized world to meet their fullest potential. Through its test prep, college counseling, and college essay services, Vanguard is committed to providing meaningful, all-encompassing college preparation that treats each student as an individual, preparing them for the boardroom, not the assembly line.

Two things set Vanguard apart from other after school companies: our elite team and our personalized, organic curriculum. Unlike other test prep companies, which often take a one-size-fits-all approach to test prep, Vanguard recognizes that every student learns differently. Our experienced instructors and counselors strive to shatter this assembly line model by focusing on core learning rather than short-term strategies and tips, tailoring instruction to fit each student’s individual needs. We encourage students’ continual questioning and curiosity with the goal of extending learning beyond the classroom, so that our students will be successful in the elite college of their choice and beyond.

Salary: $21 – $24 / hour

raw.description:
This job is what Jerry is all about: helping our customers take care of their most important assets, their car and home, with the kind of warmth and speed they didn't expect from an insurance company.

Car and home are people’s most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey - insurance, repairs, financing, maintenance - is fragmented, complicated, and expensive. Jerry.ai is building the first app to help people manage it all.

The work is fast-paced, high-energy, team-oriented, and fully remote. A few things our team members love about working at Jerry:

  • Opportunities to shape the customer experience as the product and services are constantly evolving.

  • Competitive wage and benefits (medical, dental, vision insurance, 401K match, paid vacation time).

  • Stock equity (stock options) — we're a tech startup, and you own a piece of what you're building.

  • Flexible scheduling: a 5-day, 8-hour or a 4-day, 10-hour work week.

  • Fully remote, with work equipment provided.

  • A career path in one of the largest industries in the world — insurance. We pay for your P&C insurance license if you don’t have one yet.

  • And, importantly, the colleagues you work alongside. Ask our team what they value most and the answer is almost always the same: the people and the culture. Jerry is full of people who take their work seriously and take helping each other just as seriously.

You don't have to know yet whether you're a sales person or a service person. We will figure this out together through the interview process.

As a member in the Customer Operations team, some of your responsibilities could include:

  • Taking great care of our customers. Our team members don't just answer the question asked — they catch the thing the customer didn't know to ask about. A coverage gap. A discount they qualify for. A renewal about to spike.

  • Answering inbound calls from customers shopping auto, home, motorcycle, and other policies, and from policyholders who need something changed.

  • Getting deep on the product. With a large panel of insurance companies to work from, knowing which one fits which customer is the craft of this job. Our app evolves constantly too, and knowing it inside out makes you the person customers trust to navigate it.

  • Problem solving to remove barriers between a customer and the right coverage.

  • Processing service requests — vehicles, drivers, lienholders, policy documents.

  • Making the product better. Tell us what you're hearing. The feedback loop here is short enough that you'll see your suggestions ship.

Who you are:

  • Prior work experience in customer service, sales, or hospitality is a plus, but not required

  • Genuinely friendly and positive attitude and willingness to work as a team

  • Strong work ethic

  • Strong problem solving skills

  • Strong communication skills

Compensation and perks:

  • For sales path: Hourly wage of $19.00 - 21.00 plus uncapped commissions *Our most successful team members typically earn $100,000+ per year.

  • For service path: Hourly wage of $19.00 - 21.00

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed on this job posting, determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We are a remote-first company, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Within Health is revolutionizing eating disorder treatment through our innovative telehealth platform. We provide remote clinical services at the Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP) and Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) levels of care. Our mission is to transform lives by increasing access to quality eating disorder treatment, improving patient outcomes, and fostering healing in a compassionate, stigma-free environment. We combine clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology to address the complex needs of individuals with eating disorders, creating a future where effective treatment is accessible to all who need it.

Our Culture

Within is a purpose-driven physician-led healthcare organization committed to innovation, compassion, and integrity. We bring together clinicians, technologists, and eating disorder professionals to transform lives through exceptional care. In 2025 and 2026, we were named one of Forbes’ Top Startup Employers in the U.S, a recognition based on performance and reputation.

The Role

The Primary Therapist is a minimum of a Master’s Level Clinician responsible for the individual and family therapy of specific clients, and group therapy for a group of clients. The therapist specializes in working with clients with eating disorders, is mature, flexible, and innovative, and brings a loving, positive attitude to our expert Clinical Team. The Primary Therapist works well with other departments to create a treatment plan for clients.

This is a full-time position in our Palmetto region, which covers AL, FL, GA, NC, and SC. Applicants must be licensed in SC and willing to obtain licensure in at least one or more of these states in order to qualify for this position.

What You'll Do

  • Establish positive, trusting rapport with clients.
  • Diagnose and treat mental health disorders.
  • Create and update individualized treatment plans according to patient needs and circumstances.
  • Meet with patients regularly to provide services and treatment, and to adjust treatment plans as necessary.
  • Coordinate and arrange for services needed for each individual client.
  • Conduct ongoing assessments of patient progress.
  • Conduct group therapy sessions according to program schedule.
  • Involve and advise family members when appropriate.
  • Refer patients to outside specialists or agencies when necessary.
  • Maintain thorough records of patient meetings and progress.
  • Follow all safety protocols and maintain client confidentiality.
  • Communicate regularly with outpatient providers to ensure continuity of care.
  • Attend weekly staff meetings to consult on individual cases.
  • Attend weekly treatment team meetings to consult with clients about individual progress.
  • Create weekly individualized therapeutic and experiential opportunities for clients and communicate them to patients.
  • Conduct concurrent insurance reviews for individual clients.
  • Engage in ongoing advocacy work for mental health parity.
  • Engage in community based speaking opportunities to increase eating disorder awareness.
  • Other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of a Master’s Degree in Psychology, Social Work or related field. Must be fully licensed and can work without supervision.
  • Able to get licensure in other states when asked.
  • Strong communicator, both verbally and in writing.
  • Experience treating clients with Eating Disorders.
  • Ability to demonstrate understanding of a variety of models and theories of eating disorders, trauma, mental illness, and related issues.
  • Knowledge of philosophies, practices, policies and outcomes of models of treatment, recovery, relapse prevention, and continuing care for dually diagnosed populations.
  • Understanding of diagnostic criteria for co-occurring conditions and ability to conceptualize modalities and placement criteria within the continuum of care.
  • Understanding of diverse cultures and gender specific issues and ability to incorporate needs of gender and culturally diverse groups into practice settings.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize workload and work independently.
  • Must not be opted out of Medicare.

Physical & Environmental Requirements

  • Must have reliable internet connection.
  • Must be comfortable operating a computer and smart-phone and navigate applications within macOS and iOS.
  • Must be comfortable communicating with colleagues via chat, telephone, and video calls.
  • Must be able to sit for the majority of the shift.
  • This is a work-from-home position. Work should be performed in a private, quiet space with minimal background noise.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package including salary commensurate with experience
  • Remote work flexibility with a results-driven culture
  • Comprehensive health benefits that reflect our commitment to wellbeing
  • The chance to directly transform lives and makes treatment accessible
  • Collaborative and innovative work environment with a team passionate about our mission
  • Professional development opportunities and support for continued growth

Director of Product: Capital One Shopping (Remote - Eligible)
Come join our growing team in Capital One Shopping - If you have a remarkable ability to use data to tell a story, form a hypothesis and define metrics to identify the success of product initiatives - this is the role for you!

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

We're looking for a Director of Product Management with a demonstrated interest and aptitude for AI. While formal on-the-job experience with AI is a plus, we highly value candidates who have proactively incorporated AI into their personal projects, explored AI-driven development environments (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot), or built automations using AI agents. Show us how you've used AI to learn, build, and solve problems beyond basic text generation.

Capital One Product Framework

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions tohundreds of thousands of businessesand empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Sales Development Representative supporting Twilio’s New Business and Strategic Sales organizations.

About the job

This role is critical to growing and developing pipeline for Twilio’s New Business and Strategic Sales teams. The Sales Development organization is a strategic component of Twilio’s overall go-to-market strategy.

As a team, we collaborate daily, push each other to do the best work of our lives, and bring an unparalleled level of energy and drive to our jobs. We’re looking for people who have a growth-oriented mindset and want to build their careers within Twilio. If this role excites you but you think you don’t check every box, we still encourage you to apply — we’re already looking forward to meeting you.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Break into new companies and markets using a multi-channel, value-based approach focused on building relationships and driving awareness of Twilio’s platform.
  • Receive all the necessary training and insights to confidently begin contacting prospects through Twilio’s SDR onboarding experience.
  • Achieve and exceed monthly goals for generating new business opportunities to fuel the sales pipeline.
  • Become a master of Salesforce, Outreach, Sales Navigator, and other tools essential for efficient workflows.
  • Research accounts to determine how Twilio’s solutions can provide value, then execute outbound dials, personalized emails, and social selling.
  • Work in partnership with Account Executives to develop account strategies, territory plans, and successfully generate new business opportunities.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

raw.description:
The Language Doctors, Inc. is a U.S.-based linguistic company known for delivering high-quality language services. We are currently seekinga Japanese Document Formatting & Transcription Specialist to help prepare documents for translation.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys structured, detail-heavy work and takes pride in producing clean, accurate documents.

Role Purpose

As a Transcriber, your core responsibility is to recreate scanned document PDFs into fully editable Microsoft Word documents,ensuring the content and formatting match the original file as closely as possible. These Word files serve as the “mirror” documents our translators rely on to deliver high-quality translations.

Important: This is not an audio transcription and not creative editing. You will be working with scanned PDFs, often from international healthcare systems, with varying layouts and quality.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Convert scanned PDFs into editable Word documents that match the source (layout, tables, spacing, headings, line breaks, and structure).
  • Work with a wide variety of formats (typed notes, tables, bilingual sections, complex layouts, occasional handwriting).
  • Use OCR outputs when available, and/or request OCR support when needed; then clean, format, and verify the document in Word.
  • Follow written style and formatting guidelines to ensure consistency across files.
  • Handle medical documents confidentially and responsibly at all times.
  • Flag unclear or illegible content for further review and document any uncertainties.
  • Perform a line-by-line quality check before submitting work to reduce errors and omissions.

Experience & Skills Required

  • Advanced Microsoft Word skills, especially formatting (tables, tabs, spacing, page layout, headers/footers, styles).
  • Excellent attention to detail and comfort with doing meticulous, repetitive work.

Language Requirements:

  • Japanese: JLPT N4 or equivalent proficiency required (ability to read hiragana, katakana, and basic kanji). JLPT N3 or above is a plus.
  • English: Basic knowledge preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience handling medical, legal, or technical documents with complex formatting.
  • Familiarity with OCR tools such as ABBYY FineReader or Adobe Acrobat Pro.
  • Basic image editing skills (helpful for improving readability in difficult scans).

AvailableSchedule

  • Monday to Friday 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM EST
  • Monday to Friday 12:00 PM – 8:30 PM EST

raw.title: Business Development Manager
raw.excerpt: Elior Support Services – The People Behind Every Plate Every great meal starts somewhere.
raw.description:
Elior Support Services – The People Behind Every Plate Every great meal starts somewhere. Not just in our kitchens, but in the teams that support them.

Whether you're driving strategy, managing risk, building brands, supporting our people, or keeping our business running smoothly, your work helps create the conditions for great food and exceptional service. You may not be on the frontline. But your influence will be felt in every dish served, every contract won and every guest experience we create.

We’re looking for a Business Development Manager to join our team and play a key role in growing Elior’s business across the UK. This is a role for a genuine sales professional who knows how to spot an opportunity, build a compelling proposition and turn a first conversation into a signed contract. You’ll own your business development pipeline, seek out new tender opportunities and lead the sales journey from those all-important first conversations through to closing the deal. You’ll work closely with our Operations, Marketing, Finance and Legal teams to create commercially strong, creative and compelling solutions that show clients exactly why Elior is the right partner for them. And you won’t simply hand a contract over once it’s won. You’ll remain involved through mobilisation and key retention activity, helping ensure the client experience lives up to the promise made during the sales process. This is a home-based role, with equipment provided, so you can be based anywhere in the UK. You’ll need a full UK driving licence and be comfortable travelling to meet clients and attend key business meetings. If you’re commercially sharp, naturally curious, confident in front of clients and motivated by the thrill of winning new business, we want to hear from you. What you’ll be serving up…

  • Building your own pipeline, actively researching the market, networking and identifying new business and tender opportunities across the UK.
  • Creating opportunities, developing relationships with prospective clients and positioning Elior as a credible, innovative and compelling catering partner.
  • Owning the sales process, from initial contact and discovery meetings through to solution development, presentations, negotiation and contract close.
  • Leading winning tenders, bringing together the right people across Operations, Finance, Marketing and Legal to develop solutions that are commercially viable and genuinely meet the client’s needs.
  • Selling the Elior proposition, confidently communicating our USPs and tailoring our story to what matters most to each client.
  • Using your commercial instinct, understanding the opportunity, the competition, the numbers and what it will take to turn a prospect into a profitable contract.
  • Building strong client relationships, taking the time to understand their challenges and becoming someone they want to do business with.
  • Bringing creativity to your solutions, working with internal teams to develop compelling written proposals, presentations and service solutions.
  • Keeping the momentum, managing multiple opportunities and deadlines simultaneously while ensuring every prospect receives a high-quality and professional experience.
  • Supporting successful mobilisation, staying connected after the win to help ensure the transition from signed contract to operational delivery is seamless.
  • Supporting key retention activity, coordinating bids, presentations and commercial activity where existing contracts are up for renewal.
  • Taking ownership of your numbers, managing your weekly activity, maintaining accurate pipeline information and reporting progress against your sales targets.

The ingredients you’ll bring…

  • Proven experience in business development, sales or contract acquisition, ideally within contract catering or food service.
  • A strong understanding of the UK contract catering market and what it takes to win new business.
  • A proven track record of securing new contracts, ideally including experience across food service and/or healthcare.
  • Strong commercial acumen, with the confidence to understand the numbers, challenge assumptions and negotiate effectively.
  • Excellent relationship-building skills. You’ll be comfortable developing relationships from first contact through to senior-level client conversations.
  • Confidence leading tenders, presentations and sales meetings, with the ability to influence and engage a range of stakeholders.
  • Strong writing skills and the creativity to turn a brief into a compelling commercial solution.
  • Experience managing multiple tenders and opportunities simultaneously, with exceptional organisation and the ability to meet tight deadlines.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Operations, Finance, Marketing, Legal and other specialist teams to develop winning bids.
  • Excellent communication, listening and interpersonal skills, with the ability to understand what a client really needs rather than simply selling a standard solution.
  • Strong IT skills and confidence working with CRM, tendering and sales tools.
  • A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel as required.

What really matters We’re looking for someone who is hungry to win. Someone who doesn’t wait for opportunities to land in their inbox, but gets out there, builds relationships, asks the right questions and creates opportunities. You’ll need the commercial confidence to challenge, the creativity to develop a proposition that stands out and the resilience to keep going when a deal doesn’t go your way. Most importantly, you’ll understand that great business development isn’t just about winning the contract. It’s about winning the right contract, building the right relationships and creating sustainable growth for Elior.

What's on the menu for you… At Elior, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, valued and able to thrive. That's why we offer a benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, career, finances and life outside of work. Here’s a taste of what you can expect when you join us:

  • Free lunches provided
  • Flexible and part-time working opportunities
  • Company car or car allowance
  • Private Healthcare
  • 33 days holiday, with the option to buy up to an additional 10 days per year
  • Rewarding bonus package up to 15%
  • Enhanced family, personal and compassionate leave policies
  • Paid volunteering days
  • Training, development and career progression opportunities
  • Pension scheme, life assurance and financial wellbeing support
  • Salary Advance, giving you access to a portion of your pay before payday
  • A supportive, inclusive culture where everyone can thrive

Plus access to Elior Spark, our enhanced wellbeing platform, offering support for you and your immediate family, including:

  • 24/7 virtual GP appointments
  • Mental health support, counselling and therapy sessions
  • Physiotherapy services and second medical opinions
  • Online gym and workout programmes
  • Legal and financial advice
  • Nutrition, fitness and lifestyle guidance
  • Meditation and mindfulness resources
  • Dedicated wellbeing helplines and expert support whenever you need it

Fancy being part of the recipe? At Elior, over 10,000 colleagues come together every day with one purpose: to enrich lives everywhere, every day. We're proud that 87% of our colleagues are proud to work here — and we think that's because people are given the support, trust and opportunities they need to thrive. Don't tick every box? Don't rule yourself out. We're looking for people with potential, passion and the right attitude, not just a checklist of experience. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels they belong. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, just let us know.

Ready to join us? Hit ‘Apply Now’ and let’s chat!

Business Growth Intern — Hands-On, In-Person & Remote Internship

Location:Roanoke, Virginia
Schedule:Flexible around your class schedule
Compensation:Unpaid internship; eligible for academic credit

This Is Not a “Get Coffee” Internship

At Paybility, interns do not sit on the sidelines, organize filing cabinets, or spend an entire semester watching other people work.

You will be part of the team.

Our internship program is designed for motivated students who want real-world experience, meaningful responsibilities, and the opportunity to contribute to projects that directly impact a growing company.

You will work alongside our leadership team, collaborate with other interns and professionals, participate in strategy conversations, and help turn ideas into real business results.

What You’ll Experience

Depending on your interests, strengths, and academic program, you may gain hands-on experience in areas such as:

  • Marketing and social media strategy
  • Business development and sales support
  • Recruiting and human resources
  • Communications and content creation
  • Market and industry research
  • Project management
  • Customer experience
  • Process improvement
  • Partnership development
  • Community outreach
  • General business operations

This internship is intentionally collaborative. You will work on team projects, contribute your ideas, receive feedback, and see how different departments work together to grow a business.

What Makes This Internship Different?

You will not be given meaningless “intern work.”

You may help develop a marketing campaign, research a new market, improve an internal process, assist with recruiting initiatives, create business content, support a partnership strategy, or present recommendations directly to company leadership.

Your work will have a purpose—and you will be able to point to real projects, accomplishments, and skills when you update your résumé.

You’ll Be a Great Fit If You Are:

  • Currently enrolled in a college or university
  • Located in or able to commute to Roanoke, Virginia
  • Curious, dependable, and eager to learn
  • Comfortable sharing ideas and asking questions
  • Able to work independently while contributing to a team
  • Interested in entrepreneurship, business, marketing, communications, HR, sales, or operations
  • Looking for experience that goes beyond observing from the sidelines

You do not need years of experience. We are looking for students with initiative, professionalism, creativity, and a willingness to grow.

  • Real-world business experience
  • Portfolio-worthy projects
  • Exposure to multiple areas of a growing company
  • Direct collaboration with company leadership
  • Professional coaching and constructive feedback
  • Strong résumé-building experience
  • Networking and professional references

About Paybility

Paybility is a growing business solutions company headquartered in Roanoke, Virginia. We help businesses improve how they accept payments, manage operations, access technology, and create opportunities for growth.

Our culture is entrepreneurial, collaborative, fast-moving, and built around one central belief: great ideas can come from anyone, regardless of their title or experience level.

Apply today and come build something with us.

The DBA will design and implement database strategies, administer enterprise-wide data architecture, implement complex data structures, and provide daily management of Postgres databases. The DBA will create and administer all database objects from design to deployment utilizing subject matter expertise to design or re-use, configure, and implement database solutions/processes that maximize system availability, efficiency, effectiveness, integrity, recoverability, and supportability.

Specific responsibilities include:

  • All aspects of database administration including installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, migration, capacity planning, performance tuning, backup and recovery.
  • Responsible for evaluating patch releases and patching requests from development, and communicating constraints, issues, and timelines for deployment.
  • Change management including maintenance of multiple development, test, QA, and production environments. Responsible for deploying approved changes to production.
  • 24x7 rotational on-call support, including driving Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Preventative action follow-though, and participation in weekly operations reviews.

  • Actively participate and contribute to projects involving enterprise systems enhancements.
  • Implementation and ongoing support of high availability architecture not limited to Active/Active and Active/Passive Clusters
  • Work with development project teams to design and implement database solutions to meet business requirements.
  • Regular proactive capacity planning and tending reviews of all databases. Producing weekly, monthly management reports.
  • Develop and implement Database security policies and procedures, in line with corporate objectives.

  • Must have 8+ years DBA working experience with PostgreSQL 9.6+ version and good understanding of Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server.

  • Experience in implementing Postgres STIG implementation, testing, and other vulnerability remediation.

  • Experience with database replication is a plus.

We're looking for an highly organised Video Production Coordinator to own the day-to-day running of our video pipeline, from booking VIP guests through to publishing and promotion.

Key responsibilities

Video management and workflow

• Brief and coordinate our team of editors, freelancers and, where applicable, junior team members.

AI-assisted content creation

• Use approved AI tools to draft titles, subheaders, descriptions and promotional copy, and refine the output to meet brand voice and editorial standards.
• Take responsibility for the accuracy of all published text, especially guest names, job titles, company names and factual claims.
• Help shape best practice for how the team uses AI tools, including what content can and cannot be entered into them.

YouTube hosting, promotion and reporting

• Manage YouTube channel publishing: titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails, chapters, playlists, end screens and captions.
• Write promotional copy for YouTube, social media and newsletters.
• Track performance (views, watch time, retention, engagement) and produce regular reports with recommendations for improving reach.

Proofing and quality control

• Act as the final quality checkpoint before publication: proof drafts for spelling, on-screen graphics, audio issues, branding and accuracy.

Post-campaign client reporting

• Prepare post-campaign performance reports for clients, covering metrics such as views, watch time, audience retention, engagement, click-throughs and reach across YouTube, social and newsletter channels.

From cross-border teamwork to supporting major live events, you'll be part of something international, fast-moving, and meaningful.
